name: Stirfried Mung Bean Sprouts
ingredients:
3 cups Fresh Mung Bean Sprouts, Rinsed Thoroughly
2 Tablespoons Vegetable Oil
1 whole Red Onion (or 2 Shallots), Peeled, Halved And Sliced Thinly
4 cloves Garlic, Peeled And Sliced Thinly
2 Tablespoons Soy Sauce
1 Tablespoon Oyster Sauce
2 Tablespoons Chopped Coriander Stalks Or Spring Onions, For Garnish
description: My favourite way of having mung bean sprouts (or nga choy or taugeh as we call it here). Fresh, quick and delicious!

name: Baked French Onion Soup
ingredients:
6 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, Divided
3 pounds Spanish Onions, Cut Into ¼” Slices
1  Leek, White And Very Light Green Parts, Julienned
½ cups Water
2 teaspoons Kosher Salt
1 teaspoon Freshly Ground Black Pepper
1 teaspoon Dried Thyme Leaves
4 cloves Garlic, Chopped
2 Tablespoons All-purpose Flour
2-½ quarts Homemade Beef Stock Or Low-sodium Store Bought
½ cups Cognac
½ cups Dry Sherry
1  French Bread Baguette, Cut On The Bias In ¾” Slices
2 cloves Garlic, Cut In Half
4 ounces, weight Gruyère Cheese, shredded
4 ounces, weight Mozzarella Cheese, Shredded
2 ounces, weight Asiago Cheese, Grated
1 Tablespoon Fresh Parsley, Finely Chopped
description: This French Onion Soup takes time and effort but the finished product is amazing! Sweet and yummy perfection in a bowl!

name: Apple Cinnamon Roll Muffins
ingredients:
3 cups FOR THE ROLLS:
1 Tablespoon All-purpose Flour
1-½ teaspoon Granulated Sugar
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Baking Soda
1 cup Fine Sea Salt
¼ cups Buttermilk
½ cups Unsalted Butter, melted
½ cups FOR THE FILLING:
2 teaspoons Brown Sugar
½ teaspoons Granulated Sugar
¼ teaspoons Ground Cinnamon
¼ teaspoons Ground Nutmeg
1 Tablespoon Ground Ginger
½ whole Fine Sea Salt
½ cups Melted Butter
¼ cups Apple, Skins Removed And Finely Minced
2 Tablespoons FOR THE GLAZE:
1 Tablespoon Apple Cider (or Pureed Apple)
½ teaspoons Confectioners Sugar
1 whole Honey
description: Cinnamon rolls from scratch don’t have to be difficult! These rolls are spiced up with apple and baked in a muffin pan!

name: Vegetable Nicoise Salad
ingredients:
⅓ cups FOR THE VINAIGRETTE:
¼ cups Olive Oil
2 teaspoons Lemon Juice
2 teaspoons Minced Fresh Oregano
1 teaspoon Minced Fresh Thyme
1 clove Dijon Mustard
½ teaspoons Garlic, Minced
¼ teaspoons Freshly Ground Pepper
1 pound Salt
1 pound FOR THE SALAD:
½ pounds Small Red Potatoes, Halved
1 can Fresh Asparagus, Tough End Removed
1 whole Fresh Green Beans, Stems Removed
1 can 16 Oz. Can, Kidney Beans, Drained And Rinsed
1 head Large Shallot, Thinly Sliced
6 whole (13-14 Oz Can) Artichoke Hearts, Quartered, Drained
½ cups Romaine Lettuce, Washed And Torn Into Large Pieces
description: Delicious spring salad loaded with flavor—tastes just like springtime!

name: Orange Chocolate Chip Shortbread Cookies
ingredients:
1 stick Unsalted Butter, At Room Temperature
½ cups Powdered Sugar
¼ cups Fresh Orange Zest
2 Tablespoons Fresh Orange Juice
1 cup Flour
½ cups Shredded Coconut
1 pinch Salt
½ cups Mini Chocolate Chips
description: Light, buttery shortbread cookies packed with fresh orange zest, chocolate chips and coconut!

name: Sriracha Barbeque Sauce
ingredients:
1 cup Ketchup
¼ cups Brown Sugar
2 teaspoons Sriracha Hot Sauce
1 Tablespoon Soy Sauce
2 teaspoons Teriyaki Sauce
¾ teaspoons Kosher Salt
½ teaspoons Garlic Powder
1 Tablespoon Vinegar
description: A tangy, sweet ‘n spicy BBQ sauce that everyone will love.

name: Dungeness Crab Ceviche
ingredients:
½ cups Finely Chopped Tomatoes, Seeded
½ cups Finely Diced Red Onion
1 whole Serrano Pepper, Seeded And Diced
8 ounces, weight Fully Cooked Dungeness Crab Meat, Picked Over For Shells
2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
2 Tablespoons Lime Juice
¼ teaspoons Salt
¼ cups Chopped Fresh Cilantro
1 whole Avocado, Peeled, Pitted, And Diced
description: A mixture of Dungeness crab, tomatoes, onions, lemon, lime, cilantro and avocado. It’s like sunshine in a bowl. Perfect for Cinco de Mayo!

name: Daing na Bangus (Vinegar-Marinated Fish)
ingredients:
1 whole Milkfish, Filleted
1 Tablespoon Salt
7 cloves Garlic, Crushed And Chopped
1 cup Vinegar
⅓ cups Water
1 Tablespoon Black Peppercorns
description: Daing na bangus is an authentic Filipino dish where fish is marinated in fermented vinegar, garlic and peppercorns for long hours. Try it for a really appetizing fish meal.

name: Spring Greens Flatbread Pizza
ingredients:
1 whole Pizza Dough (enough For A 12-14 Inch Size Pizza)
2 cups Fresh Spinach Leaves, Packed
2 whole Spring Onions, Whites And Greens
2 stalks Green Garlic
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
⅔ cups Grated Asiago Cheese
description: Fresh spinach, young onions and green garlic come together with a bit of cheese and olive oil to make a delightful, springy pizza.

name: Fettuccine Carbonara
ingredients:
1 pound Fettuccine
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
6 ounces, weight Pancetta, Diced
8 ounces, weight Crimini Mushrooms, Sliced
1 whole Small Yellow Onion, Finely Diced
4 cloves Garlic, Finely Minced
2 whole Large Eggs
1 cup Parmesan Cheese, Finely Grated
¾ cups Half-and-half
1 teaspoon Salt
½ teaspoons Freshly Ground Black Pepper
2 Tablespoons Fresh Parsley, Chopped
description: This recipe will have your mouth watering … literally.

name: Mashed Turnips with Sage Brown Butter
ingredients:
5 whole Medium To Large Turnips, Scrubbed, Ends Removed, Cut Into 1-inch Chunks
3 cups Milk, Approximately
4 Tablespoons Butter
16 whole Sage Leaves (16 Leaves Is Roughly 1 Small Handful)
description: Lighter than mashed potatoes, with such a lovely interesting flavor.

name: Soft Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients:
½ cups Butter, Softened
1-¼ cup Natural Smooth Peanut Butter
¼ cups Powdered Sugar (this Is Approximate, Depends On How Runny Your Peanut Butter Is—mine Was Pretty Runny!)
½ cups Granulated Sugar
⅓ cups Brown Sugar
½ teaspoons Baking Soda
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
1 whole Egg
½ teaspoons Vanilla Extract
1-¼ cup All-purpose Flour
description: This are yummy, but be forewarned, they are high sugar, which completely cancels any of the merit you get by using natural peanut butter.

name: Aunt Silvia’s Almond Chews
ingredients:
3  Egg Whites
3 cups Almond Flour
1 cup Sugar
1 teaspoon Almond Extract
½ cups Candied Cherries
description: Soft and tasty almond chews.

name: Cioppino
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1  Onion, Diced
4 cloves Garlic, Minced
1  Red Bell Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed Then Chopped
1  Yellow Bell Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed Then Chopped
1 can 14 Oz Can, Diced Tomatoes, No Salt Added
½ teaspoons Sea Salt
1 teaspoon Each: Smoked Paprika, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Oregano, Thyme
¼ teaspoons Red Pepper Flakes
4 cups Low Sodium Chicken Stock
4  Links Cooked Chicken Sausage, Sliced
½ pounds Shrimp, Peeled And De-veined
½ cups Parmesan Cheese, Shredded
¼ cups Green Onions, diced
description: Well, it’s sorta Cioppino. I use this term loosely … A delicious light and brothy soup that’s packed with flavor.

name: Ice Cream Chimichangas
ingredients:
4 whole 6 Inch Flour Tortillas
2 cups Vanilla Ice Cream, Divided
½ cups Sugar
¼ cups Cinnamon
description: Deep-fried tortillas filled with vanilla ice cream and topped with cinnamon sugar.

name: Asparagus with Garlic Chips
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil, Plus More For Drizzling
2 cloves Garlic, Sliced
1 bunch Asparagus, Bottom Ends Snapped Off
2 ounces, weight Goat Cheese Crumbled
description: Asparagus with bold flavors!!

name: Roasted Green Beans
ingredients:
1 pound Fresh Green Beans, Ends Trimmed
2 whole Small Yellow Onions, Thinly Sliced
description: Tender, crisp, roasted green beans and onions, topped with Parmesan cheese.

name: Wheat Berry Waldorf Salad with Citrus Vinaigrette
ingredients:
1 cup Uncooked Wheat Berries (I Used Par Cooked  Wheat Berries.)
½ cups Apple Cider Vinegar
1 cup Orange Juice
½ Tablespoons Kosher Salt
½ Tablespoons Fresh Ground Pepper
½ teaspoons Ground Nutmeg
½ teaspoons Ground Cinnamon
¼ cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 whole Lemon, Juiced
½ cups Goji Berries
1 whole Large Apple, Chopped
2 stalks Celery, Chopped
3 whole Scallions, Chopped
4 Tablespoons Chopped Fresh Parsley
½ cups Chopped Pecans
description: Refreshing and healthy salad packed with fruit and nuts. Fiber-filled deliciousness!

name: Flourless Chocolate Chip Chickpea Blondies with Sea Salt
ingredients:
1 can Olive Oil Cooking Spray
½ cups (15 Oz. Size) Chickpeas, Rinsed And Drained
⅓ cups All Natural Peanut Butter (or Almond Butter)
2 teaspoons Pure Maple Syrup Or Agave Nectar (you Can Also Use Honey If You're Not Vegan)
½ teaspoons Pure Vanilla Extract (gluten-free If Desired)
¼ teaspoons Salt
¼ teaspoons Aluminum Free Baking Powder
⅓ cups Baking Soda
description: Secretly healthy blondies made with chickpeas, peanut butter, and chocolate. Taste amazingly like peanut butter cookies. Flourless and no butter! Natural ingredients only!

name: Fennel Arugula Salad
ingredients:
5 ounces, weight FOR THE SALAD:
1 bulb Baby Arugula Lettuce
½ cups Fennel (Small)
½ cups Parmesan Romano Cheese (Freshly Grated)
1  Sottocenere Truffle Cheese (Thinly Sliced)
1  FOR THE DRESSING:
1-½ Tablespoon Large Meyer Lemon Or One More If Needed (Room Temp So It's Extra Juicy)
⅛ teaspoons Large Regular Lemon, Plus One More If Needed (Room Temp So It's Extra Juicy)
⅛ teaspoons Olive Oil
description: I had never had fennel before, but when I tasted this salad I absolutely loved it and over the years I have changed the recipe to include Meyer lemons and truffle cheese. It’s really refreshing. The bitterness of the baby arugula with the tart lemon dressing and the salty Parmesan cheese makes it perfect.

name: Gluten-Free Pineapple Coconut Muffins
ingredients:
2 cups Gluten Free Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Soda
½ teaspoons Salt
¼ cups Brown Sugar
6 ounces, weight Pineapple Yogurt
1 teaspoon Vanilla
2  Eggs
½ cups Almond Milk
2-½ Tablespoons Coconut Oil, Softened
½ cups Water
¼ cups Unsweetened Shredded Coconut
description: Easy gluten-free pineapple coconut muffins made with pineapple yogurt and coconut oil.

name: The Best Steamed Artichokes
ingredients:
4 cloves Garlic, Minced
2  Bay Leaves
2  Lemons Cut In Half
¼ cups White Wine
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
4 cups Chicken Broth
2  Salt And Pepper, to taste
description: Flavorful way to make fresh steamed artichokes.

name: Southwest Roast Chicken Breasts
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Butter, Softened
1 clove Garlic, Minced
¼ teaspoons Chili Powder
½ teaspoons Chopped Cilantro
2 dashes Salt
2 dashes Pepper
2 whole Bone-in, Skin-on Chicken Breasts
½ Tablespoons Olive Oil
description: This is an easy, delicious meal perfect for a busy weeknight or entertaining!

name: Homemade Madras Curry Paste
ingredients:
1 whole Medium-large (about 200 G Size) Onion, Peeled And Quartered
4 cloves Large Cloves Garlic, Peeled
2 whole Jalapeno Peppers, De-seeded And Halved (more Or Less To Taste)
1 piece (1 1/2-inch Size) Fresh Ginger, Peeled And Cut Into Chunks
2-½ Tablespoons Good-quality Madras Curry Powder
2 teaspoons Ground Coriander
1 teaspoon Ground Cumin
1 teaspoon Ground Chili Powder
½ teaspoons Ground Turmeric
½ teaspoons Ground Mustard Powder
½ teaspoons Ground Black Pepper
¼ teaspoons Coarse Salt (more Or Less To Taste)
2 Tablespoons Apple Cider Vinegar
2 Tablespoons Vegetable Oil
description: The nice thing about making your own curry paste is that like anything homemade, not only is it far fresher than anything store-bought, but it is also completely customizable. This really makes a difference when it comes to heat level. I consider this recipe as written to be about a “medium” heat level. For “mild” omit the jalapenos, and for “hot” use 3 jalapenos and add 1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper (or to taste).

name: 5-Minute Homemade Strawberry Ice Cream
ingredients:
¼ cups Banana, Very Ripe
½ cups Heavy Cream
12 ounces, weight Frozen Strawberries
1 teaspoon Pure Vanilla
description: 5 Minute Homemade Strawberry Ice Cream, made with frozen strawberries, banana and cream. Only 5 grams of sugar per 1/2 cup serving. It has a rich texture, and the flavor profile is tart, yet sweet. Whole foods never tasted better!

name: Millet Pilaf with Roasted Carrot and Fennel
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Ghee (clarified Butter)
¾ cups Hulled Millet, Briefly Rinsed In A Colander Under Cold Running Water
1-¼ teaspoon Coarse Kosher Salt, Divided
2 cups Boiling Water
4 whole Medium Carrots, Thinly Sliced On The Diagonal
1 whole Medium Bulb Fennel (with A Few Of The Fronds Reserved For Garnish), Halved And Thinly Sliced
1 whole Medium Onion, Halved And Thinly Sliced
⅛ teaspoons Ground Black Pepper
2-½ Tablespoons Fresh Lemon Juice
1-½ Tablespoon Hazelnut Oil (or Pistachio Oil, Or Even Just Extra Virgin Olive Oil)
description: For this pilaf, I roasted a pan of veggies (carrot, fennel, and onion) to toss with the millet. These veggies kept the flavors light and the look fresh, but any pan of your favorite roasted veggies will do quite nicely. I dressed this pilaf very simply with fresh lemon juice and hazelnut oil.

name: Butter Lettuce, Lox and Tarragon Schmear Bagel Sandwiches
ingredients:
2 ounces, weight FOR THE TARRAGON SCHMEAR:
2 Tablespoons Cream Cheese (low Fat Is Fine)
2 teaspoons Sour Cream Or Greek Yogurt
1 pinch Minced Fresh Tarragon
2 whole Black Pepper
4 ounces, weight FOR THE SANDWICHES:
2 slices Everything Bagels, Split Open (or Any Kind Of Bagels You Like)
1 whole Lox
4 leaves Red Onion
2 whole Medium Tomato, Thinly Sliced
description: This delicious sandwich will rival anything you get at a New York deli!

name: Mini Orange Honey Cornbread Muffins
ingredients:
1-½ cup Whole Wheat Pastry Flour
½ cups Cornmeal
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
¼ teaspoons Sea Salt
1 cup Milk (I Used 2 %)
¼ cups Orange Juice
2  Eggs, Beaten
⅓ cups Honey
⅓ cups Nonfat Greek Yogurt
½ cups Corn
description: A perfect whole grain little muffin that goes great with BBQ baked beans or even slathered with jam for breakfast!

name: Pina Colada Yogurt Parfaits
ingredients:
2 cups Low Fat Greek Yogurt
2 Tablespoons Plus 1 Teaspoon Raw Honey, Divided (Or Substitute Two Individual Serving Size Packets Of Stevia)
4 teaspoons Chia Seeds
1 cup Fresh Pineapple, Diced
½ cups Toasted Coconut Flakes Unsweetened
description: A healthy, high-protein snack with Greek yogurt, fresh pineapple, toasted coconut, honey and chia!

name: Black Bean Enchiladas with Avocado Sauce
ingredients:
5 slices Pickled Green Jalapeno
2 cloves Garlic
1 whole Avocado, Peeled And Pitted
6 tablespoons, 2 teaspoons, 4-⅝ pinches Vegetable Stock
2 Tablespoons Sour Cream
1 Tablespoon Pine Nuts
6 Tablespoons Fresh Chopped Cilantro
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 can Black Beans, Drained, 15 Ounce Can
½ whole Green Pepper, Diced
3 whole Spring Onions, Sliced
3-⅝ ounces, weight Cheddar Cheese, Grated
4 whole Flour Tortillas (large)
1 whole Medium Tomato, Thinly Sliced
description: Cheesy black beans in coriander pesto, wrapped in soft flour tortillas and baked in avocado sour cream sauce. Absolute heaven!

name: Chocolate Beetroot Smoothie
ingredients:
½ whole Red Beet, Steamed, Chopped, And Frozen
1-½ Tablespoon Raw Cacao Powder
1 whole Frozen Banana
½ cups Cranberry Kefir
½ cups Almond Milk
description: A superfood smoothie jam packed with nutrients and oxidants made with red beets, cacao powder, cranberry kefir and more!

name: Asian-Style Quinoa with Tofu (Vegan!)
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Rice Vinegar
2 Tablespoons Plus 1 Teaspoon Soy Sauce, Divided
1 teaspoon Sesame Oil
1 teaspoon Sriracha Or Other Chili Sauce, Plus More To Taste
1 can Diced Water Chestnuts, 6 Ounce Can, Drained
¼ whole Small Head Cabbage, Roughly Chopped
1 whole Carrot, Finely Chopped
½ packages Tofu (14-16 Ounce Package), Drained And Cut Into Small Cubes
½ cups Quinoa, Cooked To Package Directions
2 whole Scallions, Thinly Sliced On An Angle
1 teaspoon Sesame Seeds
description: Vegan, but definitely doesn’t taste boring or overly healthy.  You MUST eat this.

name: Easy Cumin Refried Beans
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1  Onion, Diced
4 cloves Garlic, Minced
½ cups Low Sodium Chicken Stock
2 Tablespoons Cumin
½ teaspoons Garlic Salt
1 teaspoon Pepper
2 cans 14 Oz Cans, Pinto Beans, Drained And Rinsed
½ cups Cotija Cheese
½ cups Cilantro, Chopped
description: A super easy and quick Mexican style side dish.  Perfect with tacos, enchiladas or fajitas!

name: Paleo Brownie Bites (Gluten-Free, Grain-Free, No Refined Sugar, No Bake)
ingredients:
⅔ cups Shredded Unsweetened Coconut
1 cup (heaping Cup) Medjool Dates, Pitted (1 Heaping Cup Is About 17 - 20 Medium Sized Dates)
⅓ cups Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
⅔ cups Raw Walnut Pieces And Halves
1 Tablespoon Vanilla Extract
2 Tablespoons Coconut Milk OR Liquid Sweetener (like Honey, Agave, Or Maple Syrup) If You Would Like Them Sweeter
description: Amazing chewy delicious brownie bites that are paleo, vegan, gluten-free, grain-free, have no refined sugar and require no baking!

name: Blueberry Agua Fresca
ingredients:
12 ounces, weight Frozen Blueberries
1 pint Fresh Strawberries, Cleaned And Sliced In Half
½ cups Simple Syrup (purchase It Or Make Your Own) Or Your Favorite Sweetener
7 cups Water, Divided Use
1 cup Ice
description: A wonderful fruit water that is really delicious and perfect for your Cinco de Mayo festivities.

name: Double Chocolate Mini Ruffle Cake
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE CAKE:
¾ cups Granulated Sugar
2 Tablespoons All-purpose Flour
¼ cups All-purpose Flour
2 Tablespoons Cocoa Powder (sifted)
¾ teaspoons Cocoa Powder (sifted)
¾ teaspoons Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Baking Soda
1 whole Salt
½ cups Egg, Room Temperature
¼ cups Sour Cream, Room Temperature
1 Tablespoon Canola Oil
½ cups Vanilla Extract
1-⅞ ounces, weight Boiling Water
2 Tablespoons FOR THE BUTTERCREAM:
2 sticks Dark Chocolate, Chopped In Pieces
2 cups Heavy Cream
½ cups Unsalted Butter,  Room Temperature
1 teaspoon Powdered Sugar
4 Tablespoons Cocoa Powder (sifted)
description: Double Chocolate Mini Ruffle Cake

name: My Perfect Macaron
ingredients:
1 cup Powdered Sugar
¾ cups Almond Flour
2 whole Egg White
¼ cups Granulated Sugar
1 drop Food Coloring Paste Of Your Choice
½ cups Filling Of Your Choice (frosting, Etc)
description: My perfect macaron.

name: Lemon Cookies
ingredients:
1-⅓ cup All-purpose Flour
¼ teaspoons Baking Soda
¼ teaspoons Salt
1 stick Unsalted Butter,  Room Temperature
1 cup White Sugar
3 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
½ Tablespoons Lemon Zest
1 whole Egg, Room Temperature
¼ teaspoons Vanilla
description: A bright and refreshing cookie, perfect for spring!

name: Matcha (Green Tea) Icebox Cheesecake
ingredients:
2-½ cups Chocolate Cookie/wafer Crumbs
1 cup Plus 1 Heaping Tablespoon Sugar, Divided
4 Tablespoons Melted Butter
1-¼ cup Chilled Heavy Cream
16 ounces, weight Cream Cheese, At Room Temperature
1 cup Milk
1 Tablespoon Matcha (green Tea) Powder, More For Dusting
2-¼ teaspoons Gelatin Powder
¼ cups Water
description: Matcha (Green Tea) Icebox Cheesecake—fluffy and light matcha flavored filling with a chocolate crust.

name: Grilled Pork Wrapped in Bacon Tacos
ingredients:
2 slices FOR THE GRILLED PORK TACOS:
1 pound Apple Wood Smoked Bacon
1 Tablespoon Pork Tenderloin
8 whole Trader Joe's Steak Sauce Or BBQ Sauce
1 cup Corn Tortilla Shells Or Flour (I Used Mission 50-Calorie White Corn Tortilla)
2 cups Your Favorite Taco Toppings
¼ cups FOR THE CABBAGE SLAW:
½ whole Mango, Diced
1 Tablespoon Cabbage, Shredded
1 pinch Cilantro, Finely Chopped
¼ teaspoons Jalapeno, Seeded, Diced Small
¼ teaspoons Lime Juice
description: A tender, juicy pork tenderloin, covered in crispy bacon placed on top of a tortilla with a sweet and spicy mango cabbage slaw.

name: Teriyaki Pineapple Mushroom Burgers
ingredients:
2 whole Portobello Mushroom Caps
1 cup Teriyaki Sauce
2 pieces Pineapple Rings, 1/4 Inch Thick
½ Tablespoons Honey
2 slices Manchego Cheese
2 whole Hamburger Buns
1 bunch Baby Spinach
description: Grilling season has begun and this vegetarian portobello mushroom burger is the perfect place to start.

name: Romesco Sauce (aka Roasted Red Pepper Sauce)
ingredients:
¼ cups Blanched Slivered Almonds
1 slice Sandwich Bread, Crust Removed, And Torn Into Small Pieces
1 clove Garlic, Chopped
8 whole Jarred Piquillo Peppers
1 whole Chipotle In Adobo, Seeds Removed (add 2 If You Want It Spicier)
1 Tablespoon Tomato Paste
2 Tablespoons Sherry Vinegar Or Red Wine Vinegar
¼ teaspoons Salt
¼ teaspoons Pepper
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
description: Light and healthy doesn’t have to mean boring. Romesco Sauce is bright and flavorful and can be used to top so many dishes. Serve it over chicken, steak or fish. Serve atop some croquettes, toss it into pasta, or just dunk your bread into it!

name: Gai Pad King
ingredients:
1 cup Jasmine Rice
1-¾ cup Water
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
2 cloves Garlic, Minced
6 ounces, weight Chicken Breast, Sliced Thinly
2 teaspoons Thai Fish Sauce
2 teaspoons Oyster Sauce
2 teaspoons Sugar
¼ cups Fresh Ginger, Cut Into Matchsticks
½ cups Bell Pepper, Julienned
¼ cups Button Mushrooms, Sliced
2 whole Green Onions, Cut Into 2-inch Pieces
1 teaspoon Thai Red Chili Paste, Or To Taste
3 Tablespoons Fresh Cilantro
description: Thai Ginger Chicken is quick and delicious with fresh, versatile ingredients.

name: Mint Julep Cocktail
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE SIMPLE SYRUP:
1 cup Water
1 bunch Sugar
2 ounces, weight Fresh Mint
1 ounce, fluid FOR THE COCKTAIL:
1 sprig Bourbon
description: Light, minty and refreshing for Derby Day or any hot summer evening!

name: Brownies
ingredients:
3 whole Eggs
5 ounces, weight Sugar
3-½ ounces, weight Unsalted Butter
7 ounces, weight Unsweetened Baking Chocolate (fondant)
2-½ ounces, weight Flour, All Purpose
1 teaspoon Baking Soda
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
3-½ ounces, weight Chopped Walnuts
3 ounces, weight Chocolate Chips
description: Cracked crust and moist brownie recipe with fudge chocolate and walnuts.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
ingredients:
2 cups All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Soda
½ teaspoons Salt
½ cups Unsalted Butter
¾ cups Brown Sugar
½ cups Granulated White Sugar
2 whole Large Eggs
2 Tablespoons Whole Milk
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
1-½ cup Dark Chocolate Chips
1 teaspoon Coarse Sea Salt, For Sprinkling
description: These chocolate chip cookie bars have a kick of sweet and a kick of salty: the perfect dessert!

name: Creamy Bow Tie Pasta
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Butter
1 clove Garlic, Minced Or Chopped
2 Tablespoons All-purpose Flour
1 cup Whole Milk
8 ounces, weight Cream Cheese
7 ounces, weight Heavy Cream
6 cups Salt To Taste
3 Tablespoons Pepper To Taste
description: Looking for a white sauce for pasta? I guess you may have found it with this recipe!

name: Mexican Rice (aka Spanish Rice)
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 clove Garlic, Minced
½ cups Finely Chopped Scallion Whites (reserve Green Tops For Garnish)
1 cup Long Grain White Rice, Rinsed And Drained
¾ cups Diced Tomatoes
½ teaspoons Fine Salt
1-½ cup Chicken Broth
2 teaspoons Tomato Paste
2 Tablespoons Finely Chopped Parsley
description: Here’s an easy recipe for Mexican Rice (aka Spanish Rice). It’s cooked right in a rice cooker, which happens to be my new favorite kitchen toy.  But hey, don’t worry if you don’t have a slow cooker. I’ll share my easy stove top directions too.

name: Tea Biscuit Sweet
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Unsalted Butter
14 ounces, weight Sweetened, Condensed Milk
3-½ ounces, weight Tea Biscuit Crumbs
3 Tablespoons Grated Parmesan Cheese
description: Unexpected guests? Running out of time? Try this sweet treat and make everybody happy!

name: Skinny Coconut Shrimp
ingredients:
1 pound Medium Shrimp, Peeled And Deveined (tail On)
1  Egg Beaten
1-¼ cup Coconut, Flakes
½ cups Panko
description: Baked coconut shrimp, the perfect warm weather dinner!

name: Baked Chicken Taquitos
ingredients:
1-½ cup Cooked Chicken Breast, Shredded
2 teaspoons Hot Sauce
8 whole Soft, Corn Tortillas
description: We love love love Mexican food at our house so when Alessa and I decided to feature Mexican food as our theme this month, I knew the family would love it! This particular recipe is so very easy and I tried to make it a bit healthier by baking instead of deep frying the taquitos.

name: Breakfast Bagels with Spicy Cream Cheese and Anahiem Chili Scrambled Eggs
ingredients:
2  Eggs
1 Tablespoon Greek Yogurt
⅛ cups Diced Anahiem Chilis
1 teaspoon Coconut Oil
¼ cups Cream Cheese
1 Tablespoon Chili Sauce (I Like Trader Joe's)
2  Whole Wheat Bagels (I Recommend Panera's Bagels)
4 slices Bacon, Cooked Until Crisp
¼ cups Shredded Pepperjack Cheese (I Use The Pepadew Cheddar From Trader Joe's)
description: The best breakfast sandwich!

name: Blackberry Shortcakes with Mascarpone Cream
ingredients:
½ cups Mascarpone Cheese
¼ cups Organic Sugar (Or Agave Nectar)
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
1 teaspoon Meyer Lemon Zest
6  Pre Made Store Bought Shortcakes
1 cup Blackberries
description: Such a easy dessert. You can make this in five minutes! The cream sauce is so good! I also use it as a layer in cakes and tortes!

name: 5-Minute Mediterranean Hummus
ingredients:
½ cans (15 Oz. Size) Chick Peas Drained And Rinsed
10 whole Pitted Kalamata Olives
3 pieces Sun Dried Tomatoes
2 cloves Garlic
2 Tablespoons Feta Cheese
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
½  Lemon, Juiced
description: Out of this world 5-minute Mediterranean Hummus: chickpeas, olives, sun dried tomatoes, garlic, feta, lemon juice and olive oil—what’s not to love!

name: Dried Bok Choy Soup (Choy Kon Tong)
ingredients:
2-½ ounces, weight (1 Bunch) Dried Bok Choy, Soaked In Water
2 whole Honey Dates
6 whole Red Dates (Jujube)
8 cups Water (boiling Water If Using Slow Cooker)
2 whole Chicken Drumsticks, Skin Removed
1 Tablespoon Salt, Or To Taste
description: Dried bok choy has an amazingly savoury earthy flavour that makes really good warming soups.

name: Black Bean and Roasted Corn Salsa
ingredients:
2 ears Fresh Corn, Shucked And Kernels Removed
1  Vine Ripe Tomato, Halved
¼  Large Yellow Onion, Peeled
15 ounces, weight Black Beans, Drained And Rinsed
1 teaspoon Fresh Cilantro, Chopped
½ teaspoons Salt
1  Lime
description: In honor of Cinco de Mayo, it was time to break out the black beans and make a little salsa. This is not the normal tomato-based salsa. Instead, it is filled with fresh corn, lime, cilantro, and onion. Roasting the corn, tomato, and onion adds an extra sweetness to the recipe. This light and refreshing salsa is great for the upcoming warm months.

My bacon theory is that by placing the bacon in a cold oven to start, as the oven gradually heats to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C), the bacon undergoes a magical transformation from cold flabby piece of meat, to simmering deliciousness, to crispy bacon heaven as the oven hits the 425 degree mark. Enjoy!"

1 cup FOR THE DOUGH:
½ cups All-purpose Flour, Plus More For The Work Surface
1 teaspoon Lukewarm Water
½ Tablespoons Dry Active Yeast
½ Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 cup Butter At Room Temperature, Plus More To Grease The Pan
½ ounces, weight Salt To Taste
¼ ounces, weight FOR THE TOPPING:
description: Looking for a pizza recipe? This is the one: delicious and easy to prepare!

name: Orange White Chocolate Pain Perdu
ingredients:
¾ cups Granulated Sugar
½ cups Water
¼ cups Fresh Orange Juice
1 whole Cinnamon Stick
1 whole Orange, Peeled And Segmented
4 whole Large Eggs
1 cup Whole Milk
¼ teaspoons Kosher Salt
4 whole Slices Orange White Chocolate Bread, Cut In Half Diagonally
3 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter
description: Sweet pain perdu made with orange and white chocolate brioche, drizzled with orange syrup.

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cupcakes
ingredients:
½ cups Milk
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
1 cup Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
¼ teaspoons Salt
1 cup Sugar (half White Sugar, Half Brown Sugar If You Have It)
6 Tablespoons Butter, Softened
2 whole Eggs, Beaten
1 cup Peanut Butter (chunky Is My Favorite For This Recipe, But Creamy Is Just Fine Too)
2-½ cups Chocolate Chips, Semi Sweet
1 container Pre-made Frosting, 16 Ounce Size (vanilla Is Best)
2 Tablespoons Cocoa Powder
3 Tablespoons Half And Half/heavy Cream/milk
description: A relatively easy and delightful recipe for Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cupcakes. Inspired by other bakers, yet adapted by yours truly thanks to whatever I had in my kitchen!

name: Peanut Butter Cup Cookies
ingredients:
1 cup Packed Brown Sugar
½ cups Butter, Softened
½ cups Creamy Peanut Butter
1 whole Egg
1-¼ cup All-purpose Flour
¾ teaspoons Baking Soda
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
¼ teaspoons Salt
1 cup Mini Peanut Butter Cups, Chopped
description: Soft and chewy peanut butter cookies studded with mini Reese’s peanut butter cups.

name: Pinakbet 3-Veggie Recipe
ingredients:
5 cloves Garlic, Crushed And Chopped
1 Tablespoon Oil
1 whole Plump Tomato, Cut In Small Sizes But Not Diced
1-½ Tablespoon Fish Sauce, Divided
3 pieces Small Bitter Gourd, Seeds Scooped Out And Cut (See Note)
1 whole Long Green Eggplant, Cut To 4 Inches
15 pieces Okra, Cut In Halves
1 bulb Red Onion, Cut Thinly
½ cups Water
3 teaspoons Fish Paste
½ teaspoons Sugar
description: Stir-fry vegetables with fish paste. You wouldn’t know how good it is until you tried it.

name: Green Goddess Dressing or Dip (Vegan)
ingredients:
½ cups Chopped Parsley
½ cups Chopped Dill
¼ cups Cilanto
1 clove Garlic
1 cup Vegenaise
1 cup Vegan Sour Cream
1 Tablespoon Fresh Lemon Juice
1 Tablespoon Apple Cider Vinegar
½ Tablespoons Sugar
1 teaspoon Fresh Lemon Zest
½ teaspoons Salt
3 pinches Fresh Ground Pepper
description: Before America’s love affair with with ranch dressing, there was Green Goddess, which originated in San Francisco in 1923 at the Palace Hotel: mayo-based, packed with herbs, lemon and garlic! Traditionally, made with chervil and tarragon, I use dill, parsley and cilantro, which can be found in any supermarket. I’ve made this at the restaurant as a spread for a fried green tomato sandwich and at home as a dip for raw veggies.

name: Quinoa and Chickpea Patties with Cilantro Yogurt
ingredients:
¾ cups Water
½ cups Quinoa (rinse If Needed)
2 teaspoons Oil
1 whole Medium Onion, Diced
2 teaspoons Minced Garlic
¼ teaspoons Dried Parsley
½ teaspoons Red Pepper Flakes
1 can Chickpeas, 16 Oz Can, Drained And Rinsed
1 cup Chopped Spinach, Uncooked
¼ cups Plus 2 Tablespoons Finely Chopped Cilantro
1 teaspoon Lemon Juice
¼ cups Feta Cheese
1 whole Large Egg, Beaten
1 cup Whole Grain Bread Crumbs, Plus More If Needed
1 teaspoon Salt/enough To Flavor
2 teaspoons Black Pepper
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 cup Nonfat Plain Yogurt
½ teaspoons Pepper
½ teaspoons Salt
description: This patty is not only healthy, but utterly scrumptious.

name: Quinoa with Broccoli Pesto
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE QUINOA:
2 cups Quinoa
5 cups Water
4 cloves Fresh Broccoli, Cut Into Florets
⅔ cups Garlic
⅔ cups Sliced Almonds, Toasted, Divided
½ teaspoons Fresh Grated Parmesan, Divided
2 Tablespoons Salt
¼ cups Fresh Lemon Juice
¼ cups Olive Oil
½ cups Heavy Cream
1-½ teaspoon FOR THE CHILI OIL:
description: This is a unique and healthy side dish or a great meatless meal for lunch. Broccoli, quinoa, Parmesan cheese and a delicious chili oil to drizzle on top for a complex finish.

name: Roasted Balsamic Strawberries
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons Maple Syrup
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
2 Tablespoons Balsamic Vinegar
½ teaspoons Salt
2 pints Fresh Strawberries, De-stemmed And Quartered
description: Luscious and rich strawberries get taken up a notch when roasted to perfection. Add them to ice cream, yogurt, oatmeal, or toast. Or just eat with a spoon.

name: Roasted Strawberry Pie Parfaits
ingredients:
1 pound Fresh Strawberries, Washed And Hulled
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
4 teaspoons Granulated Sugar, Divided
1 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon
1 whole Refrigerated Pie Crust
16 ounces, weight Fat Free Vanilla Greek Yogurt
description: A healthy yogurt parfait that tastes just like strawberry pie! Pie for breakfast? You bet!

name: Roasted Tomato and Goat Cheese Omelet
ingredients:
1 pint FOR THE ROASTED TOMATOES:
½ teaspoons Cherry Tomatoes, Washed And Cut In Hald
¼ teaspoons Olive Oil
2  Red Pepper Flakes
2 teaspoons Salt And Pepper, to taste
1 pinch FOR THE OMELET:
¼ cups Large Eggs
2 teaspoons Milk
¼ teaspoons Salt And Pepper, to taste
¼  Roasted Tomato (see Recipe Below)
description: Hearty and healthy brunch that will leave you wanting more!

name: Scandinavian Delights
ingredients:
2 cups Powdered Sugar
1 cup Melted And Cooled Unsalted Butter
1 whole Egg Yolk
½ teaspoons Vanilla
½ teaspoons Almond Extract
½ teaspoons Salt
¾ cups Flour
description: Don’t let their simple appearance fool you. These little dainties melt in your mouth and are absolutely delicious!

name: Frito Pie
ingredients:
2-½ cups Fritos, Divided
1  Large Onion, Chopped
1 cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese, Divided
2 cups Leftover Chili
description: I am a little embarrassed to even share this recipe because it so simple but it’s a great way to used leftover chili!

name: Sesame Noodles
ingredients:
12 ounces, weight Thin Spaghetti
3 cloves Garlic, Minced
2 Tablespoons (heaping) Peanut Butter
2 Tablespoons Rice Vinegar
3 Tablespoons Sesame Oil
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar
¼ cups Soy Sauce
1 Tablespoon Thinly Sliced Scallions (optional)
1 teaspoon Crushed Red Pepper (optional)
⅓ cups Thinly Sliced Carrots And/or Chopped Peanuts (optional)
description: Fast and simple sesame noodles that are peanut butter delicious!

name: Shrimp Relleno
ingredients:
1 whole Medium Onion, Diced
1 Tablespoon Garlic, Minced
½ teaspoons Salt
¼ teaspoons Cinnamon
1 whole Small Bay Leaf
¾ cups Chicken Broth
1 can Diced Tomatoes, 15 Oz Can, Un-drained
1 pound Uncooked Shrimp, Peeled And Deveined
description: Shrimp (“camarones” in Spanish) are one of my favorite foods to cook. This easy to make relleno sauce complements the shrimp well and goes great with a Lowcountry favorite—rice! The ingredients are items found in most pantries so give this a whirl for a little “South of The Border” flavor.

name: Simple Granola
ingredients:
6 cups Old Fashioned Oats
¼ cups Flax Seed (optional)
⅔ cups Honey
½ cups Oil
1 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon
¼ teaspoons Ground Nutmeg
⅛ teaspoons Ground Cloves
1 cup Chopped Nuts And/or Dried Fruit
description: Simple, quick and healthy granola that will become a fast favorite!

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Veggie Burgers
ingredients:
1 1/2 pounds sweet potatoes (smaller potatoes cook faster)
1/3 cup millet
1 cup old fashioned oats (use certified gluten-free oats if you are avoiding gluten)
1 15 oz. can black beans, rinsed and drained
1/2 small red onion, diced
1/2 cup lightly packed fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
2 teaspoons cumin powder
1 teaspoon chili powder
1 teaspoon chipotle powder or smoked hot paprika
1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder (optional, to taste)
1/2 teaspoon salt
high quality vegetable oil for cooking burgers (or coconut oil, if you don’t mind the coconut taste, olive oil may burn)
8 whole wheat hamburger buns (optional)
your favorite burger fixings (avocado or guacamole, tomato or pico de gallo, lettuce, sprouts, ketchup, hot sauce, mustard, pickles, cheese)
description: These sweet and spicy veggie burgers are both vegan and gluten free. For best results, prepare the burger mixture in advance and let it chill in the refrigerator (you can let it chill overnight or longer if you’d like). These veggie burgers don’t have to be served as traditional burgers—the patties are good on their own with toppings like guacamole and pico de gallo or in a salad with Southwestern flavors. Try serving them with corn on the cob in the summer.

name: Southwest Kale Salad with Cumin Ginger Sage Dressing
ingredients:
½ cups FOR THE DRESSING:
8 cloves Grapeseed Oil (plus 2 Tablespoons)
8 leaves Garlic, Minced
1 piece Fresh Sage, Chopped
3 teaspoons Ginger, Grated (1" Piece)
¼ cups Ground Cumin
¼ cups Balsamic Vinegar
½ teaspoons Apple Cider Vinegar
2 whole Salt
1 ear FOR THE SALAD:
1 head Eggs
1 can Corn, Leaves And Silks Removed
1 whole Kale
3 stalks Black Beans, 15 Ounce Can Drained And Rinsed
1 whole Red Bell Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed Then Chopped
description: A classic southwest salad made with kale for extra nutrition and topped with a homemade cumin ginger sage dressing.

name: Spinach and Artichoke Dip Pizza
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE CRUST:
1 package Warm Water (110 Degrees Fahrenheit)
2 Tablespoons (1/4 Oz. Packet) Instant Yeast
2-½ cups Olive Oil
4 ounces, weight All-purpose Flour
1 can Garlic Powder, To Taste
1 teaspoon FOR THE TOPPING:
1 bag Whipped Cream Cheese
2 cloves (14 Oz. Can) Quartered Artichokes, Drained
½ cups Olive Oil
2 cups (9 Ounce Bag) Fresh Spinach
description: Your favorite restaurant appetizer dip served on a pizza crust.

name: Spring Pea and Asparagus Pasta
ingredients:
1 pound Medium Pasta Shells
4 Tablespoons Olive Oil, Plus More For Drizzling
5  Shallots, Quartered Lengthwise And Thinly Sliced Widthwise
1 pound Asparagus, Ends Snapped Off, Chopped Into 1/2-inch Pieces
2 teaspoons Minced Garlic
2 cups Sweet Peas
⅔ cups Parmesan Cheese, Plus More For Sprinkling
2 Tablespoons Butter
2 teaspoons Grated Lemon Zest
1 whole Lemon, Juiced
1 cup Chopped Fresh Herbs
¾ cups Roasted Sunflower Seeds (preferably Unsalted)
description: Fresh spring peas and asparagus tossed with cheese, butter, herbs and pasta shells. Amen.

name: Spring Radish and Avocado Open-Faced Sandwich on Pumpernickel
ingredients:
2 pieces Sliced Pumpernickel
1 whole Avocado, Peeled, Pitted And Thinly Sliced
2 pinches Fresh Black Pepper
6 whole Radishes, Greens Trimmed Off Then Sliced Into Rounds
2 pinches Pink Himalayan Salt Or Sea Salt
2 pinches Micro Greens, Optional
description: Sometimes the simplest things in life are the tastiest! The key to this sandwich is the pumpernickel has to be crusty and the avocado has to be ripe.  Perfect for lunch or a light dinner. Also makes an awesome tea sandwich for your next party!

name: Strawberry Cream Scones
ingredients:
2-½ cups Flour
½ cups Sugar
½ teaspoons Kosher Salt
½ teaspoons Baking Soda
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
8 Tablespoons Cold Butter, Cut Into Small Pieces
1  Large Egg, Beaten
⅔ cups Cold Heavy Cream, Plus 1 Tablespoon For Brushing On Scones
3  Large Strawberries, Thinly Sliced
1  FOR THE STRAWBERRY GLAZE:
2 cups Strawberry, Minced
1 Tablespoon Powdered Sugar
description: Creamy layers of tender scone and fresh strawberries!

name: Strawberry Jello Pie
ingredients:
½ cups Sugar
3 Tablespoons Cornstarch
3 Tablespoons Strawberry Jell-O
1 cup Water
1 Tablespoon Fresh Lemon Juice
1 pint Strawberries, Sliced Thick
1 whole 9 Inch Pie Crust, Baked And Room Temperature
8 ounces, weight Cool Whip , Thawed
description: Fresh strawberries in a strawberry glaze, topped with whipped cream, all in a crunchy crust.

name: Strawberry Lemonade
ingredients:
2 cups FOR THE SIMPLE SYRUP:
1 cup Water
1 pint Sugar
1 cup FOR THE STRAWBERRY PUREE:
1 whole Strawberries, Hulled (or 2 Cups Frozen Strawberries, Thawed)
1 cup Cold Water
1 cup FOR THE LEMONADE:
2 cups Lemon, Zested
description: A deliciously fresh homemade Strawberry Lemonade recipe made with fresh strawberry puree.

name: Strawberry Lemonade Frappe
ingredients:
1 cup Frozen Strawberries
¼ cups Lemon Juice
½ teaspoons Stevia To Taste
1 cup Water
1 cup Ice
description: A sweet, tangy frozen drink blended with strawberries and lemon.

name: Blueberry Pie
ingredients:
5-¼ cups Frozen Blueberries
¼ teaspoons Vanilla Extract
2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
1 cup White Sugar
½ cups Flour
¼ teaspoons Salt (if You're Using Unsalted Butter...otherwise 1/8 If It's Salted Butter)
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
½ teaspoons Nutmeg
1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar
2 Tablespoons Butter, Divided Use
1 whole Egg Beaten
1 package Pre-Made Pie Crusts (1 Package Includes Two Pie Crusts)
description: Deliciously homemade blueberry pie with pre-made pie crust.

name: Blackened Salmon Tacos with Avocado Corn Salsa & Cilantro Ranch Dressing
ingredients:
1 pound FOR THE BLACKENED SALMON
2 Tablespoons Salmon (I Used Wild Sockeye), Pin Bones And Skin Removed, Patted Dry
2 Tablespoons Canola Oil
2 teaspoons Flour
1 teaspoon Chili Powder
2 teaspoons Smoked Paprika
½ teaspoons Brown Sugar
½ teaspoons Onion Powder
½ teaspoons Garlic Powder
½ teaspoons Cumin
½ teaspoons Cayenne, Or To Taste
½ teaspoons Salt
1 whole Pepper
1 whole FOR THE AVOCADO CORN SALSA
1 whole Ripe Avocado, Peeled, Pitted And Finely Chopped
¼ cups Large Ear Of Corn (I Used Fresh White Corn), Shucked, Then Kernels Cut Off
2 Tablespoons Tomato, Seeded Removed And Diced
½  Red Onion, Diced
¼ cups Cilantro, Chopped
2 Tablespoons Lime, Juiced
2 Tablespoons Salt And Pepper, to taste
½  FOR THE CILANTRO RANCH DRESSING:
1 clove Plain Greek Yogurt
2 Tablespoons Mayonnaise
¼ cups Buttermilk
¼ teaspoons Lime, Juiced
¼ teaspoons Garlic, Peeled
10 whole Green Onions, Thinly Sliced
description: Flavorful, spicy blackened salmon tacos topped with fresh avocado corn salsa and tangy cilantro ranch dressing made with Greek yogurt. A delicious way to enjoy salmon.

name: Tahini Pasta – Vegan!
ingredients:
⅔ pounds Spaghetti Or Other Long Pasta
1 can Chickpeas, 15 Ounce Can
¼ cups Olive Oil Plus A Drizzle For Your Skillet
½ teaspoons Smoked Paprika, Plus More For Serving
¼ cups Fresh Parsley Leaves, Plus Extra For Serving
¼ cups Fresh Mint Leaves, Plus Extra For Serving
1 whole Lemon, Juiced
3 Tablespoons Tahini Paste
2 cloves Garlic, Peeled
description: I added carbs to hummus. It works well!

name: Thai Coleslaw
ingredients:
2 whole FOR THE DRESSING:
2 Tablespoons Limes, Juiced
1-½ Tablespoon Palm Sugar, Or Light Brown Sugar
1 whole Fish Sauce, Good Quality
1 whole Thai Chili Pepper, Lightly Smashed
½ cups FOR THE COLESLAW:
¼ cups Carrot, Julienned
½ whole Fresh Cilantro, Chopped
1 whole Fresh Mint, Chopped
1 whole Red Bell Pepper, Julienned
1 cup Head Of Radicchio Lettuce, Thinly Sliced
¼ cups Small Kohlrabi, Trimmed, Julienned
description: The thought of coleslaw turned into a Thai version. This one will have you rethinking your classic slaw and begging for more.

name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwiches With Pickled Jalapenos & Coleslaw
ingredients:
2  FOR THE CHICKEN:
½ cups Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts, Cooked And Shredded
½ cups BBQ Sauce
1 cup Onion, Diced
1 Tablespoon FOR THE COLESLAW:
1 Tablespoon Nonfat Greek Yogurt
½ teaspoons Sugar
1 teaspoon Vinegar
2 cups Celery Salt & Celery Seed
3  Pepper
½ cups Cabbage, Shredded
4  Carrots, Thinly Sliced
½ cups Red Onion, Diced
description: A great way to use leftover chicken! Not just an everyday BBQ chicken sandwich, but so much more!

name: Triple Berry Sorbet
ingredients:
3 cups FOR THE SIMPLE SYRUP:
3 cups Sugar
4 cups Water
2 cups FOR THE SORBET:
2 cups Hulled Strawberries
½ cups Raspberries
½ cups Blueberries
4 cups Freshly Squeezed Lemon Juice
4 Tablespoons Light Corn Syrup
description: This is the perfect cold treat for a warm spring day.

name: Almond Pesto
ingredients:
1 cup Packed Basil Leaves
⅓ cups Raw Unsalted Almonds
1 clove Peeled Garlic
4 Tablespoons Shredded Parmesan Cheese
¼ cups Olive Oil
description: Pesto made with almonds instead of pine nuts.

name: White Bean Hummus with Lemon and Feta
ingredients:
1 can (about 15 Oz. Size) Cannellini Beans, Drained
3-⅝ ounces, weight Feta Cheese, Crumbled
1 clove Garlic (small)
1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice
3 Tablespoons Fresh Chives, Finely Chopped
description: White bean hummus with lemon and feta, a quick and easy dip that’s perfect for a picnic.

name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Stuffed Dates
ingredients:
¾ cups Goat Cheese
1 Tablespoon Minced Shallots
1 Tablespoon Fines Herbes (or Thyme)
¼ teaspoons Black Pepper
24 whole Pitted Dates
6 slices Prosciutto
description: These little treats feature layers of indulgent flavors with a surprising hint of sweetness.

name: Irish Rye Bread
ingredients:
2 cups All-purpose Flour, Plus More For Dusting
¾ teaspoons Baking Soda
½ teaspoons Salt
1 Tablespoon Caraway Seeds
1 cup Milk
2 Tablespoons Butter, Melted
description: I love making this bread. It’s so simple and you don’t have to wait for it to rise!

name: Rum and Raisin French Toast
ingredients:
¾ cups Raisins
¼ cups Gold Rum
⅓ cups Hot Water
1 cup Spreadable Light Cream Cheese
1 teaspoon Maple Extract
1 teaspoon White Sugar Or To Tase
5 whole Eggs
¼ cups Milk
8 slices White Bread
description: Show mom how much you care!

name: Banana Ice Cream 2 Ways
ingredients:
4 whole Ripe Bananas, Frozen
2 Tablespoons Peanut Butter (optional)
2 Tablespoons Nutella (optional)
description: 1 ingredient, maybe 2. Seriously. And vegan!

name: Dark Chocolate Cherry Brownie Bites
ingredients:
4  Large Eggs
1 cup Sugar, Sifted
1 cup Brown Sugar, Sifted
8 ounces, weight Melted Butter
1-¼ cup Cocoa, Sifted
2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract
½ cups Flour, Sifted
½ teaspoons Kosher Salt
1 cup Dried Cherries
description: Ooey, gooey brownies with bits of sweet and sour cherries, all in one bite!

name: Aunt Pat’s Famous Cream Puff Recipe
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE CREAM PUFF SHELLS:
½ cups Water
1 cup Butter
4  Flour
4  Eggs
¾ cups FOR THE CUSTARD CREAM FILLING:
⅓ cups Egg Yolks, Beaten
½ teaspoons Sugar
2 cups Flour
2 teaspoons Salt
1 pint Milk
description: This began as a cute little recipe clipping titled ‘Ingrid’s Austrian Cream Puffs’ which ran in our local newspaper. My Aunt cut out the recipe and has been making these for our family ever since. Impressive and deceptively easy to make. Homemade custard with whipped cream these are a creamy-crunchy delight in every bite.

name: Baked Potato Croquettes
ingredients:
3 cups Leftover Mashed Potatoes
⅓ cups Grated Pecorino Romano Cheese
3 Tablespoons Flat-leaf Parsley, Chopped
1 whole Salt And Pepper, to taste
¼ cups Egg
1 pinch Panko Bread Crumbs
description: This is a healthier version of the croquettes you know and love. Using leftover mashed potatoes they go together in a snap.

name: Very Berry Streusel Bundt Cake
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE STREUSEL:
¼ cups All-purpose Flour
¼ cups Sugar
1 pinch Light Brown Sugar
1 dash Salt
1 stick Cinnamon
2 cups Unsalted Butter, Chilled And Cut Into 1" Pieces
1 teaspoon FOR THE CAKE:
1 teaspoon All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
1 stick Baking Soda
1 cup Salt
2 whole Unsalted Butter, At Room Temperature
1 teaspoon Sugar
1 cup Eggs
2 whole Vanilla
1 cup Sour Cream
1 cup Lemons, Zested
description: Layers of fresh blueberries and strawberries along with a swirl of streusel make this bundt something special.

name: Kale and Chickpeas
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil, Plus More To Serve
1 whole Onion, Sliced Into Strips
5 cloves Garlic, Minced
2 cans (15 1/2 Oz. Size) Chickpeas
1-½ teaspoon Crushed Red Pepper, Divided
1-½ teaspoon Turmeric, Divided
1-½ teaspoon Cumin, Divided
1-½ teaspoon Paprika, Divided
2 cups Vegetable Or Chicken Broth
1 pound Kale
description: A deliciously addictive dish for the omnivore or vegetarian! So simply fantastic you won’t even realize it’s kinda healthy.

name: Hummus Chicken
ingredients:
10  Baby Carrots Chopped
½  Medium Onion, Diced
1 cup Fresh Or Frozen Broccoli
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
4 pieces Boneless, Skinless Chicken Tenderloins
1 cup Hummus
1 whole Lemon
½ teaspoons Paprika Or Sumac
description: A quick, healthy dinner! Try different flavors of hummus to try new combinations!

name: Sophia Loren’s Spaghetti al Limone
ingredients:
1-½ pound Spaghetti
3 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter
2 cloves Garlic, Sliced
3  Lemons, Zested
½ cups Heavy Cream, divided
½ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Pepper
description: Sophia Loren’s delicious Spaghetti al Limone.

name: Italian Sausage & Mushroom Skillet Lasagna
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil, Divided
1 pound Spicy Italian Sausage
2 cups Sliced Crimini Mushroom
1 cup Diced White Onions
¼ cups Chopped Scallions
1 Tablespoon Minced Garlic
¼ teaspoons Fennel Seeds
½ teaspoons Red Pepper Flakes
2 Tablespoons Tomato Paste
3 cans (16 Oz. Size) San Marzano Tomatoes
10 ounces, weight Dried Lasagna Noodles (about 2/3 Of A Regular Sized Box)
1-½ cup Chicken Or Vegetable Stock
½ cups Grated Parmesan Cheese
6 ounces, weight Kosher Salt And Black Pepper
½ cups Fresh Mozzarella Cheese, Thinly Sliced
description: Italian Sausage & Mushroom Skillet Lasagna—one-pot meals never tasted so good!

name: Vegetarian Chickpea Tacos
ingredients:
1  Onion, Diced Finely
¼ cups Olive Oil, Divided
3 cloves Garlic, Finely Chopped
3 cups Chickpeas, Soaked/cooked Or Canned And Rinsed
3 teaspoons Paprika (any Variety Or Combination)
2 teaspoons Salt
2 teaspoons Garlic Powder
2 teaspoons Cumin Powder
1 teaspoon Cayenne Pepper
¾ cups To 1 Cup Water, As Needed
2  Medium Sized Tomatoes, Chopped
1 can (15 Oz. Size) Red Beans
description: This recipe uses chickpeas and beans as a base while still having all the spice and goodness of typical ground meat tacos! Serve in warm tortillas with your favorite taco toppings!

name: Zero-Calorie Sweet Mint Tea
ingredients:
2 quarts Water, Divided
¼ cups Fresh Mint Leaves, Washed And Dried
4 whole Iced Tea Bags (6.4 Grams Each)
1 Tablespoon Stevia Powder
description: This is the tea summer memories are made of!

name: Whiskey Peach Tea
ingredients:
1 ounce, fluid Crown Royal Whiskey
½ ounces, fluid Silver Tequila
½ ounces, fluid Gin
¼ ounces, fluid Peach Syrup (I Used White Peach Monin Syrup)
¼ ounces, fluid Peach Schnapps
2 ounces, fluid Sour Or Margarita Mix
1 slice Orange
description: A twist on the classic Long Island Ice Tea, this cocktail is perfect for a relaxing afternoon. Recipe makes 1 or 2 cocktails, depending on the size of the glass.

name: Fudgy Oreo Pops
ingredients:
1 package (4-serving Size) Instant Chocolate Pudding Mix
2 cups Cold Milk
1 cup Whipped Topping (thawed)
8  Oreo Cookies, Crushed
description: These chocolatey, cookie-filled frozen pops are a must for the summer. Easy to make and easy on the pocket book too! So good!

name: BLT Soup
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons FOR THE SOUP:
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 whole Unsalted Butter
2 stalks Yellow Onion, Diced
3 whole Celery, Diced
4 cloves Carrots, Peeled And Diced
56 ounces, fluid Garlic, Minced
5 cups Canned, Whole And Peeled Tomatoes With Juice
2 Tablespoons Chicken Stock
1 Tablespoon Fresh Basil, Chopped
1 Tablespoon Fresh Thyme, Chopped
1-½ teaspoon Fresh Oregano, Chopped
1 teaspoon Salt
½ cups Pepper
1 Tablespoon Heavy Cream
2 Tablespoons FOR THE CROUTONS:
1 loaf Unsalted Butter, melted
½ teaspoons Olive Oil
¼ teaspoons Day Old Bread, Cut Into 1/2 Inch Cubes
6 strips Salt
1 cup Pepper
1 cup FOR THE BACON:
½ cups Thick Cut Bacon, Diced
1-¾ cup FOR THE PESTO:
3 Tablespoons Fresh Arugula
½ teaspoons Fresh Spinach
¼ teaspoons Fresh Basil
¾ cups Parmesan Cheese, Finely Grated
description: All of your favorites in a BLT sandwich, but in the form of a soup!

name: Homemade Chocolate Peanut Butter “Larabars”
ingredients:
½ cups Unsalted Roasted Peanuts (50% Less Salt Roasted Is Fine As Well)
1 pound (1 Pound Is About 30) Medjool Dates, Pitted
1 Tablespoon Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
1 teaspoon Coconut Oil
1 teaspoon Peanut Butter
½ cups Dark Chocolate Chips (semi Sweet Is Fine Too)
description: I don’t know if your husband is anything like my husband, but if he could, he would bankrupt us with his love of the Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Larabars. So an idea was born. I’m going to replicate that yummy recipe and make them (with love) for him to snack on whenever he wants (for a way better price)!

name: Black Grape Salad
ingredients:
4 pounds Black Seedless Grapes
8 ounces, weight Cream Cheese, Softened
8 ounces, weight Sour Cream
¼ cups Sugar
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
½ cups Brown Sugar
4 ounces, weight Chopped Walnuts
description: This is a super-simple, scrumptious cold salad that is a huge hit on a hot summer day!

name: French Brie Grilled Cheese Sandwich
ingredients:
2 slices Good Quality Panini Bread
4 slices Butter As Needed To Coat One Side Of Each Piece Of Bread
⅓ cups Brie Cheese
6 whole Mozzarella, Shredded
1 teaspoon Grape Tomatoes, Halved
description: Bringing grilled cheese to a new level.

name: Berry Lust Smoothie
ingredients:
2 cups Organic Strawberries, Fresh, Hulled
⅔ cups Organic Blueberries, Fresh
⅔ cups Organic Raspberries, Fresh
⅔ cups Organic Blackberries, Fresh
2 whole Organic Bananas, Peeled
3 cups Coconut Water
4 teaspoons Bee Pollen
description: Antioxidants, phyto-nutrients, and electrolytes all come together to create this beauty-boosting, delicious smoothie!

name: Jalapeño Popper Pizza
ingredients:
3-¾ cups FOR THE PIZZA DOUGH
2-½ teaspoons Bread Flour
¾ teaspoons Active Dry Yeast
¾ teaspoons Table Salt
1-⅓ cup Sugar
1 whole Room Temperature Water
6 ounces, weight FOR THE PIZZA:
½ cups Pizza Dough, Shaped Into Your Desired Circumference And Thickness
1 cup Cream Cheese, Room Temperature
2 whole Shredded Cheddar Cheese
1 whole Shredded Mozzarella Cheese
description: Everything you want and expect in a great jalapeño popper, but turned into a pizza.

description: Most hummus recipes call for canned garbanzo beans and tahini from a jar. I find the best hummus is made from dried chickpea (which is also cheaper) and brown sesame seeds (tahini is ground sesame seed paste). My recipe is radically adapted from Jerusalem, which happens to have won the IACP cookbook of the year award at the same time I won an award. Yotam Ottolenghi’s book is gorgeous and his hummus recipe uses dried chickpeas but he uses tahini in his recipe. I find brown sesame seeds more economical as I buy it in bulk (and apparently it’s healthier too), but keep in mind that the final hummus won’t be as silky smooth as one made with tahini. I like my hummus a little more rustic and homemade but if you really want a super smooth hummus, use 1 cup of tahini and leave out the sesame seeds, sesame oil and olive oil.
ingredients:
1 1/4 cups (250 g) dried chickpeas
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
6 1/2 cups tap water
2 cups (310 g) whole brown sesame seeds
1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil
1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
1/4 cup lemon juice

description: I’ve shared a recipe for strawberry shortcake right when I started this blog, but it’s a classic dessert that deserves a revisit. This version adds a touch of tart lemon in the shortcake, inspired by the lemon bundt cake that Suzanne also made, giving a nice balance to the fruity strawberries. A touch of balsamic vinegar gives a nice acidity and makes the strawberries taste extra sweet. By the way, the extra step of hand tearing the strawberries is important, because when you slice them up, they tend to get slippery. Breaking them apart with your fingers means the torn strawberry piece sit in the whipped cream as opposed to sliding all over the place. Just make sure to wear an apron or a dark shirt as strawberry juice might squirt all over the place!

description: Think of these toaster pastries like Pop Tarts meets Gingerbread Houses. Deep with molasses and ginger bite, the autumn winter fruit of pears filling makes these pastries totally suitable for breakfast, after popping them in the toaster/toaster oven for 5 minutes or after dinner for dessert with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Sherry Yard’s original recipe called for a simple peach filling, and a different ratio of ingredients for the dough, using just all-purpose flour. I swapped it out some of the all-purpose for white whole wheat flour (an albino version of wheat) for nuttiness as well as teff flour for the malty flavor. Both of them add extra nutrients that you don’t get for all-purpose flour, meaning I can totally self justify eating a pastry for breakfast. Feel free to substitute 455 g (3 1/4 cups) of all-purpose flour total for the flours and cornstarch though, if you don’t have either specialty flour in the house.

description: Once I got home from Columbus, it took me a few weeks to adjust to eating normal amounts of food. In the meanwhile I decided I needed to make some cinnamon rolls, inspired by Omega Artisan Bakery. Of course, normal cinnamon rolls are a bit time consuming because you have to wait for them to rise with yeast. So I adapted a recipe using baking powder and baking soda. Way easier and much faster. Don’t expect these cinnamon rolls to be the same as a regular yeast-risen cinnamon roll, these are closer to a biscuit in texture. I could come up with a cutesy story of how this recipe uses white chocolate and dark chocolate, symbolizing interracial marriage, a legal issue that same sex marriage is often compared to. But even I’m not that tacky (white and dark chocolate? I think that might border on racist). Heck, I could even stretch the already thread thin metaphor and say the addition of the blood orange is me throwing some fruit into the mix, and we all know that fruit is slang for homosexual. But I’m not going to pander to you. These cookies are damn good cookies. They have nothing to do with what I wrote above. Enjoy them or not. Partly it’s because he’s been trying to eat less processed food, partly he’s found that the breakfast cereals out there (including the pre-packaged granola that we’ve found) is too sweet. description: The secret to making a punchy flavored Frappucino like iced blended drink (my partner AJ refers to them as work friendly adult Slurpees) is to first make a “syrup” of hot coffee, white chocolate, brown sugar and spices before adding it to the milk and ice. The hot coffee (double strength brewed – be sure to add twice the amount of coffee that you would normally use as it get diluted in the blending) melts the white chocolate and brown sugar and blooms the spices, helping to bring out the flavor, which is key as cold always dulls flavors. I use less sugar than you would get in a Starbucks Frappuccino because I always felt they were too sweet for me, but feel free to add an extra tablespoon or more of sugar if you prefer it that way. I use two tablespoons of pumpkin puree in this drink, which, of course, means you will have practically a whole can left. Measure out tablespoons of the pumpkin puree and place each tablespoon in the cavity of an ice cube tray. Freeze overnight and then empty the pumpkin cubes into a ziplock bag. Now you have instant, measurable pumpkin cubes to make more ice blended drinks! In the future, don’t even bother to defrost, just toss in the blender.
ingredients:
1/2 cup fresh brewed hot double strength brewed coffee
3 heaping tablespoons (50 gram) chopped white chocolate or white chocolate chips
2 tablespoon (25 g) dark brown sugar
1 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
2 tablespoons of canned pumpkin puree (not pumpkin pie filling)
1 standard tray of ice cubes
1/2 cup whole milk (feel free to use whatever milk you want, but I just like whole)
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
1/2 cup heavy whipping cream
1 tablespoon confectioners’ (powdered) sugar
ground cinnamon for garnish
name: White Mocha Pumpkin “Frappuccino” Iced Blended Drink (naturally gluten free)

two generous pinches of red Hawaiian sea salt (or other sea salt)
180 g (1 1/2 cups) macadamia nuts, chopped
1 tablespoon macadamia honey (or other honey)
1 large egg white plus 1 tablespoon water
name: Hawaiian style sweet potato pie, featuring American Orange Yams and Okinawa Purple Sweet potato with Macadamia Nut

description:
The reason this pie is called “Double Butterscotch” is because of the butterscotch pie crust AND butterscotch filling for the apples. There is some prep time for making the pie crust, as you need to first make the brown butter and then let it chill for an hour to solidify. Then, after you make the crust, you have to let the crust dough chill another hour for the flours to hydrate. Plan accordingly. Keep in mind that this pie uses a lot of butter and is really rich – in a good way. Trust me on the crust though, it’s crispy, flaky, flavorful and fantastic. I want to say that you’re friends will never know it’s gluten free, but that does it a disservice. I think it might be BETTER than some of my other gluten-full pie crusts.
This being the Gluten Free Ratio Rally, the ratio for pie dough is as follows: Flour:3 Fat:2 Water:1 or Flour 100% Fat 66% Water 33% in baking percentages. Easy as 3, 2, 1. If you can eat gluten, you can, of course, skip all the gluten free flours (including the almond meal, teff and flax meal) and just use 450 g all purpose flour (about 3 cups and 2 tablespoons). But keep in mind, your pie crust isn’t going to be as tasty as if you were to use the alternative flours, specifically the almond flour and the teff flour. You may note that the recipe looks like it deviates a little bit from the 3-2-1 ratio. that’s because when I made the brown butter, a little bit of the water evaporated and was absorbed by both the brown sugar and the flax meal I added. So I added extra cold butter at the final blending of the pie crust dough to accomodate for this.
ingredients:
300 g (1 cup + 5 tablespoons) unsalted butter at room temperature
60 g (1/4 cup) dark brown sugar
1/2 teaspoon salt
20 g (2 tablespoons) flax meal
140 g (1 cup) glutinous (sometimes called sweet) rice flour
105 g (3/4 cup + 1 tablespoon) superfine white rice flour
100 g (1/2 cup + 1 tablespoon) teff flour
70 g (1/4 cup + 3 tablespoons) superfine brown rice flour
35 g (1/4 cup) almond meal (or almond flour)
60 g (4 tablespoons) unsalted butter, cold
150 ml (2/3 cup) cold water
7 medium apples (try to get a mix of tart firm ones like Granny Smiths and softer sweet ones like Macintosh or Rome)
1 tablespoon lemon juice (1/2 a medium lemon)
85 g (6 tablespoons or 3/4 stick) butter
180 g (3/4 cup) dark brown sugar
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
1/2 teaspoon almond extract
1/4 cup tapioca flour (sometimes called tapioca starch)
1 teaspoon cinnamon
1 egg yolk for egg wash
2 tablespoon turbinado sugar (sugar in the raw) or white granulated sugar for topping
name: Gluten Free Double Butterscotch Apple Pie

description: The addition of a fruity big red wine to this pie adds a hidden depth and complexity that you wouldn’t otherwise get. Don’t be fooled by the name though, as most of the alcohol has burnt off after the pie had baked. Crust adapted from More Best Recipes (America’s Test Kitchen) by the Editor’s of Cook Illustrated.
ingredients:
155 g (1 cup) whole wheat flour
225 (1 1/2 cups) of all purpose flour
25 g (2 tablespoons) white sugar
1 teaspoon salt
285 g (1 1/4 cups or 2 1/2 stick) of cold unsalted butter, cut into 1/4″ cubes
1/4 cup of cold vodka
1/4 cup of cold ice water
3 cups of sweet bing cherries
3 cups blueberries
1/2 cup red wine (pick something big and juicy)
35 g (1/4 cup) cornstarch
200 g (1 cup) white sugar
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/4 teaspoon almond extract
zest of a medium lemon
1 large egg, separated for wash
granulated white sugar to sprinkle on top
name: Boozy Blueberry Cherry Red Wine Pie

description: A creamy sweet and slightly tart pie with a crumb topping, the addition of blueberries and tequila add a subtle kick to the filling that elevates this pie to the sublime. This recipe uses fresh peaches and fresh blueberries. If you want, you can use frozen blueberries and canned peaches for that true authentic midwest flavor. Just be sure to thaw the blueberries by running them under a faucet running warm water, until the water runs clear, and to dry them by pour them on a sheet pan lined with two layers of paper towels. Shake until dry. You might want to also add an extra tablespoon of cornstarch to accommodate the moisture from the canned peaches.
ingredients:
230 g (1 1/2 cups) All Purpose Flour
150 g (1/2 cup + 3 tablespoons) refrigerator cold salted butter
2 tablespoon ice cold water
2 tablespoon ice cold tequila
1 large egg plus 2 tablespoon of water
2 1/2 lbs (about 6 medium) peaches8 oz (1 1/2) cups blueberries1 tablespoons fresh squeezed lemon juice3/4 cup sour cream (full fat)2 tablespoon tequila1/2 cup brown sugar2 tablespoon honey1/2 teaspoon almond extract4 tablespoons cornstarch2 large eggs1 vanilla bean

3/4 cup sour cream (full fat)

4 tablespoons cornstarch
2 large eggs
1 vanilla bean

60 g (1/4 cup) turbinado sugar (brand name “Sugar in the Raw”)
50 g (1/3 cup) all purpose flour
1 tablespoon cinnamon
4 tablespoon salted butter
name: Blueberry Peaches & Dreams Pie

description: I use potato starch as the filler for this pie, as it doesn’t cloud up the filling as much as cornstarch, but if you don’t have any potato starch, feel free to substitute cornstarch at a 1:1 ratio. There are minimum spices in this pie, to allow for the berry flavor to come through. What’s extra awesome about this pie is that it’s pretty darn easy to make. The berry filling doesn’t require much prep work, and the crust has only four ingredients, meaning you have time to make it and then time to go and spank someone.
ingredients:
455 g (3 cups + 3 tablespoons) all purpose flour
300 g (1 cup + 5 tablespoons) salted butter, refrigerator cold
1/3 cup vodka
1/3 cup ice cold water
340 g (12 oz or 2 1/2 cups) blackberries
510 g (18 oz or 3 1/2 cups) blueberries
200 g (1 cup) granulated white sugar
45 g (3 tablespoons) potato starch (not potato flour)
zest of 1 medium orange (~1 tablespoon)
1/4 teaspoon all spice
1/8 teaspoon (a generous pinch) nutmeg
1 large egg, separated into yolk and white for wash
1 to 2 tablespoons of extra sugar for sprinkling on top
name: Black and Blue (Berry) Pie

description: A tropical twist on the old-fashioned oatmeal raisin cookie, the longer you soak the fruit in the rum, the more kick they give it. I let them soak for about an hour, but if I were to do it again, I’d probably let them soak overnight. I know my new friends would probably appreciate that as much as I would.
ingredients:
170 g (1 1/2 cups) dried tropical fruit mix (dried papaya, pineapple, raisins, dried mango or whatever you want to use)
1/2 dark rum
250 g (3 cups) quick cook oats
150 g (1 cup) all purpose flour
75 g (1/2 cup) whole wheat flour
1 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 cup melted coconut oil
175 g (1 cup) brown sugar
200 g (1 cup) white sugar
2 large eggs
1 vanilla bean
name: Rum Soa

description: Crispy and sweet with a number of spices to invoke the holidays, these snappy cinnamon rolled cookies have a buttermilk glaze to mimic a cream cheese frosting that cinnamon buns usually have. I like to add more spices to the mix, to give complexity to the cookie, but feel free to keep it classic and just use cinnamon by itself. Keep in mind that you have to refrigerate the dough for half an hour before slicing them to bake, so schedule that in. Or just make them the day before and keep them in the fridge overnight, making them a snap for fresh baked cookies the following day.
ingredients:
225 g (1 cup or 2 sticks) of unsalted butter, cold
75 g (1/3 cup) white granulated sugar
85 g (3/4 cup) confectioners’ (powdered) sugar, sifted
1/2 teaspoon sea salt
1 1/2 teaspoon orange zest (about 1 medium navel orange)

60g to 90 g (1/2 to 3/4 cup) confectioners’ (powdered) sugar, sifted
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 teaspoon buttermilk
name: Snappy Cinnamon Spice Bun Cookies with Honey Buttermilk Glaze

description: These cookies smell of wintertime and the holidays with their aromatic spices. Baked apple chips can be found at health food stores and upscale grocery stores like Whole Foods. Don’t be put off by the list of ingredients. It’s a fairly straightforward recipe, and if you don’t have some of the spices, just substitute other spices like cloves, allspice, cardamom or whatever you have on hand. As with all “gluten free ratio rally” recipes, feel free to substitute whatever flour you want. I just used the ones that I thought would compliment the apple spice flavor.
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups apple juice
60 g (1 cup) baked apple chips, crushed to 1/4 inch pieces
1 tablespoon ground flax meal
140 g (1/2 cup + 2 tablespoons) unsalted butter
3 fresh bay leaves
100 g (1/2 cup + 3 tablespoons) sweet rice flour

140 g (1/2 cup + 2 tablespoons) dark brown sugar
150 g (3/4 cup) granulated white sugar, divided
1 large egg
2 teaspoon vanilla extract
name: Apple Brown Butter Bay Leaf Spice Cookies

description: You’ll notice that the filling of this cobbler has a touch of honey and that’s it. If your fruit isn’t as sweet, feel free to add a little more honey, but having less sweetener means the fruit flavors can shine more.
ingredients:
5 lbs of summer stone fruit (plums, pluots, apricots, peaches, nectarines, whatever you want)
1 1/2 cups white wine

1/4 cup honey
2 tablespoons lemon juice

plus extras sugar to sprinkle on top
1. Preheat the oven to 425˚F and spray a 9” x 13” glass or ceramic baking dish with a neutral flavored cooking spray.
name: Late Summer Stone Fruit Cobbler, with Plums, Pluots and Peaches

description: This recipe is produces nice soft and slightly crumbly cookie, with lots of lemon zip to it. The caramelize cornflakes and poppyseeds give the chunky cookies a surprise crunch and texture, while the cornmeal and quinoa work together to give the cookie a little earthy depth. You definitely don’t need to be gluten free to enjoy these treats.
ingredients:
60 g (1 cup) cornflakes
15 g (2 tablespoons) nonfat instant dry milk powder
15 g (1 tablespoon) granulated white sugar
3 g (1/2 teaspoon) sea salt
42g (3 tablespoons) unsalted butter

name: Caramelized Cornflake Lemon Poppyseed Cookies, gluten free

description: While the original pistachio chocolate chip cookie that Pistacia Vera had is probably fantastic, I wanted to give a different spin on the cookie, by grinding the pistachios into a rough paste, and blending in a little melted sweet creamy white chocolate into the batter. Try to find roasted unsalted pistachios (Trader Joe’s is a good source for them) but if you only can find the salted type, reduce the sea salt in the recipe to 1/4 teaspoon. Make sure to use a quality dark chocolate to counterbalance the sweetness, one that is at least 65% cacao. I like to chop a chocolate bar into chunks to get the irregular pieces and small slivers of chocolate that melt into the batter but feel free to us chocolate chips if you want to skip the chopping.
ingredients:
45 g (1/4 cup) white chocolate chopped into 1/4th inch chunks
2 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil or pistachio oil (if you have it)
120 g (1 cup) shelled roasted unsalted pistachios

180 g (6 oz or 1 cup) bittersweet chocolate chopped into 1/4 inch chunks
name: White Chocolate Pistachio Dark Chocolate Chunk Cookies

description:
My take on the classic black and white checkerboard cookie requires a few specialty items like freeze dried strawberries, black onyx cocoa powder and sumac. I crush the freeze-dried strawberries into powder with a mortar and pestle, but you can place them in a Ziploc bag and crush them with a rolling pin. Freeze-dried strawberries can be found at upscale supermarkets like Whole Foods or specialty markets like Trader Joe’s. Black onyx cocoa powder give the dark squares an extra dark punch to them, and can be found online and at specialty baking stores. Feel free to use the same amount of natural cocoa powder in it’s place if you don’t have black onyx cocoa and don’t feel like buying an extra specialty item, just don’t expect the dark squares to be as black. Finally I use ground sumac, which is a spice often used in Mediterranean food. You can find it in International/Middle Eastern grocery stores or you can just substitute the same amount of lemon zest in its place.
Take note in preparation, because of the nature of this cookie, there is a lot of refrigerate chilling between steps to firm up the dough.Adapted from a recipe from Cookies: At Home with the Culinary Institute of America by Todd Knaster
ingredients:
226 g (1 cup or 2 sticks) unsalted butter
115 g (1 cup) confectioners’ sugar
70 g (1/3 cup) granulated white sugar
1 teaspoon sea salt
14 g (2 tablespoon) freeze dried strawberry powder
1 teaspoon ground sumac or lemon zest
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
1/2 vanilla bean
1 egg350 g (2 1/2 cups) all purpose flour
350 g (2 1/2 cups) all purpose flour
226 g (1 cup or 2 sticks) unsalted butter

225 g (1/4 cup) natural cocoa powder
10 g (1 tablespoon) instant coffee
1 teaspoon freshly ground fine black pepper
recipeYield: 60 checkerboard cookies and 12 marbled zebra cookies
name: Strawberry Black Pepper Chocolate Checkerboard Cookies

description: This is one of those tarts that you can make ahead of time for a special dinner, especially since it needs a chill in the fridge overnight to set. It makes a sparkly presentation and is perfect for the wintertime when you want something bright and beautiful but are a little tired of citrus. The tart sweet pomegranate molasses works beautifully with the dark chocolate filling, and the crunch of the pomegranate seeds give a nice texture to tart. If you can locate it, just use 1/2 cup of purchased pomegranate molasses, or make your own (the recipe is below).
ingredients:
140 g (1 cups) all purpose flour
55 g (1/4 cup + 1 tablespoons) teff flour
25 g (1/4 cup) Dutch-processed cocoa powder
50 g (1/4 cup) granulated sugar
115 g (4 oz or 1 stick) unsalted butter, cold

description: You’ll notice that my chocolate cones are ultra black in color. That’s because I used black onyx cocoa which is a special Dutch-processed cocoa. It’s what makes Oreo cookies look so dark. If you can’t get black cocoa, the cones will be fine with either natural cocoa or dutch processed. Just make sure the cocoa is unsweetened.
ingredients:
60 g (1/2 cup) cake flour
18 g (2 tablespoons) black onyx cocoa powder (see note above)
60 g (4 tablespoons) unsalted butter at room temperature
120 g (1 cup) confectioners’ sugar, sifted
90 g (3 large) egg whites at room temperature
sprinkles or slivered almonds as decoration (optional)
name: Homemade Mini Chocolate Ice Cream Cones

description: These cookies have NOTHING to do with Chips Ahoy, other than the name. They are dense, chewy, soft, stuffed full of dark chocolate and complex with a huge amount of butterscotch undertones. I developed these to bypass the long curing process that my other chocolate chip cookies dough needs. In fact the first batch of cookies can be done in less than an hour. These aren’t better than those cookies, they’re just different (and equally good).
ingredients:
240 g (1 3/4 cup) all purpose flour
240 g (1 3/4 cup) white whole wheat flour (an albino varietal of whole wheat that is milder in flavor but equally nutritious)

2 1/2 stick of unsalted butter

2 large eggs
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
1 lb bittersweet chocolate, chopped into 1/4 inch pieces
sea salt for top of cookie
name: Not Your Average Chips Ahoy Chocolate Chip Cookie (brown butter chocolate chip cookies)

description: I had a number of gluten sensitive friends coming to my party so I baked half of my desserts gluten free and half of them with regular all purpose flour. If you don’t have any gluten issues, omit the chia seeds (which act as a gluten binder replacement) and feel free to substitute 175 g (1 1/4 cup) all purpose flour for all the gluten free flours and starches. However, keep in mind that some of the flours (specifically the teff and mesquite flours) work really well with chocolate. If you really want to make these cookies extraordinary, track down those flours (they are often available at specialty grocery stores like Whole Foods, ethnic grocery stores and online) and use them as specified and just substitute 105 g (3/4 cup) all purpose flour for the remaining gluten free flours and starches. Trust me, you won’t be disappointed with the results.
ingredients:
10 g (1 tablespoon) chia seeds
1/3 cup whole milk
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 tablespoons Kirschwasser liquor
225 g (8 oz) of quality bittersweet chocolate, chopped into 1/2 inch pieces
75 g (1/2 cup) unsweetened dutch-processed cocoa powder

1 cup granulated white sugar
1 cup confectioners’ sugar (powdered sugar)
name: Black Forest Chocolate Crinkle Cookies (gluten free)

description: These cookies get a boost of Dr. Seuss-ian like whimsy with the addition of the red food coloring and shiny white egg glaze. You can omit the food coloring if you like but expect the blackberry cookie part to look a dull (not really attractive) gray-purple color. To get the extra black color in the chocolate stripes, I used onyx black cocoa powder. You can find it a specialty supply stores or online. If you don’t have access to it though, feel free to substitute the same amount of dutch-processed cocoa powder. Don’t omit the white glaze though, because they not only make the cookies look surreal and shiny but also helps the sparkling sugar stick to the top of the cookie, giving them an extra sugary crunch with each bite. If you don’t have sparkling sugar (which are extra large sugar crystals) just substitute regular granulated white sugar.

130 g (1 cup) blackberries (frozen is ok)
90 g (1/3 cup plus 1 tablespoon) granulated white sugar, divided
226 g (8 oz or 2 sticks) unsalted butter at room temperature

1 teaspoon salt
1/2 vanilla bean
1 egg
1/2 teaspoon red food coloring
385 g (2 3/4 cup) all purpose flour
226 g (8 oz or 2 sticks) unsalted butter at room temperature
115 g (1 cup) confectioners’ (powdered) sugar

1/2 vanilla bean
1 egg
1 teaspoon peppermint extract
280 g (2 cup) all purpose flour
25 g (1/4 cup) natural cocoa powder
35 g (1/4 cup) onyx black cocoa powder
10 g (1 tablespoon) instant coffee
1 large egg white
1 tablespoon of water
1/4 cup sparkling white sugar crystals
name: Blackberry Peppermint Chocolate Striped Cookies

description: This recipe is adapted from David Leite’s award winning New York Times article about Perfection and Chocolate Chip Cookies. As usual, I tinkered with the recipe, and in a rare move, actually SIMPLIFIED it. I made it the way David wrote it and compared it with my simplified version and they were pretty identical, except mine has less ingredients. But if you want to try his original recipe to compare, by all means, check it out. Either way, you won’t be disappointed.
ingredients:
3 1/4 cups (480 g) all purpose unbleached flour
1 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
1 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
2 large eggs

pinch of salt
