description: "This fruit salad has people very skeptical at first, but once you try it you'll love it! This is a judgement recipe; there's no right or wrong. Add other fruits as you please, just be careful with the mayo; you want it to taste of it barely."

name: Tuna Mac
ingredients:
6 cups water
1 (7.25 ounce) package macaroni and cheese dinner mix
1/4 cup margarine, cut into pieces
1/4 cup milk
1 (6 ounce) can tuna, drained and flaked
1 (4.5 ounce) can sliced mushrooms, drained
1 cup bread crumbs
description: "An easy casserole using mac-n-cheese from a box with a can of tuna, mushrooms, and bread crumbs on top."

name: Velveeta® Salsa Mac and Cheese
ingredients:
1 pound ground round
1 teaspoon minced garlic
1 (16 ounce) jar chunky salsa
2 cups water
1 (7 ounce) package elbow macaroni
12 ounces processed cheese food (such as Velveeta®), cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks
description: "A QUICK family favorite and so tasty! Adjust the overall heat of the dish by choosing milder (or hotter) salsa."

name: Very Yummy Croutons
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups butter, melted
8 slices bread with crusts removed, cut into cubes
2 teaspoons garlic salt
description: "Delicious croutons, my family ate them all before I made the salad!"

name: Wild Pina Colada Green Smoothie
ingredients:
4 cups fresh diced pineapple
2 cups coconut water
2 cups ice cubes
1 cup chopped dandelion greens
1/2 cup shredded unsweetened coconut
1/4 cup cashews
1/4 cup chopped pitted dates, or more to taste
description: "In this raw vegan pina colada smoothie, the bitterness of the dandelion greens comes in very handy, and seems to make this smoothie taste like it has alcohol in it. I promise all of the ingredients come together in exactly the right quantities that you would swear this little concoction had a nip of rum in it and you were laying at a beach resort! Trust me, this green smoothie puts the 'dandy' back in the lion. It is TO DIE FOR!"

name: Yule Salad Topping
ingredients:
1 cup sour cream
1 cup mayonnaise
description: "This is to go on gelatin salads. Happy Yule!"

name: Coconut Balls
ingredients:
6 cups Coconut - Flaked, Shredded, Or Desicated
1 cup Icing Sugar
1 can (14 Oz. Can) Sweetened Condensed Milk
½ cups Coconut Oil, Melted
2 cups Melted Milk Chocolate Dipping Wafers Or  Squares For Dipping
description: Easy and delicious chocolate covered coconut balls.

name: Cranberry Almond Coconut Quinoa Cookies
ingredients:
1-½ cup Whole Wheat Pastry Flour
¼ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Baking Soda
¼ cups Unsweetened Applesauce
¼ cups Vanilla Greek Yogurt
¼ cups Brown Sugar
¼ cups Honey
2  Eggs
1-½ teaspoon Vanilla Extract
1 cup Cooked Quinoa, Cooled
1 cup Oats
¾ cups Dried Cranberries
½ cups Slivered Or Chopped Almonds
½ cups Chocolate Chips
½ cups Shredded Coconut
description: Made with quinoa, whole grains and oats, these healthy cookies are perfect to grab on-the-go!  Almonds, cranberries, chocolate chips and coconut add a subtle sweetness.  After one bite, your taste buds will be partying.

name: Dark Chocolate Strawberry Cupcake Tortes
ingredients:
½ cups FOR THE CUPCAKES:
¾ cups Water
5 ounces, weight Plus 2 Tablespoons, Granulated Sugar
7 ounces, weight Semi-sweet Chocolate
¾ cups Bittersweet Chocolate
5  Plus 2 Tablespoons Butter, Melted
1 teaspoon Eggs
16 ounces, fluid Vanilla Extract
1 pound FOR THE TORTES:
description: For those dark chocolate lovers out there, this is definitely a dessert that you need to try. I’ve never tasted anything like this cake recipe; it’s like biting into a soft chocolate bar. It is rich and full of dark chocolate flavor. Makes about 18 cupcakes.

name: Filipino Burger Steak
ingredients:
1 pound FOR THE BURGER PATTIES:
1 Tablespoon Ground Beef
1 whole Dijon Mustard
4 cloves Small Onion Chopped
1  Garlic, Minced
½ teaspoons Egg Beaten
¼ teaspoons Salt
2 Tablespoons Pepper
1 pound FOR THE MUSHROOM SAUCE:
⅓ cups Butter
1 quart Sliced Mushrooms
½ teaspoons Flour
description: Beef patties topped with creamy mushroom sauce.

name: Jalapeno Popper Cheese Bread
ingredients:
½ whole Loaf French Bread (from 1 Loaf Cut In Half Lengthwise)
4 ounces, weight Cream Cheese, Softened
½ cups Shredded Mozzarella
½ cups Shredded Medium Cheddar
1 whole Jalapeno, Stem Removed, Diced
1 Tablespoon Mayonnaise
description: Perfectly cheesy and perfectly spicy jalapeno popper cheese bread.

name: Jerk Chicken Salad and Avocado
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons FOR THE MARINADE:
2 Tablespoons Soy Sauce
2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar
1 Tablespoon Vegetable Oil
1 Tablespoon Molasses
2 teaspoons Vinegar
2 teaspoons Dried Thyme
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
1 teaspoon Nutmeg
1 teaspoon Ground Cloves
1 teaspoon Allspice
1 whole Ground Ginger
1 pound Jalapeno Pepper, Seeded And Finely Diced
½ cups Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts
½ cups FOR THE SALAD:
½ cups Mayonnaise
½ cups Red Pepper, Diced
2 Tablespoons Mango, Diced
4  Onion, Diced
description: A bright and tropical chicken salad served in a halved avocado. A flavor packed, light summertime meal.

name: Mini Peanut Butter Cup Brownie Bites
ingredients:
¼ cups Butter, Softened
¼ cups Nonfat Vanilla Yogurt
3 ounces, fluid Semi-sweet Bakers Chocolate
1 cup Sugar
1 teaspoon Vanilla
3  Eggs
1 cup Whole Wheat Pastry Flour
2 Tablespoons Cocoa Powder
½ cups Chocolate Chips
1 cup Mini Peanut Butter Cups (I Used Trader Joe's)
description: A tasty little brownie with mini peanut butter cups, that will keep portions in check.

name: Mini S’mores Ice Cream Sandwiches
ingredients:
1 pint Rocky Road Ice Cream
8 whole Sheets Of Graham Crackers, Break Each In Half Into 2 Squares
½ cups Marshmallow Creme
12 ounces, weight Semi-sweet Chocolate, Chopped
description: Instead of making a cake for your next summer outing, make ice cream sandwiches!

name: Mint Tea
ingredients:
2 bags (individual-size) Black Tea
1 cup Fresh Mint Leaves, Washed
3-½ cups Water, Boiling
2 cups Sugar
description: This recipe is a concentrate; keep it in the refrigerator and you can have refreshing tea whenever you want!

name: Paleo Maple-Cinnamon Granola
ingredients:
2 cups Raw Unsalted Sunflower Seeds
1-¾ cup Raw Unsalted Pumpkin Seeds
1-⅓ cup Golden Flaxseed Meal
1 cup Unhulled Sesame Seeds (or An Extra 1 Cup Sunflower Seeds)
⅔ cups Coconut Oil Or Ghee (Clarified Butter)
¾ cups Pure Maple Syrup
1 Tablespoon Pure Vanilla Extract
1 Tablespoon Ground Cinnamon
½ teaspoons Sea Salt
description: Granola without oats or even nuts? Oh yes I did!

name: Honey Beer Bread
ingredients:
3 cups FOR THE BREAD:
1 Tablespoon All-purpose Flour
1 Tablespoon Sugar
1-½ teaspoon Baking Powder
3 Tablespoons Salt
1 bottle Honey
4 Tablespoons (about 12 Oz. Size) Beer
1 stick Unsalted Butter, Melted And Slightly Cooled
¼ cups FOR THE HONEY BUTTER:
1 dash Unsalted Butter, At Room Temperature
description: A little sweet and very fragrant, this beer bread makes a great snack slathered in honey butter!

name: Philly Cheesesteak Sliders
ingredients:
16 whole Split Slider Size Or Dinner Rolls
1 Tablespoon Butter
1 pound Cube Steak, Thinly Sliced
1 teaspoon Worcestershire Sauce
1 teaspoon Seasoned Salt
½ whole Green Pepper, Thinly Sliced
4 slices Provolone Cheese, Cut Into Quarters
description: Fun bite-sized phillies, which naturally means you can eat 8. Right?

name: Healthy Raw Brownies
ingredients:
1-½ cup Almonds (any Nut Will Work)
¼ cups Raw Cacao (cocoa) Powder
¼ teaspoons Sea Salt
2 Tablespoons Tablespoons Honey Or Agave Nectar
1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil
1-½ cup Dates
description: These raw brownies whip up so quickly and easily with few ingredients and they taste beyond incredible. But the best part is, they are healthy and my kids love them.  These brownies are also vegan, gluten free, high protein and low-carb. And did I mention how healthy and easy these are to make?

name: Hawaiian Barbeque
ingredients:
2 pounds Beef Short Ribs
2 pounds Boneless Chicken Thighs
1 cup Aloha Brand Soy Sauce
6 cloves Chopped Garlic
¼  Large Onion, Sliced
1 cup Light Brown Sugar
1-½ Tablespoon Chopped Fresh Ginger
½ cups Butter
5  Green Onions, Sliced
description: This is the best Hawaiian barbecue! Add some macaroni salad and white rice and it is perfect!

name: Portuguese Fruit Salad
ingredients:
1 quart Cherries, Halved And Pitted
1 quart Strawberries, Halved Or Quartered
2  Apples, Cut Up
2  Oranges, Sectioned
1  Mango, Cut Up
2 Tablespoons Sugar
½ cups Madeira Wine
description: A fresh and delicious salad with a little extra something. Use your own favorite fruit.

name: Potato Croquettes
ingredients:
1-½ pound Russet Potatoes, Or Any Variety That Is Mealy In Texture And Good For Mashing.
1 whole Egg
2 Tablespoons Softened Butter
4 Tablespoons White Flour
1 Tablespoon Salt
¼ Tablespoons Nutmeg
1-½ cup Dry Bread Crumbs For Breading The Croquettes
description: There are two keys to turning out good potato croquettes every time. The first, a well-proportioned balance of flour, egg and potato. The second necessity is oil heated sufficiently for deep frying them. The recipe given here ended the diplomatickitchen’s search for one that would turn out excellent croquettes on a regular basis.

name: Prize Winning Brownies
ingredients:
1 cup Butter
¾ cups Cocoa Powder
2-¼ cups Sugar
3 whole Eggs
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1-¼ cup Flour
½ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
description: Is there anything better than warm, moist brownies fresh from the oven? This is a family favorite recipe. Our son took it to the 4-H fair and it won a purple ribbon!

name: Five Herb Pesto
ingredients:
1 1/2 teaspoons whole coriander seeds
1/4 teaspoon fine grain sea salt
1 large clove garlic, peeled
a handful sliced almonds, toasted (cooled)
zest of one lemon
50 medium basil leaves
a handful of arugula leaves
1/2 teaspoon fresh oregano leaves
1/4 cup minced chives
3/4 cup grated Pecorino cheese
~1/4 cup / 60 ml extra virgin olive oil
description: A summer pesto made from a mix of coriander, basil, arugula, oregano, and chives, and links to a few other new recipes we've sprinkled around the QUITOKEETO shop site.

name: Grilled Chicken Tacos with Pineapple Salsa
ingredients:
6 whole Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts
½ cups Lime Juice
¼ cups Soy Sauce
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
2 Tablespoons Honey
1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar
2 Tablespoons Chili Powder
1 Tablespoon Ground Cumin
1 Tablespoon Ground Coriander
4 cloves Garlic, Finely Chopped
1 teaspoon Salt
1 teaspoon Black Pepper
8 whole Flour Or Corn Tortillas, Warmed
1 cup Baby Spinach Leaves
2 whole Avocados, Diced
1 cup FOR THE SALSA:
1 whole Pineapple, Diced
1 whole Jalapeno, Stem And Seeds Removed, Minced
½ whole Fresno Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed, Minced
½ whole Red Bell Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed, Diced
2 Tablespoons Red Onion, Finely Diced
½ teaspoons Fresh Cilantro, Chopped
1 Tablespoon Sea Salt
description: Marinated grilled chicken tacos with pineapple salsa combines sweet and spicy to make a perfectly, easy summer dinner option.

name: Green Gravy with Fish
ingredients:
1 bunch Fresh Coriander (Cilantro)
6 cloves Garlic, Divided
5  Green Chilies
½ teaspoons Turmeric Powder
2 teaspoons Salt
1-½ Tablespoon Ground Coriander
5 Tablespoons Oil
1 teaspoon Fenugreek Leaves
4 cups Water, Divided
2 Tablespoons Red Flour Or All Purpose Flour
3 Tablespoons Tamarind Pulp
1 pound, 1-⅔ ounces, weight Red Snapper Fish Pieces
description: This very authentic dish originated from fishermen. Few people know about this very tasty recipe.

name: Quinoa Produce Salad
ingredients:
1 cup Quinoa, Pre-rinsed Or Rinsed
2 cups Reduced Sodium Chicken Broth
2 cups Frozen Corn, Defrosted (can Definitely Use Fresh, If Available)
4 whole Green Onions, Chopped
2 cups Grape Tomatoes (multicolored Or Campari Are Great), Halved
6 leaves Basil, Thinly Sliced
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 whole Lemon, Juiced
description: This Quinoa Produce Salad is the perfect side dish for any meal this summer!

name: Red Velvet Cupcakes with Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients:
1 whole FOR THE CUPCAKES:
1 whole Egg
½ cups Egg Yolk
½ cups Packed Brown Sugar
1 Tablespoon Vanilla Sugar
2 teaspoons Red Liquid Food Coloring (I Used KopyKake Kroma Kolor In Red)
6 Tablespoons Vanilla Extract
2 Tablespoons Neutral Flavored Oil, Such As Canola, Vegetable, Sunflower, Coconut
1 cup Mayonnaise, Room Temperature
¼ cups All-purpose Flour
2 teaspoons Cake Flour
½ teaspoons Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
¾ cups Sea Salt
½ teaspoons Buttermilk, Slightly Warmed (just Warm To The Touch)
⅛ teaspoons Baking Soda
1-½ teaspoon More Of Baking Soda
8 ounces, weight White Distilled Vinegar
1-½ stick FOR THE CREAM CHEESE FROSTING:
½ teaspoons Cream Cheese, Room Temperature
1 cup Unsalted Butter,  Room Temperature
description: To me, nothing beats an old-fashioned red velvet cupcake with cream cheese frosting. Well, unless it’s a slice of cake of the same! Moist, deep in flavors, slightly sweet and topped with an incredible frosting!

name: Roasted Beet Garden Salad
ingredients:
2  Beets, Roasted
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
2  Eggs, Hardboiled
10  Fresh Mozzarella Balls
¼ pounds Salami, Sliced Thin
2 Tablespoons Soy Nuts
2 Tablespoons Red Onion, Sliced
1  Tomato, Cut Into Wedges
6 cups Spring Mix
4 Tablespoons Balsamic Vinaigrette
description: This fresh and satisfying salad is a definite crowd pleaser and gorgeous to feast upon!

name: Roasted Cauliflower
ingredients:
1 head Cauliflower
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
description: A ridiculously simple and easy recipe to prepare tasty cauliflower.

name: Roasted Eggplant Pizza
ingredients:
1 whole Eggplant
1 whole Olive Oil, Enough To Slather On The Eggplant Before Roasting
6 ounces, fluid Salt And Pepper, to taste
4 leaves Thin Crust Pizza Crust (we Used Boboli), Medium To Large Size
8 ounces, weight Pizza Sauce
description: You can never have enough pizza.

name: Garlicky Bok Choy
ingredients:
1-½ pound Bok Choy Or Baby Bok Choy
1-½ Tablespoon Grapeseed Oil
2 cloves Garlic, Finely Minced
1-½ teaspoon Salt To Taste
description: There are two types of bok choy: baby bok choy and regular.  I used baby bok choy for this recipe. If you cannot find it or only have the regular, then definitely chop it up instead of cutting in half like I did.

name: Shallot-Herb Grilled Corn
ingredients:
½ cups Margarine
½ cups Chopped Shallot
1 Tablespoon Dried Parsley Flakes
1 Tablespoon Dried Cilantro
1 teaspoon White Vinegar
½ teaspoons Salt
6 ears Corn, Shucked, Cleaned
description: My immersion blender came with a small bowl and attachment that allows it to work like a food processor. I love it. It is great for small quantities such as this margarine rub for corn. I had a smidgeon of the mixture left over and used it on a grilled cheese sandwich. Yum!

name: Shrimp Scampi Pizza
ingredients:
1 whole Pizza Dough, Homemade Or Store Bought, Enough For A Medium-large Pizza
1 Tablespoon Plus 2 Teaspoons Olive Oil, Divided (plus More For Drizzling)
1-½ cup Diced Tomatoes
2 Tablespoons Butter, Divided
½ cups Diced Mushrooms
1 teaspoon Dried Oregano
1 teaspoon Dried Basil
½ cups Heavy Cream
½ pounds Salt And Pepper, to taste
2 cloves Fresh Mozzarella, Sliced Thinly
1 pound Garlic
1 teaspoon Shrimp, Raw, Peeled And Deveined
description: Seriously delicious pizza!

name: Simple Butter Parsley Potatoes
ingredients:
3 pounds Potatoes
½ sticks Butter
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 bunch Fresh Parsley, Chopped
description: A delicious and simple side dish to accompany any protein.

name: Fresh Lemonade
ingredients:
1  FOR THE SIMPLE SYRUP:
1 cup Lemon
1 cup Water
1 cup Sugar
4 cups FOR THE LEMONADE:
4 cups Of Fresh Squeezed And Strained Lemon Juice (for 1 Cup You'll Need About 4 Or 5 Lemons)
1 whole Cold Water
description: Perfect for a hot summer day.

name: Smoky Lentils with Pomegranate and Mint
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 pound Smoked Turkey (basically Turkey Ham), Cubed Into 1/2-inch Pieces
8 cups Low-sodium Chicken Or Vegetable Stock, Warmed
1 can (15 Oz. Size) No-salt-added Diced Tomatoes, With Juices
2 whole Medium-large Onions, Chopped
3 whole Large Carrots, Scrubbed And Chopped
3 whole Large Stalks Celery, Chopped
5 cloves (Large) Garlic, Minced
1 pound Brown Lentils, Rinsed And Picked Over To Remove Any Stones Or Pieces Of Dirt
4 Tablespoons Tomato Paste
1 Tablespoon Pomegranate Molasses
1-½ teaspoon Cumin
1-½ teaspoon Smoked Paprika
½ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Black Pepper
2 Tablespoons Pomegranate Vinegar
4 Tablespoons Torn Fresh Mint Leaves
description: When I made this dish I originally had a run-of-the-mill stewed lentil thing in mind. Then I just let my imagination run wild, grabbing whatever sounded good from my fridge and pantry. With ingredients like pomegranate molasses, cumin, smoked paprika, and fresh mint, it ended up tasting like a Middle Eastern version of baked beans. Savory, smoky, and complex-flavored with an underlying hint of sweetness, the sauce is killer.

name: Spicy and Sweet Shrimp Salad
ingredients:
¼ cups FOR THE SAUCE:
¼ cups Plus 2 Tablespoons Of Honey
1 Tablespoon Sriracha Sauce
12 whole FOR THE SHRIMP:
3 dashes Butter
3 dashes Peeled And Deveined Raw Shrimp
4 cups Garlic Powder
¾ cups Ground Black Pepper
¾ cups FOR THE SALAD:
3 Tablespoons Chopped Romaine Lettuce
½  Cut Cucumbers (Cut Into Pieces That Are About 1/2 Inch Thick)
2 Tablespoons Chopped Celery
¼ cups Crumbled Blue Cheese
description: Opposites definitely attract with this quick and easy sweet and spicy sauce made with just two ingredients.

name: Strawberry Rhubarb Crisp
ingredients:
2 cups Halved Strawberries
4 cups Chopped Rhubarb (one Inch Pieces)
1-¼ cup Sugar
2-½ Tablespoons Cornstarch
1-½ cup Water
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1 teaspoon Orange Zest
2 Tablespoons Fresh Orange Juice
¾ cups Flour
1 cup Old Fashioned Oats
½ cups Brown Sugar, Packed
1-½ teaspoon Cinnamon
¾ cups Roughly Chopped Pecans Or Walnuts
1 pinch Salt
5 Tablespoons Butter, Melted
description: Strawberry Rhubarb Crisp is the perfect way to use the last rhubarb of the season!

name: Summer Salad with Grilled Chicken, Bacon & Chipotle Lime Vinaigrette
ingredients:
4  FOR THE SALAD:
1 teaspoon Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts
6 slices Vegetable Oil Or As Needed To Coat Chicken
5 ounces, weight Fully Cooked Bacon
1 cup Mixed Salad Greens
½  Strawberries, Sliced
½ cups English Cucumber, Sliced
1  Mixed Nuts And Seeds (cashews, Sliced Almonds, Pumpkin Seeds & Sunflower Seeds)
1 Tablespoon FOR THE DRESSING:
1 teaspoon Lime, Zest And Juice
⅛ teaspoons White Wine Vinegar
1 teaspoon Dijon Mustard
1 pinch Chipotle Chili Powder
½ cups Honey
description: A filling summer salad with grilled chicken, bacon, cashews, sliced almonds, pumpkin and sunflower seeds. It is dressed with a chipotle lime vinaigrette.

name: Avocado Mango Salsa
ingredients:
2 whole Hass Avocados, Peeled, Pitted And Diced
1 Tablespoon Lime Juice
2 whole Mangos, Peeled, Seeded And Diced
½ cups Finely Diced Red Onion
2 Tablespoons Chopped Cilantro
4 ounces, weight Canned Diced Green Chiles
description: This slightly sweet, tangy and creamy avocado-mango goodness is so good you won’t be able to stop scooping it up and shoveling it into your mouth!

name: Dutch Oven Original Sin
ingredients:
25  Oreo Cookie Sandwiches
½ cups Vegetable Oil
1 cup Sugar
2  Eggs
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
¼ teaspoons Salt
¼ teaspoons Baking Powder
½ cups All-purpose Flour
3 Tablespoons (Heaping) Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
3 Tablespoons Butter, Melted, Plus More To Grease The Dutch Oven
description: What is more sinful that chocolate? When it comes in the form of a gooey brownie over rich Oreos and topped with vanilla ice cream, I would say nothing in the food world can be more sinful. This dessert is perfect for camping trips or back yard parties. The texture of the brownie is devilishly gooey and full of fudge goodness. S’mores? Who needs them when you have Original Sin!

name: Tomato Davinci – Heirloom Tomato Savory Bread Pudding
ingredients:
¾  Ciabatta Loaf
2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1  Onion, Diced
2 cloves Garlic, Minced
2  Eggs
½ cups Vegetable Stock
½ cups Nut Milk (almond, Coconut, Rice, Etc)
4 cups Fresh Tomatoes, Chopped
2 Tablespoons Sun-dried Tomatoes, In Oil, Chopped
¼ cups Fresh Herbs (I Used Parsley, Basil And Thyme)
description: My kids really like this recipe because they say It taste just like pizza. Besides getting rave reviews at home, this was another popular side we used to have on the TaylorMade Menu in the cafe. This is a lovely way to use stale bread or when you have fresh farmers market tomatoes. You can use any kind you like; I have made this recipe with all kinds—red, yellow and orange tomatoes, grape tomatoes, heirloom tomatoes, etc.

name: Babci’s Sauerkraut
ingredients:
4 bags 2 Lb Bags Of Sauerkraut
1 pound Bacon
3  Large Onions , Chopped Fine
1 cup Water
description: My children have called our next door neighbor Babci since the day we moved in 16 years ago. This is how she taught me to make sauerkraut to go with kielbasa.  Looks like it makes a lot, but it cooks way down and is delicious.

name: Vanilla Bourbon Strawberries
ingredients:
6 cups Fresh Strawberries
3 Tablespoons Vanilla Sugar
2 Tablespoons Bourbon
description: These sweetened boozy berries can be served plain, with a dollop of whipped cream, or used in your favorite shortcake preparation.

name: Vegan Chocolate-Banana “Ice Cream”
ingredients:
1  Banana
1 Tablespoon Cocoa Powder
1 Tablespoon Peanut Butter Or Almond Butter, Optional
description: An oldie but a goodie: banana “ice cream”. This is always a hit at my cooking classes because people can’t believe this ice-creamy consistency is just bananas.

name: Pineapple Pie Bars
ingredients:
2 cans FOR THE FILLING:
⅓ cups (20 Oz. Size) Crushed Pineapple
¼ cups Sugar
1 Tablespoon Cornstarch
4 sticks Unsalted Butter
4 cups FOR THE CRUST:
1 cup Margarine (do Not Use Butter)
2-½ cups All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Sugar
1 whole Sweetened Coconut Flakes
1 cup Vanilla
1 Tablespoon Large Egg
description: Sweet and slightly tart pineapple pie filling goes on top of a crust that a cross between a pie crust and a cookie. I know that sounds a little crazy, but really these are just crazy good!

name: Green Olive Pesto
ingredients:
⅓ cups Green Olives, Pitted
⅓ cups Fresh Basil
3 sprigs Fresh Thyme, Stems Removed
2 Tablespoons Fresh Lemon Juice (about 1 Lemon)
½ Tablespoons Whole Ground Mustard
1 Tablespoon Capers
1 pinch Pepper
¼ cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Or More As Needed
description: This is a pantry staple for me—rub on grilled vegetables, use as a spread on sandwiches, mix with vegenaise as a dip, use as a base for pasta salad or potato salad. It’s briny, lemony and delicious!

name: Parmesan Gnocchi
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Butter
16 ounces, weight Packaged Potato Gnocchi
1 cup Whipping Cream
½ teaspoons Salt
¼ teaspoons Black Pepper
1 teaspoon Dried Basil
2 Tablespoons Dried Sun-Dried Tomatoes Re-hyrdrated And Minced
½ cups Freshly Grated Parmesan Cheese
description: Gnocchi dumplings swimming in a pool of the most wonderful cream sauce. You will be licking the bowl!

name: Spicy Mustard Grilled Chicken
ingredients:
6  Chicken Thighs
4 Tablespoons Pinot Grigio
3 Tablespoons Soy Sauce
2 Tablespoons Whole Grain Mustard
1  Large Yellow Onion, Peeled And Quartered
4 cloves Garlic, Peeled And Sliced
1 teaspoon Cayenne Pepper
1 teaspoon Sea Salt
½ teaspoons Black Pepper
½ teaspoons Red Pepper Flakes
description: As most people know, grilled chicken can become boring very fast. However, we love to put a spin on the standard chicken with new spice blends and marinades. This recipe provides a slight spice to the chicken without being overtly hot. By marinating the chicken, the flavors are allowed to fully penetrate the meat. By grilling over charcoal, an extra layer of flavor is added to the meal.

name: Garlic Edamame
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
4 cloves Fresh Garlic, Minced
16 ounces, weight Frozen Edamame Pods
description: Sauteing these pods in garlic and olive oil adds a great layer of flavor.

name: Fig Butter & Pork Tenderloin Apple Melt
ingredients:
4 slices Whole Wheat Raisin Bread
2 Tablespoons Fig Butter, I Used Trader Joe's
4 slices Sharp White Cheddar Cheese
1  Apple, Cored And Thinly Sliced
½ pounds Pork Tenderloin, Cooked And Cut Into Thin Slices
½ cups Red Onion, Thinly Sliced
¼ cups Sprouts
description: A delicious savory pork sandwich loaded with cheese and fig butter, on raisin bread!

name: Rumaki
ingredients:
1 pound Bacon
1 can Whole Water Chestnuts, 8 Ounce Can, Drained
¼ cups Hoisin Sauce
description: Rumaki is a Polynesian hors d’oeuvre usually involving bacon and water chestnuts. We put our own spin on it by brushing the bacon with hoisin sauce. You just cannot go wrong with bacon, water chestnuts and hoisin sauce. Quick, easy, and tasty. What more can you ask of an appetizer?

name: Baked Sweet Potato Fries with Greek Yogurt-Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients:
2 whole Sweet Potatoes
⅛ cups Salt And Pepper And Garlic Powder, To Taste
⅛ cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Enough To Drizzle Over The Potatoes As Desired
description: Delicious, crispy, flavorful sweet potato fries. These are way better than the fast food variety.  Plus a delicious yogurt-sour cream sauce to really take them to the next level.

name: Orange Maple Sweet Rolls (Vegan)
ingredients:
½ cups Warm Water, 110 Degrees F
1 package Dry Active Yeast, 0.25 Ounce Packet
½ cups Dairy-free Milk (I Use Coconut Milk Beverage)
⅓ cups Coconut Oil, Melted
⅓ cups Pure Maple Syrup
⅓ cups Veganaise Or Any Soy Mayonnaise
2 teaspoons Vanilla
2 Tablespoons Orange Juice
1 whole Orange For Zest
1-½ teaspoon Salt
4 cups All-purpose Flour
4 Tablespoons Pure Maple Syrup For Cake Pans
½ cups Melted Earth Balance Butter For Cake Pans And Filling
1 cup Light Brown Sugar For Filling
description: These sweet rolls are so light and airy. They have such a nice orange flavor that complements so nicely with the maple flavor.

name: Spice Candied Nuts
ingredients:
1 whole Egg White
½ pounds Unsalted Assorted Nuts (Walnuts, Hazelnuts, Almonds, Etc.)
2 teaspoons Sugar
2 Tablespoons Ground Coffee
2 teaspoons Ground Cinammon
1 teaspoon Ground Ginger
description: Assorted nuts of your choice coated with cinammon, ginger and ground coffee: a surprising and crowd-pleasing appetizer, ready in minutes.

name: Guinness (or any Beer) Float
ingredients:
2 cups Vanilla, Chocolate, Or Coffee Ice Cream
1 bottle Guinness Stout Or Other Good Beer, 12 Ounce Bottle, Chilled
description: One of the most bizarre things I’ve ever heard of…and then I tried it. Curiously delicious! Use any variety of beer you want.

name: Roasted Mustard Sweet Potates
ingredients:
2 whole Large Sweet Potatoes
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil, Divided
1 Tablespoon Coarse Ground Mustard
1 Tablespoon Dijon Mustard
1 Tablespoon Prepared Yellow Mustard
½ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Pepper
½ teaspoons Garlic Powder
description: Just a few simple ingredients away from a deliciously sweet and savory sweet potato side dish!

name: Buffalo Chicken Spaghetti

This pastry is perfect for making apple and other sweet pies. Even if you've never made pastry before, as long as you stick to the correct measurements for the ingredients and you follow the method exactly, you'll be laughing. The one place where you can experiment is with flavouring. If you don't fancy using lemon zest, try another dry ingredient like orange zest instead. Or a pinch of cinnamon, nutmeg or cocoa powder. Vanilla seeds are great too. Just remember to be subtle and don't go overboard with any of these flavours!

Try to be confident and bring the pastry together as quickly as you can – don't knead it too much or the heat from your hands will melt the butter. A good tip is to hold your hands under cold running water beforehand to make them as cold as possible. That way you'll end up with a delicate, flaky pastry every time.

description:
Not only is this dessert delicious, it was invented quite near where I was staying by the Tatin sisters. The story goes that one of them was making an apple tart but, for whatever reason, made a mistake and left it too long in the oven. However, she thought she could salvage it, so she ended up turning it upside down and her guests went mad for it. I wish all my cooking mistakes had such happy results. If you want to see a video of this being made, go to www.jamieoliver.com/how-to. It's dead simple and when you've made it once you'll have the hang of it.

Hopefully, this recipe will give you the basics so that you'll be able to stretch it by using pears, quinces, peaches, apricots or a mixture… I'm sure the sisters would love the fact that people were bending this recipe to make it their own. Light golden puff pastry, soft juicy fruit and crisp caramel is a great combination! You could serve this with a spoonful of crème fraîche or whipped cream, but personally I love the contrast between the warm tart and cold ice cream.

description: In my opinion, the most important part of a salad is the dressing. It's all very well saying everyone needs to eat more salad, fruit and veggies (it's true, we do), but it should be a pleasure, not a chore! By dressing a salad you can make it delicious, meaning you want to eat it rather than feel you have to. The other good news is that your body can absorb far more of the nutrients from salads because of the presence of oil and acid in the dressing. So dressings give you the double whammy of being a healthy benefit and also delicious! Don't drown your salads in dressing, though – remember, a little goes a long way – and always dress them at the last minute before serving.

description:
This pastry is perfect for making apple and other sweet pies. Even if you've never made pastry before, as long as you stick to the correct measurements for the ingredients and you follow the method exactly, you'll be laughing. The one place where you can experiment is with flavouring. If you don't fancy using lemon zest, try another dry ingredient like orange zest instead. Or a pinch of cinnamon, nutmeg or cocoa powder. Vanilla seeds are great too. Just remember to be subtle and don't go overboard with any of these flavours!

Try to be confident and bring the pastry together as quickly as you can – don't knead it too much or the heat from your hands will melt the butter. A good tip is to hold your hands under cold running water beforehand to make them as cold as possible. That way you'll end up with a delicate, flaky pastry every time.

name: Cinnamon Sweet Puffs

cooking spray

name: Citrus Carrot Salad

1 cup shredded carrots

description: "This is a healthy, sweet, and even seasonal dish! It can be made for 4th of July instead of coleslaw, and it's perfect for a cool afternoon picnic!"

name: Classic Belgian Waffles

1 cup whole wheat flour

name: Corn on the Cob Topping Twisters - Cheddar BBQ
ingredients:
1/2 cup Becel® Buttery Taste margarine

name: Cranked Up Corn Chowder

4 ears corn, kernels cut from cob

1/4 cup molasses

name: Date and Raisin Oat Biscuits
ingredients:
1 cup So Delicious® Dairy Free Unsweetened Coconut Milk

name: Delicious Creamed Peas

1 tablespoon butter

name: Easy Fresh Blueberry Cobbler

Berries:
4 cups blueberries

water, to cover

Batter:

description: "Easy recipe for all fresh fruit. Makes deep 8x8-inch pan. Great warm with vanilla ice cream and a cup of coffee! Use any fresh fruit, or use 2 cans of canned fruit. With pineapple, throw in some cherries and toss with brown sugar instead of white sugar. With peaches, use almond flavoring."

name: Easy Oven-Fried Chicken
ingredients:
1/4 cup shortening, or as needed
1/4 cup butter, or as needed
1/2 cup vegetable oil, or as needed
1 egg
1 teaspoon water
10 crackers, or as needed, crushed
1/4 cup cornmeal, or as needed
1 teaspoon dried sage
dried tarragon

salt and ground black pepper to taste

name: Easy Pepperoni Pizza Muffins

cooking spray
1 (10 ounce) can refrigerated buttermilk biscuit dough
10 tablespoons pizza sauce (such as Ragu® Homestyle)
10 slices pepperoni
10 tablespoons shredded mozzarella cheese, or as needed

name: Easy Spanish Rice

description: "This recipe has been told to me by my girlfriends MIL from Mexico. I had to measure the ingredients. Never before have they been measured, always a 'handful of this and equal parts of this' until it looked right. I hope you enjoy it. It has become a family favorite in our home. I am always asked to make it!"

name: Egg-Free Sweet Corn Casserole
ingredients:
1 (15.25 ounce) can whole kernel corn (such as Del Monte®, drained
1 (15 ounce) can cream-style corn (such as Del Monte®)
1 (7.5 ounce) package corn bread mix (such as Jiffy®)

name: Enhance That Jar of Spaghetti Sauce
ingredients:
2 tablespoons butter
1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil
1 (8 ounce) package sliced fresh mushrooms
1 cup red wine, divided
1 pound ground beef
1 cup diced yellow onion

1 tablespoon rosemary

description: "I never have enough sauce from just a jar alone. I also like the taste of fresh ingredients. I like to combine both in this recipe! The red wine makes all the difference. Serve on favorite noodles with mozzarella cheese and mushrooms on top."

name: Erika's Baked Beans
ingredients:
4 slices bacon
1 (16 ounce) can pork and beans
1/2 cup chopped onion
2 tablespoons brown sugar, or more to taste
1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
1 teaspoon prepared mustard
description: "Delicious baked beans with bacon."

name: Fabulous Fruit and Feta Salad
ingredients:
1 (10 ounce) package mixed salad greens
1 (11 ounce) can mandarin oranges, drained
1 cup coarsely chopped walnuts, toasted
1/2 cup thinly sliced red onion
1 (4 ounce) package feta cheese, crumbled
3/4 cup raspberry vinaigrette dressing
freshly cracked black pepper to taste
description: "Easy, great light salad that will go with any dish."

name: Easy Whole Wheat Banana Muffins
ingredients:
1 cup mashed bananas
1 cup creamy salad dressing (such as Miracle Whip®)
3/4 cup white sugar
2 cups whole wheat flour
2 teaspoons baking soda
1/2 teaspoon salt
description: "Very easy, moist banana muffins. Great basic recipe that you can change by adding nuts, chocolate chips, or raisins."

name: Faux Sourdough
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups warm potato water*
1 tablespoon granulated sugar
1 (.25 ounce) package active dry yeast
1 (6 ounce) container So Delicious® Plain Greek-Style Coconut Milk Yogurt
4 1/2 cups bread flour, or more if needed
1 1/2 teaspoons salt
1/2 teaspoon citric acid powder
1 pinch ground ginger
description: "Using water from boiled potatoes, this yeast bread bakes up golden brown and irresistibly delicious."

name: Easy, Sweet Cornbread Muffins
ingredients:
2 (7.5 ounce) packages corn bread mix (such as Jiffy®)
1/2 cup milk
1/2 cup sour cream
3 tablespoons honey
2 eggs
2 tablespoons white sugar
3 tablespoons melted butter
description: "If you enjoy sweet cornbread, I think you'll like these a lot!"

name: Fresh Apricot Cobbler
ingredients:
1 cup water
3/4 cup white sugar
1 tablespoon cornstarch
1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
6 cups halved fresh apricots
1 tablespoon butter
Topping:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1/4 cup white sugar
1 tablespoon baking powder
1 teaspoon salt
7 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons white sugar
1 1/2 cups milk
description: "When I was growing up, we had fruit trees and every year we had to come up with things to do with the extra fruit.  This cobbler became one of my favorites."

name: Feta Mashed Potatoes

2 pounds red potatoes, each cut into 6 pieces
1/2 teaspoon salt

6 ounces plain fat-free Greek yogurt, or more as needed

6 cups water

1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil

1 teaspoon honey
2 tomatoes, chopped
1/2 sweet onion (such as Vidalia®), chopped

2 carrots, cut into bite-size pieces

2 green onions, chopped
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, or to taste
1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro
1 pinch fresh cracked black pepper, or to taste
description: "Best with 'fresh from your garden' vegetables. A crisp, refreshing and simple side dish for those blistering hot summers!"

name: Gingersnap Fresh Peach Pie

1/3 cup butter, melted
40 gingersnap cookies, crushed
3 fresh peaches - peeled, pitted, and mashed

1 banana

2 teaspoons lemon juice

2 1/2 cups all-purpose gluten-free flour

1 cup all-purpose flour

1 egg, at room temperature
1 tablespoon oil

description: "This secret family pancake recipe was passed down from my grandfather. He fed a family of 7 (including 4 growing boys!) on these pancakes, and refused to give anyone the recipe until he finally relinquished it to my mother (his daughter-in-law) before he passed away. It is a long-standing family favorite!"

name: Gina's Arizona Citrus Salad

Dressing:
2/3 cup light olive oil

It's a beautiful salad with a light dressing and has lots of texture and color. The dressing took some experimenting, but I think it turned out just right."

name: Grilled Eggplant Pepper Appetizer Dip

1 pound eggplant, cut into 1/2-inch slices

description: "Hot dish or goulash, call it what you want. I grew up on this quick and easy meal. I have tweaked the ingredients a bit, but the results are just as good. Serve with a side salad for a great weekday dinner. Enjoy."

name: Gyros

1/4 cup chopped red onion

name: Hot Vidalia® Onion Dip
ingredients:
1 large sweet onion (such as Vidalia®), finely chopped

1 1/2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese

description: "Ever since my friend Sonja made this and brought it into work, it is my signature appetizer dish to take to parties! I tweaked it a little to my taste. It is the first appetizer to go and everyone will be asking for the recipe! Serve with crackers or sliced bread. Absolutely delicious!"

1 cup frozen honeydew melon
1 cup frozen mango
1/2 frozen banana
2 cups packed fresh spinach
2 teaspoons chia seeds
description: "Tropical fruit chunks are blended with coconut milk and lots of spinach for this refreshing on-the-go breakfast or snack."

name: Japanese Cucumber Salad (Sunomono)
ingredients:
5 cucumbers
2 teaspoons salt
1/2 cup lemon juice
1/2 cup white sugar
1 tablespoon white wine vinegar
1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, or to taste
description: "A delightfully tart and sweet salad that's great anytime. This will keep in the fridge for a few days and makes a great sweet snack when you're feeling the munchies!"

ingredients:
4 cups milk
2 (3 ounce) packages instant pistachio pudding mix

1 cup chopped walnuts
1 cup mini marshmallows
1/2 cup shredded coconut

name: Julie's Crunchy Potato Salad
ingredients:
12 large red potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-inch slices
1 bunch celery, finely chopped
1 bunch green onion, thinly sliced
3 carrots, peeled and diced
2 green bell peppers, seeded and diced
1 (3.25 ounce) can sliced black olives

name: Easy Microwave Mac and Cheese for One

½ cups Noodles Of Choice
½ cups Water
¼ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Garlic Powder
¼ cups Milk
¾ cups Shredded Cheese, Fat Reduced
½ cups Frozen Peas
description: The texture is absolutely perfect, creamy and rich. You should start with 1/2 cup of cheese and go from there. If you want it cheesier and richer like me, then you can and should add 1/4 cup more. This is one of those recipes I have pinned to my fridge so that I have it close in those lazy single moments haha.

name: Leftover Ham and Lima Bean Soup
ingredients:
3 (16 ounce) packages frozen baby lima beans
3 cups diced ham, or to taste
3 cups water
1 chopped onion
1 russet potato, cubed
1/2 cup salted butter
1 slice processed cheese food (such as Velveeta®)
1 tablespoon cornstarch
2 teaspoons celery salt
ground black pepper to taste
description: "Great for leftover ham after the holidays!"

name: Lime Cilantro Vinaigrette
ingredients:
2/3 cup fresh lime juice
2/3 cup packed cilantro leaves
1/4 cup apple cider vinegar

1 tablespoon ground cumin
salt to taste

4 cups water
1 cup white sugar
1 cup lemon juice

2 (2 liter) bottles lemon-lime soda

3 cups sliced ripe tomatillos

1 1/2 cups white sugar
1 teaspoon lemon juice, or more to taste

After tasting the ripe ones (they turn purple) and realizing they taste a lot like rhubarb, I made a few alterations to one of my favorite rhubarb pie recipes from allrecipes.com and viola, a new creation! I was totally amazed with the taste and I think you will be too!"

name: Little Traveler's Salad
ingredients:
1 head romaine lettuce, chopped
1 (10 ounce) package baby spinach leaves

name: Maple Breakfast Sausage
ingredients:
2 1/2 pounds ground pork
1/4 cup maple syrup
1 1/2 tablespoons chopped fresh sage
1 tablespoon salt
2 1/2 teaspoons fennel seed
2 1/2 teaspoons red pepper flakes
2 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder
2 1/2 teaspoons onion powder
1 teaspoon anise seed

description: "Homemade breakfast sausage made with ground pork and seasonings. Great cooked in crumbles for biscuits and gravy, or in patties for breakfast sandwiches or eggs benedict. I like to premake a large batch and freeze the patties, then just take out a few the night before."

name: Mexico Chiquito Punch
ingredients:
1 (46 fluid ounce) can pineapple juice
1 (1 liter) bottle grenadine syrup
1 cup white sugar
1/4 cup lemon juice
1 (1 ounce) packet instant tea powder
5 quarts water, or as needed
description: "Hands down, best tropical fruit punch EVER. There is a chain of fast-food restaurants in Little Rock called Mexico Chiquito; they sell the best fruit punch, and this is about as close as you can get! This recipe can also be made in two separate 1-gallon pitchers. Just divide the mixture of listed ingredients between the two pitchers and fill with water as above."

name: Mini Chocolate Cups
ingredients:
12 (1 ounce) squares semisweet chocolate
20 mini paper muffin cups
description: "These are awesome chocolate cups! Perfect for all occasions! You can serve them for dessert and put strawberries inside. These are extra great. (You can use all kinds of chocolate.) You may need to make more layers than included in the recipe below."

name: Mississippi Vegi Balls
ingredients:
2 cups Italian-seasoned bread crumbs
1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese

4 eggs

1/4 teaspoon dried sage

"Accompany with a sauce of your choice. 
Tastes like a meat."

2 eggs, separated
1 1/4 cups milk
1/4 cup white sugar

1/4 teaspoon salt

waxed paper

1 clove garlic, finely chopped
8 slices mozzarella cheese
1 large roma tomato, thinly sliced

6 leaves fresh basil, roughly chopped

Using naan bread not only saves time but it is great for portion control. The only difference between this recipe and most pizza recipes is that It doesn't include a tomato sauce on the base. I don't like the sogginess that comes from the sauce, but feel free to try it with the sauce as it will still yield good results."

name: New Quiche Lorraine
ingredients:
4 slices bacon
1 (9 inch) frozen deep dish pie crust, thawed
1/2 cup diced white onion
1 clove garlic, minced
1 cup half-and-half

description: "I discovered quiche Lorraine while studying French in high school. After trying many recipes over the years and being dissatisfied with each one I have put my own spin on this classic recipe that results in a crisp crust and tender custard. Serve with a side salad if desired. Bon appetite!"

name: Old Fashioned Rhubarb Cobbler
ingredients:
3 cups chopped rhubarb, or to taste
Batter:
3/4 cup white sugar
3 tablespoons butter
1 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 cup milk
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1/2 teaspoon salt
Topping:
1 cup white sugar
1 tablespoon cornstarch
1/4 teaspoon salt
1 cup boiling water

name: Peanut Butter Snack Bars

parchment paper
cooking spray
3/4 cup chopped dark chocolate

1/4 cup flax seeds
1 cup crispy rice cereal
1 cup cornflake crumbs
3/4 cup chopped smoke-flavored almonds
1/2 teaspoon kosher salt
1/2 cup honey
1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
1/4 cup brown sugar
2 tablespoons agave nectar
1 tablespoon canola oil
1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
description: "These are Mike's favorite bars--a combination of energy bars, granola bars, and cereal bars. These can be adapted to your taste with fruits, nuts, seeds, chocolate, etc. Also, depending on your selection of ingredients, you can go 100% natural/organic."

name: Penne Alfredo with Vegetables

1/2 (1 pound) package whole wheat penne

1 1/2 cups fat-free half-and-half

name: Perfect Fried Green Tomatoes

4 green tomatoes, cut into 1/4-inch slices
salt and ground black pepper to taste

2 teaspoons salt, divided
2 teaspoons ground black pepper, divided
1 cup buttermilk
1 cup cornmeal

Cajun Ranch Sauce:
1/2 cup ranch dressing

Over the years I have tried and made fried green tomato recipes and this is the one that is perfect. Cajun ranch sauce goes perfect with this crispy on the outside but smooth and creamy on the inside tomato."

name: Perfect Cut-Out Cookie Dough

6 tablespoons unsalted butter
1/2 cup confectioners' sugar
1 egg
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon salt
description: "This recipe always comes out perfect. My toddlers and I make these often. I throw the dough together in the morning and let it sit in the fridge. I take it out at dinner time to let it warm just a bit, and we roll them out and ice them after for dessert. You use different flavors of extract and add spices. For fall, I use maple extract and add cinnamon and nutmeg. I use my mixer to prepare dough and it comes together super easy."

name: Pink Lady Punch

1 quart ginger ale, chilled
4 cups cranberry juice cocktail, chilled
4 cups pineapple juice, chilled

Can be served in a punch bowl, or individual servings. Garnish with cherries, orange slices or other desired fresh fruit."

name: Pork Rites (Taverns)
ingredients:
2 pounds ground pork
1 cup ketchup

name: Potato-Leek Soup
ingredients:

3 cups chopped leeks (white and light green parts only)
4 Yukon Gold potatoes, thinly sliced
2 teaspoons sea salt, or to taste
2 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper, or to taste

description: "A low-fat, spicy version of traditional leek and potato soup. Serve hot, if desired, with a dollop of sour cream or milk at the table. Or cool and serve cold or at room temperature, and if desired, stir in half-and-half before serving."

name: Puttanesca Blanca Linguine
ingredients:
1/2 pound spinach linguine

ground black pepper to taste
description: "A delicious twist on a quick and easy Italian classic that substitutes fish sauce for finicky anchovy fillets. Serve with a generous green salad. I like something with strawberries or Asian pears and a glass of white wine. Make it a full meal by topping with a dry-spiced chicken breast (I like a hint of fish oil and garlic spice blends to make a nice rub.)"

name: Ranchy Fruit and Nut Salad

Topping:

name: Rhonda's Fried Green Tomatoes
ingredients:
1/2 cup vegetable oil, for frying

1/4 cup cornmeal

1 pound ground beef

3/4 cup shredded Parmesan cheese, divided

name: Rum-beer Float
ingredients:
1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle root beer
1 (1.5 fluid ounce) jigger spiced rum
2 scoops vanilla ice cream
description: "This is a quick and easy dessert cocktail for parties, and it adds an adult twist to a classic root beer float."

name: Sarah's Fried Green Tomatoes

2 large green tomatoes, sliced 1/4-inch thick

name: Sausage Mushroom Quiche

6 eggs

1/4 cup shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
description: "Savory quiche perfect for breakfast or dinner."

name: Grammie Pammie’s Apple Cake
ingredients:
10 whole FOR THE APPLE MIXTURE:
1 teaspoon Granny Smith Apples (peeled, Cored, And Sliced)
¼ cups Cinnamon
½ cups Light Brown Sugar

name: Shredded Apple Carrot Salad

name: Slow Cook 3-Bean Chili (Vegetarian and Gluten-Free)

8 cups water

name: Soccer Chex® Mix

1 egg, beaten

name: Spiced Hot Cocoa Mix

3 cups powdered milk

description: "A great hot, chocolaty drink for wintertime using chocolate pudding mix, cinnamon, and more. Great for gift giving. Mix 1/4 cup mix with 1 cup of boiling water. Top off with whipped topping and sprinkle with cinnamon. Enjoy!"

name: Green Tomato Ketchup

4 whole Large Green Tomatoes

½ cups Brown Sugar

description: I had wanted to create a ketchup from green tomatoes for years and finally motivated by this month’s theme of vegetables I did. I wish that it actually looked green. It does not due to the red pepper in the recipe and I am tempted to try it with a green pepper instead next time. However, I was so pleased with the flavor I probably won’t!

name: Grilled Brie with Figs & Thyme Honey

cheesecloth

She thought it best to go ahead and pick the damaged vegetables and she did, harvesting armloads of tattered and torn chard and heaps of eggplants and tomatoes, which she used to make a gratin. name: pickled vegetable sandwich slaw
ingredients:
Something of a gateway pickle, these should be eyed suspiciously as well. The thing is, one day you’re eating the foods you’ve always liked — sandwiches, salads, tacos, cheese — and you wouldn’t change a single thing. And then, once day, the quadruple-threat crunch/sweet/salty/punch of a pickle gets under your skin and suddenly, the food landscape is a bleak, depressing place without them. You need
on your tacos,
in your tuna and egg salads, cucumber slices in your
,
with your sharp cheeses and
in the fridge whenever the mood strikes, and nothing’s ever quite right without them again. I can find a clear demarcation in my pre- and post-pickle junkie days (it’s just about 10 (!) years ago, when I took up with this Russian I married) and think there’s still hope for you. Here, how about some
instead?
1 cup distilled white vinegar
6 tablespoons sugar
3 tablespoons Kosher salt
2 tablespoons yellow mustard seeds
1 cup cold water
4 to 5 cups mixed slivered or julienned* firm, raw vegetables (see above for vegetable suggestions, below for slicing tips)
Optional: Few slivers of jalapeno

description: One of my favorite desserts on this planet (yes, we’re going for High Melodrama today, also, it’s that wonderful) is , which translates from Italian as “drowned.” The lucky drowner is top-notch vanilla gelato, and it is draped in a single shot of freshly-pulled espresso. I see you arching your eyebrows and you are full of questions, aren’t you? Isn’t that horribly bitter? Doesn’t it melt the ice cream? How can it be your favorite dessert if it has neither butter nor chocolate with it? All are legitimate concerns but the thing is, when it’s done right — and there really is a magical balancing point between the volume of ice cream and the amount of espresso, that is, sadly, rarely achieved — the resulting mess is a semi-slumped mound of cold and sweet vanilla cream with a trench of faintly bitter latte around it. It is the ultimate grownup dessert — sure, you get the ice cream you’ve been angling for after dinner since you were , but you also get a bracing hit of espresso, just enough to keep you up past your bedtime, you know, when all the fun begins.

1 can (15 Oz. Size) Cannelini Beans, Drained, Rinsed

2 cups Diced Mango

With pineapple, throw in some cherries and toss with brown sugar instead of white sugar. With peaches, use almond flavoring."

It requires very cold fat to be carefully worked into a floury mix until the pieces are exactly the right size. Too small, your crust is flat and crunchy. 3/4 cup sour cream

name: Crescent Roll Zucchini Quiche

1/4 cup butter

name: Cuddle Up Chili

1 pound ground beef

1 pound lean ground beef

Substitute the cavatappi with any full-bodied pasta, such as bow-tie, wagon-wheel, or mostaccioli.  You can even sneak in some frozen corn for a little tex-mex feel. Top it with cheese when serving."

name: Easy Creamy Caesar Salad Dressing
ingredients:
1/3 cup canola oil
1/3 cup grated Parmesan cheese

1 pound lean ground beef

1/4 cup butter, melted

name: Easy, Not Fast One Pot German Cabbage Soup

1 pound ground beef

name: Forgotten Puffs (Chocolate Chip Meringue Cookies)
ingredients:
2 egg whites
2/3 cup white sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla extract

description: "Easy cookies you don't need to watch over. I got this recipe from Betty at church. I just love these!"

description: "Like traditional French onion soup but ready in a fraction of the time, this soup is loaded with rich broth and onions, ladled into bowls, topped with thick slices of French bread and Swiss cheese, then broiled until cheese is bubbling."

name: Fresh Raspberry Balsamic Vinaigrette
ingredients:
1 cup fresh raspberries
1 tablespoon white sugar
2/3 cup balsamic vinegar
1/4 cup olive oil

1/2 teaspoon salt

name: Garlic Chicken and Zucchini

name: Gluten Free Mexican Lasagna

2 (15 ounce) cans chili without beans (such as Wolf®)

name: HERDEZ® Three Pepper Cheesy Stuffed Jalapenos

4 corn tortillas
1/2 cup water
1 (15.25 ounce) can corn, rinsed
1 (15 ounce) can cannellini beans, rinsed
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 cup uncooked white rice
2 cups water
Garnishes:
Cotija cheese
Limes
Avocado
Cilantro
Green onion
Cabbage
Hot sauce
Crema fresca

This recipe is adaptable to whatever beans you happen to have on hand. This stew is gluten-free, but none of your guests will ever suspect!"

name: HERDEZ® Roasted Corn Tamales with Chipotle Shrimp
ingredients:
20 dried corn husks
2 ears corn
6 ounces lard or shortening
1/4 cup butter
2 cups masa flour
3/4 teaspoon baking powder
1 cup chicken stock
2 pounds shrimp, shelled and deveined
2 tablespoons butter
1 (12 ounce) jar HERDEZ® Traditional Chipotle Mexican Cooking Sauce
description: "Traditional tamales with a spicy shrimp accompaniment. So worth the time it takes to make this. Yummm."

name: HERDEZ® Red Guajillo Chile Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients:
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 cup diced onion
1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 (12 ounce) jar HERDEZ® Red Guajillo Chile Mexican Cooking Sauce, or to taste
1 1/2 cups water
1 (15 ounce) can corn, drained
1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (15 ounce) can diced tomatoes, undrained
1 cube chicken bouillon
1 cup tomato-vegetable juice cocktail
6 (6 inch) corn tortillas, cut into strips
Additional toppings if desired: diced avocado, shredded cheddar cheese, salsa, diced tomato, sour cream, cilantro, hot sauce
description: "This tortilla soup is extra flavorful with the addition of red guajillo chile sauce! It's a little spicy, so add to taste!"

name: HERDEZ® Pumpkin Mole Soup
ingredients:
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 sweet onion, chopped
2 large cloves garlic, minced
1 (15 ounce) can pumpkin puree
4 cups low-salt chicken stock
1 cup HERDEZ® Roasted Pasilla Chile Mexican Cooking Sauce
1 (1 ounce) square unsweetened chocolate
3/4 cup heavy cream or evaporated milk
1/2 cup crema or sour cream for topping
description: "This rich soup gets its warm spiciness from pasilla peppers and its dark depth of flavor from chocolate. We make a meal of it with an avocado-lime salad and some bread."

name: HERDEZ® Mexican Cornbread
ingredients:
3 1/4 cups cornmeal
2 tablespoons baking powder
1 tablespoon kosher salt
2 tablespoons white sugar
1/2 cup shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/2 cup shredded pepperjack cheese
1/2 cup minced onion
1/2 cup minced red bell pepper
2 cups milk
1/2 cup canola oil
1 (14.75 ounce) can sweet cream-style corn
1 (4 ounce) can canned diced green chiles
1/2 cup HERDEZ® Tomatilla Verde Mexican Cooking Sauce
Non-stick cooking spray

name: HERDEZ® Lobster Tacos
ingredients:
4 medium lobster tails
Salt and ground black pepper to taste
1/4 cup HERDEZ® Red Guajillo Chile Mexican Cooking Sauce
3 green onions, chopped
1 medium tomato, diced
8 tortilla wraps, corn or flour
1/4 cup shredded Colby-Jack cheese
1 small Hass avocado, sliced
1/2 cup shredded lettuce
description: "Disappointed by restaurant lobster tacos, I created this recipe for great at-home lobster tacos my family enjoys."

name: HERDEZ® Hot Chipotle Mocha
ingredients:
8 fluid ounces hot, strong brewed coffee
2 tablespoons miniature chocolate chips
2 tablespoons vanilla-flavored coffee creamer
1/2 teaspoon HERDEZ® Traditional Chipotle Mexican Cooking Sauce, or to taste
Sugar to taste  (optional)
description: "Spicy kick to get your day off right! Experiment with different flavored creamers to mix up your coffee drink!"

name: Horseradish Cheese Spread
ingredients:
1 (16 ounce) jar pasteurized process cheese spread (such as Cheez Whiz®)
1/2 cup horseradish sauce
1 (4 ounce) package cream cheese, softened
1/4 cup butter
1 tablespoon prepared horseradish
1/2 teaspoon onion salt
5 drops hot sauce
description: "This recipe is simple but so good."

name: Hot Dog Chili Sauce
ingredients:
2 pounds ground beef
2 (14.5 ounce) cans reduced-sodium beef broth
1 (28 ounce) can crushed tomatoes with puree
2 tablespoons chili powder
1 tablespoon paprika
1 teaspoon onion powder
1 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon kosher salt
1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
description: "This recipe makes a wonderful chili sauce for hot dogs. Just place a grilled hot dog in a bun and top with chili, grated Cheddar cheese, and diced onions. Serve immediately. If halving this recipe, cover the pot for half of the two hour simmer."

name: Hot N Spicy Crab Dip
ingredients:
1 (16 ounce) can crabmeat
2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, softened
1 (8 ounce) package sharp Cheddar cheese spread
3 tablespoons lemon juice
3 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
3 tablespoons beer
2 tablespoons chopped fresh chives
2 tablespoons grated onion
1 tablespoon chile-garlic sauce (such as Sriracha®)
1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
1 clove garlic, crushed
1 pinch paprika, or to taste
description: "This is super easy and super delicious! I'm always asked to make it for parties. And I never have any leftover! It's great on crackers, toasted bread, or veggies! Even good as filling for stuffed mushrooms!"

name: Ice Cream Pie
ingredients:
3 tablespoons butter
3 tablespoons corn syrup
2 tablespoons brown sugar
2 1/2 cups crispy rice cereal (such as Rice Krispies®)
1/4 cup peanut butter, slightly melted
1 (12 ounce) jar chocolate fudge sauce, divided
1 teaspoon corn syrup, or to taste
2 quarts vanilla ice cream
description: "My great-grandma's ice cream pie includes a Rice Krispies® crust and peanut buttery chocolate topping. This recipe can be changed to accommodate different tastes by changing the flavor of ice cream. My cousin has tried several different ones and loves them all."

name: Indian Summer Raspberry Peach Sangria
ingredients:
1 (750 milliliter) bottle red wine
24 fluid ounces raspberry-flavored soda water
1/2 cup peach schnapps
1/2 cup pomegranate juice
1/2 cup fresh lemon juice
1 cup fresh raspberries
2 peaches, sliced
2 lemons, sliced
1 orange, sliced
4 cups ice cubes, or as desired  (optional)
description: "Love at first sip!"

name: Banana Split Cake Cups
ingredients:
1 stick Butter, Melted
2 cups Graham Cracker Crumbs
8 ounces, weight Package Cream Cheese, Softened
¼ cups Butter, Softened
3 cups Powdered Sugar
4 whole Bananas, Sliced

1 cup Chopped Pecans (or Walnuts)
1 quart Strawberries, Hulled And Sliced
1 cup Heavy Whipping Cream
9 ounces, weight Jar Maraschino Cherries, Drained And Halved
description: A sweet childhood treat layered in mason jars.

name: Jalapeno Popper Dip
ingredients:
7 slices bacon, diced
2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, softened
1 cup mayonnaise
1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1/4 cup chopped green onion
5 jalapeno peppers, seeded and chopped

Topping:
1 cup crushed buttery round crackers
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/4 cup butter, melted
description: "This has all the flavor of jalapeno poppers in an easy to make dip! I have mixed the Parmesan cheese in with the dip and omitted the cracker and butter topping, but baked as usual, too."

name: Joanne's Pumpkin Patch Paradise
ingredients:
4 cups crispy corn cereal squares (such as Corn Chex®)
4 cups crispy rice cereal squares (such as Rice Chex®)
1 cup pretzels
1 cup peanuts
1/2 cup peanut butter
1/4 cup butter
2 1/4 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1/2 cup candy corn, or to taste  (optional)
1/2 cup candy-coated milk chocolate pieces (such as M&M's®), or to taste  (optional)
description: "This is a wonderful snack recipe. The first time I tried it, I ended up eating the entire batch by myself. It is perfect for any occasion, especially parties and get-togethers!"

name: Joyce's Simple Pizza Sauce
ingredients:
1 (8 ounce) can tomato sauce
1 teaspoon white sugar
1/2 teaspoon dried basil
1/4 teaspoon Italian seasoning
1/4 teaspoon minced onion
description: "Simmer a blend of tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, basil, sugar, and minced onion for a yummy sauce for pizza. I can't have garlic, dairy (from cows), or gluten, but I can have pizza with this sauce on a gluten-free pizza crust and by using Gouda goat cheese."

name: Kiki's Spiced Habanero Peach Jam
ingredients:
3 1/2 pounds fresh peaches - peeled, pitted, and chopped
6 tablespoons lemon juice
1 vanilla bean, halved lengthwise and seeds scraped out
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1 teaspoon ground allspice
1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
2 habanero peppers, stemmed and seeded
2 (3 ounce) pouches liquid pectin
5 cups white sugar
2 cups packed brown sugar
description: "I developed this recipe when I was low on funds one holiday season and needed an inexpensive gift for family and friends. I now make several batches every years at several peoples request. It has become a huge hit at bake sales as well. Don't be afraid of the fact that it has habanero peppers in the recipe. The heat is very subtle and just adds to the flavor of the jam. It's also great spread over a block of cream cheese served with crackers for an easy appetizer for parties. Try it instead of sugar in your baked bean recipe and you will not be disappointed."

name: Lemon BBQ Chicken Salad
ingredients:
2 cups cubed cooked chicken
2 tablespoons lemon juice
2 cups cold cooked rice
1 stalk celery, sliced
1/2 cup sliced pimiento-stuffed olives
6 tablespoons crumbled cooked bacon, divided
1 cup mayonnaise
2 tablespoons barbeque sauce
1/2 teaspoon hickory-flavored liquid smoke
description: "A zesty summer salad to serve as a cool summer supper, potluck contribution, or even a ladies luncheon. A good way to use up leftover chicken and rice. If leftover chicken and rice are not available, boneless chicken breast and regular or instant rice can be prepared ahead of time."

name: Melon Salad
ingredients:
1 watermelon, peeled and cubed
1 honeydew melon - peeled, seeded, and cubed
1 cantaloupe - peeled, seeded, and cubed
1 pineapple, peeled and cubed
1 (16 ounce) package sliced fresh strawberries
1 (12 ounce) bottle poppy seed salad dressing
1 (8 ounce) container vanilla yogurt
description: "Sweet and juicy. Anyone of any age will eat this up."

name: Mexican Chocolate/Salted Caramel Cake in a Mug
ingredients:
2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
3 tablespoons white sugar
2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
2 tablespoons chocolate chips
1/4 teaspoon baking powder
1 pinch salt
1 pinch cayenne pepper
1 pinch ground cinnamon
3 tablespoons milk
1 tablespoon canola oil
1 egg, beaten
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 individually wrapped caramels, unwrapped and halved
1 pinch kosher salt
description: "I had this at friends house and had to have the recipe! He didn't know where he got it but he knows the date - it was on the receipt he wrote the recipe on. Great when you want just one serving of dessert."

name: Miles of Mozzarella Baked Mostaccioli
ingredients:
2 teaspoons olive oil, divided
1/2 cup finely chopped onion, divided
3 cloves garlic, minced, divided
2 cups beef broth
2 (15 ounce) cans tomato sauce

1 tablespoon dried basil
2 teaspoons white sugar
1 1/2 teaspoons dried parsley
1/2 teaspoon thyme

1 pound ground beef
1/2 cup diced green bell pepper
2 cups water
1 (16 ounce) package mostaccioli pasta
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
1 (8 ounce) package fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced
description: "This recipe uses my Powerful Flavor Pasta Meat Sauce. The beauty is in the massive amounts of mozzarella. Don't cook the mostaccioli before you add it to the final baking dish. By allowing the pasta to cook in the sauce, as opposed to water, you will see a perfect al-dente pasta infused with the flavor of the sauce."

name: Mom's Double Pie Crust
ingredients:
1 2/3 cups all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon salt

5 tablespoons cold orange juice, or as needed

1 pound top sirloin steak

2 tablespoons balsamic or red wine vinegar
2 tablespoons butter
description: "Sirloin steak is cooked stovetop and sliced, then served with browned mushrooms in a buttery balsamic sauce."

name: No-Bake Cheesecake Flag Cake
ingredients:
Crust:
1 1/2 cups finely crushed graham cracker crumbs
1/4 cup white sugar
2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
6 tablespoons butter, melted
Filling:
1 cup cream cheese at room temperature
1 cup mascarpone cheese at room temperature

20 large fresh strawberries, hulled and halved lengthwise, or as needed
24 large fresh blueberries, or as needed

name: No-Bake White Chocolate Cheesecake
ingredients:
1/2 cup white chocolate chips
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, softened
1 (9 inch) prepared graham cracker crust
description: "This is the easiest cheesecake I've ever made, and it is creamy. This always disappears VERY quickly at an office potluck or family buffet. It even fooled my uncle, who doesn't like chocolate!"

name: Oven Baked Omelet

1 teaspoon butter
9 large eggs

name: Patsy's Cauliflower Salad

1 head cauliflower, cut into bite-size pieces

1 bunch radishes, thinly sliced
1/2 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup sour cream
5 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
1 teaspoon garlic powder
description: "A very delicious, mayonnaise-based cauliflower salad. Mom's been making it for over 30 years. It wows everyone who tastes it. Don't bring it to your next potluck unless you plan on bringing it every time."

name: Oven-Grilled Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients:
1 (14 ounce) bag Birds Eye® Recipe Ready Grilling Blend

1/2 large onion, diced

Topping:

name: Shortbread Cookies with Chocolate and Almonds

cooking spray

This recipe creates a fresh and sweet treat with minimal sugar allowing you to indulge in fruit and chocolate, the best of both worlds! Store the remaining ice cream in a container in your freezer for later enjoyment!"

name: Skillet Chicken and Apple Stuffing

description: "I've never liked the heavy texture of buttercream icing, so I came up with this as a smooth and rich alternative. It always gets rave reviews!"

The idea behind the Blueberry Milk Crumble came from Momofuku Milk Bar, which is a bakery in New York that does awesome intriguing nostalgic twists on childhood classic treats. It does require some special ingredients, including milk powder (nonfat dry milk powder can be found at most grocery stories, but I used whole milk powder which can be found at health food stores. The nonfat will work though – just makes sure it’s crushed to a fine powder as the nonfat stuff has a habit of clumping up.) 2  Eggplants, Cut In 1/2 Inch Slices
3 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
½ cups Pine Nuts
3 ounces, weight Goat Cheese Crumbled
¼ cups Basil, Thinly Sliced
2 Tablespoons Fresh Mint, Chopped
1  Lemon, Zested And Juiced
½ teaspoons Kosher Salt
¼ teaspoons Fresh Ground Pepper

name: Feta Stuffed Tomatoes
ingredients:
1 whole Tomato, Large
1 ounce, weight Feta Cheese, Fat Free
1 Tablespoon Tortilla Chip Crumbs
1 Tablespoon Scallions, Chopped
1 Tablespoon Fresh Parsley, Chopped Or Substitute 1/2 Tablespoon Of Dried
1 teaspoon Olive Oil

name: Grilled Sweet Corn Salsa
ingredients:
4 ears Fresh Sweet Corn
1  Jalapeno, Finely Chopped (I Like To Leave Half The Seeds In For A Little Heat)
1 pint Grape Tomatoes, Quartered
½ cups Diced Red Onion
1  Lime, Juiced
¼ cups (Packed) Chopped Cilantro
description: Grilled corn tossed with grape tomatoes, jalapeno and lime makes for a refreshing summer salsa. Great for serving as a side dish with steak, topping a salad, or loading onto tortilla chips.

name: Healthy Chicken Caprese Sammies
ingredients:
1 head Garlic
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1  Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breast, Cut In Half Horizontally
1 teaspoon Kosher Salt
1 teaspoon Cracked Black Pepper
3 Tablespoons Butter

1 teaspoon Dried Rosemary
10  Fresh Basil Leaves
1  Medium Tomato, Sliced
4 ounces, weight Mozzarella Cheese, Sliced
2 teaspoons Balsamic Vinegar
description: Great summer sandwich! Easy, quick and absolutely scrumptious!

name: Jalapeño Quesadillas
ingredients:
6 Tablespoons Butter
4 whole Whole Wheat (or Regular) Tortillas
1-½ cup Monterey Jack Cheese, Grated
3 whole Jalapenos, Sliced Very Thin
8 ounces, weight Mushrooms, Sliced (optional)

name: Mango & Avocado Black Rice Salad with Cilantro-Lime Vinaigrette
ingredients:
1-½ cup FOR THE SALAD:
2-¾ cups Uncooked Organic Black Rice
½ teaspoons Water
½ cups Salt
1  Chopped Fresh Cilantro
½ cups Large Ripe Mango, Peeled, Pitted And Diced
¼ cups Diced Red Onion

¼ cups Small Ripe Avocado, Peeled, Pitted And Diced Or Sliced

1 clove FOR THE DRESSING:
1 teaspoon Freshly Squeezed Lime Juice
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
¼ teaspoons Garlic, Minced

name: Mediterranean Club Sandwich
ingredients:
1-½  FOR THE SANDWICHES:
2 teaspoons Round Pita Breads
2 slices Olive Oil
4 slices Garlic Salt, For Sprinkling
2 leaves Black Pepper, For Sprinkling
1  Prosciutto
1  Deli Turkey Or Chicken Breast

¼ cups Tomato, Thinly Sliced

description: Stacks of prosciutto, chicken, roasted red pepper and summer veggies sandwiched between toasted pita wedges. You’re gonna need a bigger mouth.

name: Mouthwatering Cilantro Lime Skirt Steak with Chimichurri
ingredients:
1 pound FOR THE STEAK:
⅓ cups Skirt Steak
⅓ cups Soy Sauce
3 cloves Olive Oil
2  Garlic, Minced
¼ cups Limes, Juiced
1 teaspoon Cilantro Leaves

1 clove Jalapeno Rough Chopped (Seeds Removed)
¼ cups Onion, Rough Chopped
¼ cups Garlic (whole)
½ cups Cilantro Leaves
2  Parsley Leaves
1 teaspoon Olive Oil
1 teaspoon Limes, Juiced
1  Cumin

name: No-Bake, Dairy-Free, Sugar Free Overnight Oats
ingredients:
3 cups Rolled Oats
3 cups Unsweetened Vanilla Almond Milk
3 Tablespoons Chia Seeds
½ teaspoons Vanilla Extract

½ cups Blueberries
description: No-Bake, Dairy-Free, Sugar Free Overnight Oats are perfect for summer and easy to make ahead before you head to the beach!

name: Long Island Potato Salad
ingredients:
5 pounds Medium Sized Red Potatoes
½ cups Chopped Onions
4 cups Water
1 cup White Vinegar
2 cups Granulated Sugar
½ cups Canola Oil
1 Tablespoon White Pepper

ingredients:
1 pound FOR THE SALAD:
4 cloves Dry Spaghetti Pasta
1-½ cup Garlic, Finely Minced
¼ cups Finely Chopped Purple Onion
⅓ cups Torn Fresh Basil Leaves

2 Tablespoons FOR THE DRESSING:

1 teaspoon Rough Chopped Sundried Tomatoes (use The Kind That Have Been Packed In Oil)

½ teaspoons White Granulated Sugar
⅛ teaspoons Granulated Onion Powder

name: Peach Mango White Iced Tea
ingredients:
12 cups Purified Water
5  White Tea Bags, Individual Serving Size Bags
2  Peaches, Pitted And Diced
1 cup Chopped Frozen Mangoes, Thawed
1 Tablespoon Granulated Sugar
¼ cups Granulated Sugar

name: Peachy Keen Slushie

1 cup Diced Peaches, Frozen
½ cups Cranberry Juice
¼ cups Orange Juice, Freshly Squeezed (for 1/4 Cup You'll Need  One Orange)
½ teaspoons Stevia To Taste
⅓ cups Water
1 cup Ice

name: Peanut Butter and Jelly Parfaits
ingredients:
4 whole Shortbread Cookies
½ cups Jelly (your Favorite Flavor)
1 Tablespoon Water
2 ounces, weight Cream Cheese
½ cups Powdered Sugar
½ cups Peanut Butter
¼ cups Milk
1 pinch Large Pinch Of Salt

ingredients:
½ cups Butter, Softened
¾ cups Sugar

name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Noodles
ingredients:
FOR THE CHICKEN SATAY
1 tablespoon reduced-sodium soy sauce
2 teaspoons cooking oil
2 garlic cloves, finely minced
1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
1 teaspoon ground cumin
freshly ground black pepper
2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut evenly into bite-sized pieces
wooden skewers, soaked in cold water for at least 10 minutes
FOR THE PEANUT NOODLES
1 teaspoon cooking oil
1 garlic cloves, finely minced
1 teaspoon finely minced red chile pepper
1/2 lime, juiced
2 tablespoons honey
1/4 cup  peanut butter

FOR THE CUCUMBER SALAD
1 medium cucumber, very thinly sliced

name: Broccolini, Spinach and Garlic Pasta
ingredients:
1/2 pound dry small pasta noodles
3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
2 tablespoons fresh minced garlic
5 ounce package fresh baby spinach leaves, stems removed
1/2 pound broccolini, steamed until fork tender
1 cup marinated artichoke hearts, drained
1/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan Cheese
1 teaspoon kosher salt
1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
1/4 teaspoon garlic salt
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil for additional drizzling

name: Triple Chocolate Cupcakes with Pink & Chocolate Swirled Frosting
ingredients:
(1) 18.5 ounce devil's food cake mix (I used Pillsbury Moist Supreme)
(1) 3.9 ounce box instant chocolate pudding
3/4 cup vegetable oil
1 cup sour cream
4 large eggs
1/2 cup strongly brewed coffee, cooled
2 Tablespoons water

2 pounds confectioners' sugar
8 to 10 Tablespoons milk, cold

1 box White Cake Mix, 18-20 Ounce Box (the Kind Without Pudding In The Mix)
1 box Instant Vanilla Pudding Mix (3.4 Oz Box)
8 Tablespoons Butter, Softened
2  Large Eggs
1 tub Red And Blue Food Coloring (I Love Wilton's Gel Food Coloring)
description: Festive and easy red, white and blue whoopie pies made with a cake mix and Cool Whip frosting.

name: Salmon Reuben Sandwich
ingredients:
8 ounces, weight Salmon, Uncooked
4 slices Rye Or Pumpernickel Bread
3 Tablespoons Margarine
4 Tablespoons Thousand Island Dressing
4 slices Swiss Cheese
3 Tablespoons Sauerkraut
description: I love the flavor combination that is a Reuben: sauerkraut, thousand island dressing, Swiss cheese and rye bread. But I am not a big fan of corned beef. So while watching a friend devour a Reuben the other evening I thought, “I wonder what this would be like with salmon?” Well, I tried it and was very pleased with the result. I tried this with both the traditional rye and pumpernickel.

name: Sautéed Calves’ Liver with Creamed Sweet Onion and Bacon
ingredients:
1 cup Panko Breadcrumbs
¼ cups All-purpose Flour
½ teaspoons Kosher Salt
½ teaspoons Freshly Ground Black Pepper
1 pound Calves Liver, Cut Into Slices About ½” Thick
1 cup Milk
8 slices Bacon, Cut Into 1” Pieces
2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter
½  Sweet Onion, Chopped In ¾” Dice
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 cup Madeira Wine
description: Calves’ liver is not everyone’s favorite but that may be because it was cooked too long. This recipe may change minds … it has bacon in it!

name: Simple  French Dressing

½ cups Ketchup
½ cups White Vinegar
1 cup Vegetable Oil
½ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Pepper
½ teaspoons Dry Mustard
½ teaspoons Garlic Salt
1 cup Sugar

name: Smoked Salmon Dip

4 ounces, weight Cream Cheese, At Room Temperature (low-fat Is Fine)
¼ cups Sour Cream (low Fat Is Fine)
1 teaspoon Lemon Juice
2 Tablespoons Minced Red Onion
1 Tablespoon Minced Fresh Dill, Plus More For Garnish
1 pinch Black Pepper
2 ounces, weight Smoked Salmon, Finely Chopped
description: This creamy-textured, slightly tangy and smoky-flavored dip is the perfect easy appetizer.

4 whole Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts

4 cloves Garlic, Pressed And Minced
10 ounces, weight Part-skim Ricotta Cheese

2 whole Olive Oil Spray

½  Medium Onion, Finely Chopped

½ cups Powdered Sugar
1 cup Vanilla Extract
description: Toasted Coconut Cake with Coconut Buttercream

ingredients:
2-¼ cups All-purpose Flour
½ teaspoons Kosher Salt
1-½ teaspoon Baking Powder
½ cups Unsalted Butter, Softened To Room Temperature
¾ cups Granulated Sugar
2 whole Eggs

1 whole Vanilla Bean, Seeds Only

12 ounces, weight Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips, Melted (optional)
description: This biscotti is anise-free, but does not lack in flavor. It is packed full of vanilla and almonds and dipped in a delicious dark chocolate.

1-¼ cup Whole Milk
⅛ teaspoons Kosher Salt

2 cups Heavy Cream

description: A New Orleans classic turned into a creamy and sweet frozen treat!

name: Tuscan Bean Salad with Green Olivada
ingredients:
1 clove Garlic, Chopped
4 ounces, weight Pitted Green Olives
1-½ Tablespoon Olive Oil
2 Tablespoons Red Wine Vinegar
1 teaspoon Fresh Lemon Juice
¼ teaspoons Dry Mustard

1 cup Water
1 pint Strawberries, Cleaned, Hulled And Chopped

2 cups White Whole Wheat Flour (or All-purpose Flour)
2-½ teaspoons Baking Powder

¼ teaspoons Salt
¼ cups Sugar

3  Red Potatoes, Cubed

2 whole Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts

5-½ cups Semi Frozen Cantaloupe Chunks

It rarely occurs to me over the summer, when there’s more eggplant/zucchini/tomatoes/peaches/plums/berries than anyone could fathom going through in the scant weeks they’re available, to wish I had more whole grains in my diet. And since we’re being honest, only occasionally in times that it probably should, such as in February, when refined flours and pasta are used to fill the endless gap in growing seasons. But, as it happens, because I’m terrible at timely meal-planning, I was attempting to make  for dinner a couple weeks ago and it wasn’t ready on time, or even close to it, and I remembered a one-pan linguine dish I’d read about in  that sounded fascinating. Realizing I had almost all the ingredients on hand, I rustled it up instead and felt like such a domestic diva, I nearly took a bow when I brought it out, but resisted, as I prefer to only drop  a season. In the dish, pasta, only enough water to cook it, an onion, garlic cloves, some cherry tomatoes, olive oil, basil, salt and red pepper flakes are combined cold, brought up to a boil and cooked until the pasta is  and everything else becomes the dish’s saucy servant, all in a single saucepan, all at once. I realize you’re all leaving me right now to make it this very moment, and I don’t blame you. At the very least, you need to  the recipe for when you’re in a pinch, and really, when is anyone not?

description: I realize that given the sheer number of two and three-layered, springform-bound and buttercream-shellacked  I keep in the archives, you’d imagine that I had some pretty spectacular birthday cakes growing up. You’d be correct, but they were almost never homemade, not because I was suffering from cake-neglect, but because the only one I requested every year for my birthday was an ice cream cake, preferably from Carvel. Okay,  from Carvel, you know, the one in the strip mall at the end of the main road. The Carvel ice cream cake was, to me, as perfect as a June birthday cake could be — a layer each of chocolate and vanilla ice creams, separated by a smattering of Oreo-ish cookie rubble, coated with a suspiciously unbuttery buttercream and scattered with colored sprinkles.
