ingredients:
½ cups White Quinoa (un-cooked)
1 cup Water
¾ cups Gluten Free Flour
2 Tablespoons Gluten Free Flour
½ cups Quinoa Flour
2 Tablespoons Cornstarch
2 teaspoons Baking Powder
1 teaspoon Sea Salt
¾ cups Coconut Palm Sugar
¼ teaspoons Cinnamon
2 Tablespoons Coconut Butter, Divided Use
2 whole Eggs
1 cup Almond Milk
1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
¼ cups Coconut Palm Sugar To Top With
description: Gluten-free, dairy-free treat!

name: Jennifer’s Sage and Beer Braised Beef Short Ribs over Cheese Tortellini
ingredients:
4 Tablespoons Olive Oil, Divided
1 pound Beef Short Ribs
½ cups All-purpose Flour
1 whole Red Pepper , Stem And Seeds Removed, Then Chopped
8 sticks Large Carrots, Chopped
1 whole Onion, Chopped
1 cup Beer (Budweiser Or Your Choice)
14 ounces, fluid Beef Stock (homemade Or Canned)
2 Tablespoons Fresh Sage (plus A Few Sprigs For Garnish)
1 Tablespoon Fresh Chives
2 pinches Salt And Pepper, to taste
1 package Cheese Tortellini, 8 Ounce Package
description: Hearty ribs over tortellini are perfect for fall cooking.

name: Dill, Chive and Chardonnay Chicken Salad on Buttermilk Herb Biscuits
ingredients:
2 cups FOR THE BISCUITS:
1 teaspoon All-purpose Flour
1 Tablespoon Sugar
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
¼ teaspoons Salt
¼ cups Black Pepper (optional)
¼ cups Fresh Chives, Chopped Fine
2 Tablespoons Fresh Parsley Chopped Fine
8 Tablespoons Fresh Dill, Chopped Fine
¾ cups Butter, Cubed
⅓ cups Buttermilk
⅛ cups FOR THE CHICKEN SALAD:
1 Tablespoon Mayonnaise
1 teaspoon Sour Cream
2 teaspoons Chardonnay Or Other Dry White Wine
⅛ teaspoons Apricot White Balsamic Vinegar (or Other Light Balsamic)
¼ teaspoons Fresh Lemon Juice
1 Tablespoon Salt
1 Tablespoon Pepper
1 Tablespoon Fresh Chives, Chopped Fine
¼ cups Fresh Dill, Chopped Fine
¼ cups Fresh Lemon Verbena, Chopped Fine
1-½ cup Onion, Chopped
description: Buttermilk biscuits packed with herb-infused chicken salad.

name: Stuffed Green Pepper Soup
ingredients:
2 tablespoons vegetable oil
3 green bell peppers, diced small
1 onion, diced small
1 clove garlic, minced
2 1/2 pounds ground beef
3 quarts water
2 (29 ounce) cans tomato sauce
2 (28 ounce) cans petite diced tomatoes in juice
1/2 cup ketchup
1/2 cup beef base
1/4 cup brown sugar
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
4 cups water
2 cups brown rice
description: "I gave some of this soup to a neighbor who said that her husband probably wouldn't eat it as it had onions in it. She said he tried it, loved it, and asked me for the recipe. I have used instant brown rice, and it worked fine."

name: How to Make Focaccia
ingredients:
1 (.25 ounce) package active dry yeast
1 cup warm water (105 degrees F/41 degrees C)
6 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided
3/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 cup semolina flour
2 teaspoons minced fresh rosemary  (optional)
2 3/4 cups bread flour, divided
1 teaspoon extra-virgin olive oil
3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided
2 teaspoons minced fresh rosemary
1 teaspoon coarse sea salt, or to taste
description: See how to make a light Italian yeast bread with delightful dimples.

name: Strawberry Shooters
ingredients:
1 (750 milliliter) bottle amaretto liqueur
1 (1 pound) fresh strawberries, hulled and cored
1 (7 ounce) can whipped cream (such as Reddi-Whip®)
description: "Tried this at a country music festival and loved it! Easy, a little messy, but oh so worth it! Eat whole, all at once. This will seem like quite the mouthful, but will taste amazing! Enjoy."

name: How to Make Beef Satay
ingredients:
1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root
4 cloves garlic, crushed
2 tablespoons minced onion
1/4 cup packed brown sugar
1/4 cup fish sauce
2 tablespoons vegetable oil
2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 tablespoons ground coriander
1 tablespoon ground cumin
1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric
1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
1 2-inch piece of fresh lemon grass (white part only)
2 pounds beef top sirloin, trimmed
4 12-inch long metal skewers
description: An incredibly delicious marinade makes amazing grilled beef satay.

name: Butternut Squash and Black Bean Stew with Tomatoes and Green Beans
ingredients:
2 teaspoons vegetable oil
1 medium onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 pounds butternut squash, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces
1 (14.5 ounce) can Del Monte® Diced Tomatoes with Zesty Mild Green Chilies, undrained
1 (14.5 ounce) can vegetable broth
1/2 cup water
1 teaspoon ground cumin
1 teaspoon dried oregano
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
1 (14.5 ounce) can Del Monte® French-Cut Seasoned Green Beans with Roasted Garlic, undrained
1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
Hot cooked couscous
Chopped fresh cilantro  (optional)
description: "Cubes of butternut squash are simmered in a zesty tomato sauce with spices, green beans and black beans and served over couscous."

name: Kale Pesto English Muffin Pizza
ingredients:
1 bunch kale, stems removed and discarded
4 cloves garlic
1/4 cup shredded Parmesan cheese
8 whole wheat English muffins, split
2 cooked chicken breasts, diced
1 cup sliced fresh mozzarella cheese
description: "Healthy pizzas, if you are new to kale this is a great way to try it!"

name: Cucumber Orange Carrot Juice
ingredients:
1 large navel orange
2 carrots, roughly chopped
1/2 cucumber, roughly chopped
1/2 cup water, or as needed
1/4 cup white sugar, or to taste
1 teaspoon lemon juice  (optional)
description:
"This is a delicious juice my husband and I make for breakfast or an after-meal dessert when guests are over. It's not only delicious, but will perk up any bad day with a boost of vitamins and nutrients that you may otherwise skip out on. I hope you try it, and enjoy! 

Recipe makes 2 tall glasses or 4 smaller glasses of juice. 

You need a blender."

name: Sweet Dark Cherry Cobbler
ingredients:
Filling:
1/2 cup white sugar
2 tablespoons cornstarch
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
3/4 cup water
1 (12 ounce) bag frozen pitted dark sweet cherries, thawed
1 tablespoon butter
Topping:
1 cup all-purpose flour
1/4 cup white sugar, divided
2 teaspoons baking powder
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup milk
3 tablespoons shortening
description: "You can try several variations of this, like using blueberries instead of cherries. Serve warm with ice cream."

name: Big-Batch Roquefort Dressing
ingredients:
5 cups mayonnaise
1 cup sour cream
1 cup buttermilk
6 green onions, chopped
1 clove garlic, chopped
1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
salt and ground black pepper to taste
5 ounces crumbled Roquefort cheese
description: "According to family legend, this recipe came from the El Gaucho restaurant in Seattle, about 50 years ago. It has been a family favorite ever since! It's a wonderful salad dressing, and a top-notch dip as well. Store in glass jars in the refrigerator."

name: Cuban Chicken
ingredients:
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, chopped
1 (14.5 ounce) can diced tomatoes
1 (12 ounce) can chicken chunks, drained
1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper
1/2 cup raisins
1/2 cup stuffed green olives, sliced
1 tablespoon red wine vinegar
1 teaspoon ground oregano
1/4 teaspoon ground cumin
2 bay leaves
description: "An unusual combination of ingredients. Yummy! Serve over rice. You can put rice into the pot to cook with everything else, but add 2 cups chicken broth and simmer 20 minutes until the rice is done. One fewer pot to wash!"

name: Pesto Alfredo Sauce
ingredients:
1 cup half-and-half
1/4 cup prepared pesto
2 tablespoons butter
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1/8 teaspoon salt
1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper
description: "This simple alfredo sauce is quick and full of flavor. Not as thick as traditional sauce but it also doesn't have as much fat or calories. Serve over cooked fettuccine noodles and sprinkle with Parmesan."

name: Ultra Easy Pineapple Chicken Kabobs
ingredients:
1 green bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
1/2 onion, cut into 1-inch pieces
1/2 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 (15 ounce) can pineapple chunks, drained
1/4 cup barbeque sauce, or as needed
6 skewers
description: "For people who love chicken, pineapple, and pepper."

name: Super Special Chicken
ingredients:
butter-flavored cooking spray
2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, each cut into quarters
1/2 cup fat-free French dressing (such as Kraft®)
1/4 cup reduced-sodium ketchup
2 teaspoons dried onion flakes
1 teaspoon chili seasoning
1 teaspoon dried parsley flakes
1 (15 ounce) can green beans, drained
description: "I do not know where my mother got this recipe, but the first time my mother made this recipe she refused to tell us the ingredients. Knowing how picky we were at the time, it was a good thing she did. I now make this recipe and add some green beans near the end. The sauce results in juicy chicken that is just spicy enough."

name: Baghdad Beef Stew
ingredients:
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
1 pound cubed beef stew meat
1 (17 ounce) can figs, drained (reserve juice) and chopped
1 3/4 cups water, or as needed
1 cup sliced carrots
3/4 cup sliced onion
6 green onions, chopped
1/2 teaspoon ground coriander
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 cup honey
2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
1 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
1 cup sliced almonds
description: "One of my most-requested recipes! Serve over egg pastina pasta. It's the same as couscous but much less expensive! If it's too thick for you, add more water when reheating."

name: Edamame Succotash
ingredients:
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 medium onion, chopped
1 medium yellow or red bell pepper, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 (14.5 ounce) can Del Monte® Diced Tomatoes, undrained
1 (15.25 ounce) can Del Monte® Southwest Corn with Poblano and Red Peppers, drained
2 cups frozen edamame, thawed
1 teaspoon dried thyme
Salt and black pepper
Bottled hot pepper sauce
description: "Here's a southwest twist on a classic side dish, using edamame instead of lima beans, and a dash of pepper sauce for a bit of heat."

name: Toffee Brickle Cookies
ingredients:
2 large eggs
1/2 cup margarine, softened
1 (15.25 ounce) package yellow cake mix
1 (6 ounce) package toffee baking bits
1/2 cup chopped pecans
1 tablespoon water
description: "A delicious cookie that is soft and melts in your mouth. Easy to prepare with few ingredients needed. Everyone's favorite! Sure to please!"

name: Honey Bunch Bread
ingredients:
2 3/4 cups warm water (110 degrees F/45 degrees C)
1/2 cup honey
2 tablespoons active dry yeast
1/3 cup vegetable oil
1 tablespoon salt
6 cups all-purpose flour, or more as needed
description: "This is our family's favorite bread recipe; it was obtained from one of my fathers coworkers."

name: Fresh Raspberry Apple Cobbler
ingredients:
Filling:
6 cups chopped apples
2 cups raspberries
2 tablespoons white sugar, or to taste
1 tablespoon lemon juice
1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
Topping:
1 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 cup oats
1/4 cup brown sugar
3 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
2 tablespoons ground flax seeds  (optional)
2 tablespoons milk
2 tablespoons yogurt
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/8 teaspoon baking soda
description: "A healthier version of fruit cobbler where the fruit is emphasized by reducing the sugar. I made this with the wild raspberries from my backyard, and it was delicious! If you want to really taste the fruit in your cobbler, this is a good one to try!"

name: Fruit Salad with Mint Honey-Lime Dressing
ingredients:
1/3 cup mint honey (if available), or other light honey
1/3 cup fresh lime juice
1/2 cup plain low-fat yogurt
2 teaspoons grated lime zest
1 tablespoon high-quality balsamic vinegar

Fruit Salad:
4 cups cubed cantaloupe
4 cups cubed honeydew
3 cups seedless red grapes
3 cups pineapple, peeled, cored, and diced
1 medium papaya, peeled and cubed
1 1/2 cups fresh strawberries, halved
8 fresh mint sprigs, or as needed
description: "Freshen up your summer salad with a honey-lime dressing. Surprisingly sweet, the honey heightens the freshness of summer's best picks."

name: Linguini with Honey-Sauced Prawns
ingredients:
1 pound prawns, peeled and deveined
1/2 cup julienne carrots
1/2 cup julienne celery
1/2 cup diagonally sliced green onions
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tablespoons olive oil
1/2 cup water
1/4 cup honey
4 teaspoons cornstarch
1 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
1/4 teaspoon crushed dried rosemary leaves
1 pound cooked linguine pasta, kept warm
description: "A quarter cup of honey is all it takes to brighten this dish. By adding a hint of sweetness, the linguini and sauce make a deliciously balanced bite."

name: Easy Creamy Zucchini Soup
ingredients:
3 pounds zucchini, sliced
2 cups water
1 (14.5 ounce) can chicken broth
1 large onion, chopped
4 slices bacon, cut into small pieces
3 cloves garlic, chopped
2 teaspoons salt
1 teaspoon ground black pepper
1 teaspoon dried basil
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese, or to taste
description: "Creamy soup that is super easy to make in one pot. I have also tried adding a teaspoon of red pepper flakes for a little extra heat."

name: Tomato and Almond Gazpacho
ingredients:
3 cups diced vine-ripened tomatoes
3 cups chopped cucumber, seeds removed but not peeled
1 cup diced red onion
1 clove garlic, sliced
3 cups tomato juice
1 tablespoon salt
3 tablespoons sherry vinegar
2/3 cup Dannon Oikos Plain Greek Nonfat Yogurt
1 cup sliced almonds, toasted
Country bread or French baguette
Olive oil for toasting
description: "Juicy, vine-ripened tomatoes, cucumbers, tomato juice and a touch of sherry vinegar make a delicious summer gazpacho, and Greek-style yogurt adds a tangy creaminess."

name: Bacon Wrapped Citrus Shrimp
ingredients:
1 (8 ounce) can pineapple chunks, drained
12 jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
6 slices bacon, halved crosswise
12 toothpicks
1/2 cup lime vinaigrette dressing
1/4 cup chopped green onion
description: "Jumbo shrimp wrapped in bacon with a pineapple chunk are quickly marinated in a lime vinaigrette before being pan-fried to a crisp in this easy appetizer."

name: Pho Ginger and Lime Soup
ingredients:
2 teaspoons sesame oil, divided
1 (4 inch) piece fresh ginger, peeled and chopped, or to taste
3 quarts chicken broth
1 large red onion, diced
2 cups sliced carrots
1 tablespoon curry powder
1 tablespoon ground ginger
1 tablespoon cayenne pepper
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 jalapeno pepper, finely chopped
6 limes, juiced, divided
1 (9 ounce) package udon noodles
4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cubed
1 leek, cut into matchstick-size pieces
1 green onion, finely chopped
description: "Very healthy soup! I came up with the idea myself and, once I tried it, I knew that I had a winner here. It is somewhat spicy and is very, very good for if you have a cold, would like to warm up in the winter, or to clear your nose."

name: Lucky's Quickie Chickie
ingredients:
2 teaspoons olive oil
6 ounces chicken tenderloin strips
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/8 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil
1 1/2 teaspoons honey
1 1/2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar, or more to taste
description: "Fresh basil is essential to get that fresh burst of flavor with a hint of sweet and sour in this dish. The ingredients are all on hand when my herb garden is in season! Add a salad and a favorite vegetable for a quick weeknight meal."

name: Fabienne's Barbecued 'Papcinna' Drumsticks
ingredients:
1/4 cup olive oil
2 tablespoons cider vinegar
1 tablespoon paprika
1 tablespoon basil
1 teaspoon celery salt
1 teaspoon mustard powder
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
8 chicken drumsticks
description: "Cinnamon's subtle flavor compliments the basil and paprika's aromas in this original marinade. The apple cider vinegar adds its special touch and ties everything together in a mouthwatering experience. A must try! Basting brings out the flavors so be sure not to omit these steps!"

name: Wickwire Guacamole
ingredients:
1 Hass avocado, mashed
1 tablespoon mayonnaise (such as Hellman's®), or more to taste
freshly ground black pepper to taste
1 dash hot pepper sauce, or to taste  (optional)
description: "This has been our family's favorite guacamole for over thirty years. It's a little weird, but trust me. You'll love it!"

name: Randy's Amazing Avocado Dip
ingredients:
3 avocados, mashed
1 pint sour cream
1 (16 ounce) jar green salsa (such as Bobby Salazar's® Chile Verde Salsa), or to taste
1 (8 ounce) package shredded Mexican cheese blend
1/2 tomato, diced small
1/4 red onion, finely chopped
description: "This is an amazing and delicious avocado dip. Randy, a nurse I work with, gave me his original recipe and said I could share it. It makes a lot so you might cut in half but not the avocados. For extra flavor add Poco Pica® taco sauce."

name: Watermelon Cooler
ingredients: 1 small watermelon, seeded and cubed
description: "Refreshing and healthy! Works best served with big straws! Feel free to leave some big chunks."

name: Broomstick Dip
ingredients:
1 cup smooth peanut butter
1 cup chocolate-hazelnut spread (such as Nutella®)
1/2 cup oatmeal cereal squares (such as Quaker® Oatmeal Squares), crushed
1 (16 ounce) bag small pretzel rods
description: "An easy to put together dessert dip that is perfect for a Halloween party or fun snack. The pretzels look like broomsticks after they have dipped into this yummy, crunch dip."

name: Butter Biscuit Peach Cobbler
ingredients:
2 (29 ounce) cans peaches
3/4 cup white sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup unsalted butter
1 tablespoon cornstarch
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
1 pinch salt
1 (16 ounce) can refrigerated buttermilk biscuit dough (such as Pillsbury Grands!®)
1 pinch ground cinnamon
1 pinch white sugar
1 pinch ground nutmeg
1 pastry for a 9-inch pie crust
description: "This is my grandmother's southern homemade peach cobbler recipe handed down to my mother in Louisiana. It's made with cinnamon, nutmeg, and buttery morsels of biscuit bits. It tastes great on its own, but even better with vanilla ice cream, a la mode."

name: Tex-Mex Migas
ingredients:
1 tablespoon butter
1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chiles
1/2 tomato, chopped
6 large eggs
1/4 cup crushed tortilla chips, or to taste
1/4 cup shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
6 (8 inch) flour tortillas
6 tablespoons taco sauce, or to taste  (optional)
description: "A favorite for breakfast or brunch in central Texas."

name: Moroccan Semolina Soup with Milk, Anise Seeds, and Honey
ingredients:
4 cups water
3/4 cup coarse semolina flour
1 1/4 teaspoons salt, or to taste
3 cups milk
2 tablespoons butter
1 teaspoon anise seed, or more to taste
description: "This simple Moroccan soup is easy to prepare and can be served in the evening or for breakfast. Serve warm with honey on the side. If desired, sweeten the soup with the honey. Garnish with cinnamon. The soup will thicken as it cools. Stir in additional water to thin the soup when reheating."

name: Andy's Prosciutto Scallops
ingredients:
1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil
1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes
2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil leaves
2 tablespoons chopped black olives
12 sea scallops
2 teaspoons seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
12 slices prosciutto
description: "If you like bacon-wrapped scallops, you will love these. They are a little more expensive to make but well worth it!"

name: Bacon Wrapped Artichoke Hearts
ingredients:
8 cups peanut oil for frying
1 (16 ounce) can artichoke hearts in water, drained
1 (16 ounce) package bacon slices, cut into thirds crosswise
20 toothpicks
description: "This is an extremely tasty and easy appetizer for any occasion. Despite some people's hesitation to try it, it always turns out to be a big hit at parties and get-togethers."

name: Sweet and Crunchy Popcorn Snack Mix
ingredients:
waxed paper
2 cups crispy corn and rice cereal (such as Crispix®)
2 cups honey graham cereal (such as Golden Grahams®)
2 cups peanut butter corn puff cereal (such as Reese's Puffs®)
2 cups popped popcorn, or more to taste  (optional)
8 ounces candy-coated milk chocolate pieces (such as M&M's®)
1 cup salted peanuts
1/2 cup butter
2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
1 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup corn syrup
1/2 cup peanut butter
description: "This sweet and crunchy snack not only tastes great but looks so appealing that when I serve it at tailgating parties, passers-by stop and ask for the recipe."

name: Caribbean Couscous
ingredients:
1/2 cup chopped pecans
2 tablespoons oil
1 (4 ounce) can mushrooms, drained and liquid reserved
1 large sweet potato, peeled and grated
1 1/2 cups vegetable stock
1 orange, zested and juiced
2 green onions, sliced
1/4 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
1/2 teaspoon poultry seasoning
1/2 teaspoon ground cumin
1 pinch ground allspice
3/4 cup couscous
1/3 cup chopped dried mixed fruit
1/4 cup shredded coconut
1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
description: "An unusual combination of ingredients. It's worth the effort."

name: Chicken in Tomato Herb Cream
ingredients:
1/2 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 pinch cayenne pepper, or more to taste
4 tablespoons butter
1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into chunks
1 shallot, minced
1/2 cup white wine
1 cup chopped tomatoes
1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice
1 cup heavy whipping cream
2 teaspoons chopped fresh tarragon
description: "Fresh herbs are essential! Tarragon is especially good. Using different herbs makes this a new dish each time."

name: Spooky Halloween Eyes
ingredients:
12 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and halved
1/4 cup mayonnaise, or as needed
1 teaspoon red food coloring, or as needed
1 teaspoon blue food coloring, or as needed
1 teaspoon black food coloring, or as needed
description: "These festive hardboiled eggs are fun and easy to make. Sure to be a hit at any Halloween party."

name: Date and Fig Quick Bread
ingredients:
1/2 cup chopped walnuts
1 cup dates, pitted and chopped
1 cup chopped dried figs
1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened
1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda
1 cup boiling water
1/2 cup white sugar
2 large eggs, room temperature
3/4 cup all-purpose flour
3/4 cup whole wheat flour
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
description: "A bit unusual but good all the same. You may substitute plumped raisins for the figs if you like. You may also use Splenda®. To prevent crumbling, use finely diced dates or boil whole dates for 10 minutes before chopping. Serve with cream cheese."

name: Slow Cooker Cranberry Fig Pork
ingredients:
4 (4 ounce) pork chops
1 cup frozen cranberries
3 canned figs, 1/4 cup juice reserved
1/2 cup apple juice
2 tablespoons brown sugar
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
1/4 teaspoon dried rosemary
description: "An easy slow cooker recipe! Serve over rice if desired."

name: Portobello Chicken
ingredients:
1 tablespoon olive oil
3 portobello mushrooms, cut into strips
1 (750 milliliter) bottle Merlot wine
4 cooked chicken breast halves
4 slices provolone cheese
description: "A quick and easy but delicious dinner entree perfect for surprise guests. I serve with wild rice and use the leftover sauce in the rice. Do not use too much seasoning on the chicken, otherwise the dish turns out too salty."

name: Oriental Spicy Chicken Wings
ingredients:
1/4 cup Asian chile paste (such as sambal oelek)
2 tablespoons fish sauce
2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 teaspoons chopped garlic
1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger
1 lime, juiced
2 1/2 pounds jumbo chicken wings, tips removed
description: "WARNING: SPICY..We ate them so fast we didn't get a picture. Hubby said: 'I hope you wrote this one down'."

name: Grilled Country Style Ribs
ingredients:
1/2 cup Burgundy wine
1/4 cup barbeque sauce, plus more for basting
1/4 cup cider vinegar
1/4 cup hot pepper sauce
2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard
4 pounds country-style pork ribs
1 tablespoon onion powder
1 tablespoon garlic powder
description: "Been fixin' ribs for a long time and never had a complaint; they just kept comin' back for more."

name: Easy Lemon Lover's Bundt® Cake
ingredients:
1 (18.25 ounce) package lemon cake mix
1 cup sour cream
1/2 cup vegetable oil
1/2 cup freshly squeezed lemon juice
4 large eggs
1 (3 ounce) package instant lemon pudding mix
zest of 1 lemon, or more to taste
1 tablespoon poppy seeds, or more to taste  (optional)
1/2 teaspoon lemon extract
description: "This is the best I have come up with to mimic Starbucks'® Lemon Cake. Family and friends agree, and it is so easy."

name: Honey Vanilla Grilled Sweet Potatoes
ingredients:
2 large sweet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
3 tablespoons butter, melted
2 tablespoons ground cinnamon
1/3 cup honey
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
description: "A great way to bring a normally fall side right into spring and summer. The flavors are light and simply delish!"

name: Paleo(ish) Pumpkin Walnut Muffins - Duplicate
ingredients:
1/2 cup pumpkin puree
1/2 cup coconut flour
1/4 cup coconut oil
1/4 cup agave nectar, or more to taste
6 eggs
1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1 pinch pumpkin pie spice, or to taste
1 cup chopped walnuts  (optional)
description: "Pumpkin muffins modified from another recipe I found so it is gluten-free and pretty clean in terms of diet."

name: Refrigerator Raspberry Oatmeal
ingredients:
1/3 cup skim milk
1/4 cup old-fashioned oats
1/4 cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tablespoon low-sugar raspberry preserves
1 1/2 teaspoons chia seeds
1/4 teaspoon almond extract
1/3 cup sliced raspberries
description: "You can really use any combination of preserves, extract and berries you like. The oatmeal absorbs all the liquid overnight, and becomes almost pudding-like. My husband, who has an intense dislike for cooked oatmeal, loves this. Chia seeds can be found in most health food or Whole Foods®-type stores."

name: Super Veggie Juice With A Kick
ingredients:
2 large carrots, ends trimmed
2 large celery stalks
1/2 beet
1/4 green bell pepper
1/4 apple
1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh ginger  (optional)
description: "A healthy and flavorful fresh juice to help you load up on those servings of veggies that may otherwise be difficult to consume. Add some ginger for a little kick. It's better if they're all chilled before juicing or shake the juice in a cocktail shaker with some ice just to chill, then strain the ice out before drinking."

name: Banana Pancake Pops
ingredients:
1 cup vegetable oil for frying, or as needed
1 3/4 cups pancake mix
1 cup water, or as needed
2 bananas, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
1/4 cup white sugar
1/4 cup ground cinnamon
description: "Banana pancake pops will cook easy and taste great. Warning: very addictive once tried. Don't worry if the first couple are darker then the rest. You'll get used to how long they should fry."

name: Chia Seed Chips
ingredients:
1 cup whole wheat flour
1/2 cup chia seeds
1 1/2 teaspoons seasoned salt
1 teaspoon sea salt
1/2 cup water
1 pinch seasoned salt
description: "While waiting for a batch of crackers to finish baking, I was playing with the remaining dough and forming bite-size rounds and though they would make great chips (and they do -- they're amazing!). These chips should keep for about a week if stored properly."

name: Rotisserie Ragout
ingredients:
1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed
6 green onions, chopped
1 stalk celery with leaves, chopped
1 jalapeno pepper - stemmed, seeded, and diced
3 cloves garlic, chopped
1 pinch chili powder, or to taste
1 cup chicken broth
3/4 cup coconut water
1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
1 1/2 cups diced cooked rotisserie chicken
2 tablespoons chia seeds
description: "A little leftover rotisserie chicken makes a zesty stew."

name: Bean Bake
ingredients:
1 pound ground beef chuck
1 small onion, minced  (optional)
1 (16 ounce) can lima beans, drained
1 (10.75 ounce) can tomato soup
1/4 cup brown sugar, or to taste
3 slices bacon
description: "This is my mother-in-law's recipe; she is the queen of canned cooking! This recipe may sound yucky, but it's really quick and yummy. My kids love this and it is easy for beginning cooks. Delicious served with cornbread and a garden salad."

name: Indian-Style Mousse
ingredients:
2 cups heavy whipping cream
3/4 cup white sugar, divided
2 tablespoons rose water
1 teaspoon ground coriander
3 pinches ground cardamom
4 egg whites
description: "Light as air and takes no work to prepare! Need something that tastes Indian but don't like the more authentic options? Try this!"

name: Lekman Cocktail
ingredients:
5 fluid ounces lingonberry juice
1 1/2 fluid ounces vodka (such as Absolut®)
1/2 fluid ounce blue Curacao liqueur
1 cup ice, or as needed
1 sour key candy
description: "This cocktail was invented in May 2013 in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Its name, ingredients, and colour are inspired by the eponymous Ikea® product. The recipe is the outcome of a rhetorical question posed while assembling Ikea® furniture 'If the Lekman were a drink, what would be in it?.'"

name: Penne with Peas and Pancetta

6 ounces dried penne pasta

name: Corn and Poblano Spoon Bread

1 teaspoon butter

1 1/2 cups water
3/4 cup cornmeal
1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (8 ounce) carton sour cream

description: "Fresh poblano chiles, shredded cheese, and spicy southwest-style corn make an easy and delicious spoon bread."

name: Chopped Salad Sub Sandwich

2 tablespoons white wine vinegar

1 (14.5 ounce) can Del Monte® Diced Tomatoes with Basil, Garlic & Oregano, drained

4 (1/2 inch thick) slices Italian or French bread, toasted

name: Peach Dutch Baby with Blueberry Compote

name: Turkey Green Bean Chili with Cheesy Corn Fritters

name: Old Mama's Fashioned Chili
ingredients:
1 pound ground beef
2 (15 ounce) cans black beans, undrained
2 (15 ounce) cans kidney beans, undrained
2 (14.5 ounce) cans stewed tomatoes, undrained
2 green bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch dice

salt and ground black pepper to taste

name: Strawberry Fig Preserve
ingredients:
3 cups mashed fresh ripe figs
3 cups white sugar
2 (3 ounce) packages strawberry flavored gelatin (such as Jell-O®)
6 half pint canning jars with lids and rings
description: "Using fresh figs and strawberry Jell-O, this is a very easy preserve recipe."

name: Tomato Zucchini Soup
ingredients:
1 (26 ounce) can tomato soup
26 fluid ounces milk
1 (14.5 ounce) can zucchini in Italian-style tomato sauce
1 1/2 teaspoons dried basil
1 teaspoon minced garlic
4 slices Swiss cheese
description: "It's a grown-up version of tomato soup. My husband came up with this for a quick and easy meal idea. It is very versatile. You can add spinach if you prefer. Serve with the traditional grilled cheese or any other sandwich to complete it. It also makes great next-day leftovers."

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup in the Slow Cooker
ingredients:
1 tablespoon olive oil
4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into cubes
1 large onion, chopped
2 (16 ounce) cans refried beans

shredded Cheddar cheese, or as needed
description: "Delicious and easy to make. You can spice it up as much as you want with hot sauce. Serve with tortilla chips."

name: Short Ribs with Honey Chimichurri Sauce
ingredients:
1 cup dark honey
1 bay leaf, finely chopped
1 pint extra-virgin olive oil

3 tablespoons garlic

lemon, for juice and zest

Fresh cilantro, for garnish

name: Honey-Vanilla Bean Cheesecake
ingredients:
For Crust:
8 tablespoons unsalted butter
2 1/4 cups whole wheat flour
1/2 cup light brown sugar

For Filling:

name: Bacon Wrapped Bananas
ingredients:
1/4 cup soy sauce
1 tablespoon honey
4 ripe bananas, each cut into 5 chunks
10 slices bacon, halved crosswise
20 toothpicks
description:
"Hawaiian-style appetizer great for parties.
 This recipe was given to me by my mother-in-law and is a huge hit with everyone!"

name: Blueberry Cream Cheese Cake
ingredients:
1 (18.25 ounce) package yellow cake mix
1 cup water
3 large eggs
1/3 cup vegetable oil
Filling:
1/2 cup white sugar
1 teaspoon cornstarch
1/3 cup water
2 cups fresh blueberries
Icing:
1 (16 ounce) package confectioners' sugar
1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, softened
1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract

name: Zucchini Mint Salad

1 small zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch rounds

salt to taste
1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil

ground black pepper to taste
description: "If you're looking for one more color on the table, here's your answer. It is super easy and takes only 10 minutes!"

name: No Bake Strawberry Cheesecake
ingredients:
1 (3 ounce) package strawberry-flavored gelatin (such as Jell-O®)
1 cup boiling water

cooking spray
1/4 cup brown sugar

8 bone-in chicken breast halves, with skin

3 cups peeled, sliced peaches

name: Blue Cheese and Beef Meatballs
ingredients:
1 1/2 pounds ground beef
1 cup fresh bread crumbs
2 eggs
4 ounces crumbled blue cheese
1/2 cup diced onion
1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper
salt to taste
description:
"Juicy meatballs with tasty bursts of blue cheese and onion. My own recipe, and my husband absolutely loves them.
Good enough to eat alone. 
I personally think they would also be good in hoagie sandwiches."

name: Chocolate Covered Gingersnaps
ingredients:
1 pound chocolate almond bark
2 (16 ounce) packages gingersnap cookies
description: "A variation on the famous chocolate mint cookies. Quick and easy to make and easy clean up! A freezing tray to rest the dipped cookies will keep the bottoms neat-looking."

name: Beet and Carrot Lentil Salad
ingredients:
1 cup water, or as needed
3 small beets, greens removed
3 cups water
1 cup French lentils
1/2 teaspoon salt
5 vine-ripened tomatoes, chopped
4 carrots, shredded
1/2 bunch fresh cilantro, finely chopped
5 green onions, chopped
3 lemons, zested and juiced
description: "I created this healthy recipe from scratch a few years ago, and it has always been a hit at parties. Now I am happy to share it and I hope you will enjoy it too! Garnish with cilantro sprigs and lemon wedges to serve."

name: Zucchini Plum Bread
ingredients:
2 cups shredded zucchini

2 teaspoons vanilla extract
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 cup whole wheat flour

description: "This delicious bread is a great way to use late summer produce and a big hit with the whole family. It can also be made into a lower sugar version by replacing the white sugar with a bake-able sugar substitute."

name: Chocolate Avocado Pudding

2 large avocados - peeled, pitted, and cubed
1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/3 cup coconut milk
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 pinch ground cinnamon
description: "Saw this at the market the other day. The ingredients were simple and it looked delicious! Many substitutes abound (liquid, sweetener, spices). Vary amounts to taste!"

name: Vanilla Pumpkin Pudding
ingredients:
2 cups pumpkin puree
1/2 cup white sugar

description: "I found directions online for cooking and freezing pumpkin after Halloween one year. I collected several pumpkins that did not get carved and cooked and froze a ton, hence the need for pumpkin recipes. I put this recipe together myself while in a creative mood one night. I am surprised I do not see more recipes using French vanilla coffee flavoring; it adds a nice touch."

name: Reindeer Food
ingredients:
1 (20 ounce) package miniature pretzels

Sour cream
Guacamole
Salsa
Lime wedges
description: "Tender, slow-cooked shredded beef is served on warm tortillas with bell pepper strips with tomatoes."

name: Creamy Green Beans with Crunchy Pita Strips

2 tablespoons butter

name: Meatballs Divine
ingredients:
1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
2 large eggs

6 leaves fresh basil, or to taste

1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt

description: "These are amazing and nothing amazing is ever easy; keep that in mind when you undertake this recipe. Try to avoid tasting them before you're ready to serve because you may end up eating them all and your guests will be left with only marinara and pasta. I make this recipe as written, then I freeze half of it when combined as it makes about 40-50, 1 1/2-inch meatballs (enough to feed Sicily.) If you won't be freezing half, then use more sauce to cover all the meatballs. Serve over your favorite pasta, or try it with provolone on a meatball sub."

name: Club Sandwich Salad with Corn and Feta

1 (15.25 ounce) can Del Monte® Whole Kernel Corn, drained

Oregano Vinaigrette:

Salt and black pepper
description: "The flavors of a club sandwich, including bacon, corn, and feta cheese, are captured in this colorful and tasty salad."

1 (15.25 ounce) can Del Monte® Canned Pears in Heavy Syrup or Del Monte® Lite Sliced Pears

6 cups grapeseed oil for frying, or as needed

1 1/2 teaspoons milk, or as needed
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
description: See how Chef John prepares craze-worthy cronuts!

name: Jalapeno Fudge

6 eggs
1 1/4 pounds shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (4 ounce) can canned diced jalapeno peppers
description: "My mom used to feed this to me as a baby, strangely enough."

name: Kielbasa Onion Soup

1 tablespoon olive oil

1 tablespoon minced garlic
3 (14 ounce) cans vegetable broth
1 (14 ounce) can stewed tomatoes
1 1/2 cups chopped carrots
1 (8 ounce) can tomato sauce
1 cup water

name: Bop's Broccoli Cauliflower Salad

description:
"A nice crunch in this salad, real bacon bits, diced broccoli, cauliflower, shredded sharp Cheddar cheese and onion are tossed with a yummy, sweet, and tart dressing and chilled. 

Be prepared to give this recipe to everyone when taking it to a covered dish gathering. It is the hit of the party at every gathering I've taken it to! It is very addicting! Enjoy!"

name: Fern's Tuna Casserole

description: "Nothing fancy here, but really great comfort food from my husband's Grandma. Good old tuna casserole with potato chips on top."

"I was a young boy on 4-H in California and when it came time to do my first demonstration I chose my first love....cooking!
 This recipe is great for kids' taste buds, but can be 'Mitch'ed' up, as my wife would call it, to suit the more refined taste buds of the adults in the house. Serve on a paper plate with favorite potato chips or have Mom make your favorite macaroni or potato salad."

name: Spiced Spider Cupcakes

Spice Cake:
3 cups all-purpose flour
2 cups white sugar
2 teaspoons baking soda
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg
2 cups water
2/3 cup canola oil

Cream Cheese Frosting:
2 (3 ounce) packages cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup butter, softened

Decorations:
1 (.68 oz. tube) black decorating gel

black shoestring licorice

name: Pineapple and Pecan Cake

My husband said these were light and fluffy pancakes the first time I made them. It must be the extra baking powder, or the butter instead of oil in the mix. 

Two pancakes per serving here, but a pancake stack is three or more! We use a brand of syrup that is made without high fructose corn syrup. Syrup is important!"

name: Costa del Sol Barbeque Sauce

1 1/2 cups ketchup

name: Mexican Bison Bake with Cilantro-Lime Cream

6 ounces dried penne pasta

1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained

3/4 cup salsa
1 teaspoon dried oregano

It does require some special ingredients, including milk powder (nonfat dry milk powder can be found at most grocery stories, but I used whole milk powder which can be found at health food stores. The nonfat will work though – just makes sure it’s crushed to a fine powder as the nonfat stuff has a habit of clumping up.) Freeze dried blueberries can also be found at upscale and specialty markets like Whole Foods or Trader Joe’s. If you can’t find it, just skip it. The milk crumble won’t have the blueberry punch but it’ll still be pretty awesome.

description: A buckle is basically a coffee cake with a streusel crumb topping that gives the cake a buckled or crumbled topping. Occasionally you find the same recipe called a crumble but that name just confuses me so I stick with buckle. Plus a “buckle” is such an old fashioned name, one that you expect your grandmother or great aunt to use when they make it and offer it to you along with tea (well, not my grandmother, as she’s more likely to have offered me a tea egg but that’s neither here nor there). But there’s something warm and comforting getting served a slice of warm buckle made with fresh fruit. If fresh cherries aren’t available or are out of season, feel free to substitute frozen cherries that you thawed, or use the same amount of another fruit like blueberries or peaches. It’s a fairly versatile recipe that way. The absolute best thing about this recipe though is how easy it is. Dump all the dry ingredients in a bowl, add the melted butter and eggs and your cake/buckle batter is pretty much done!

description: Cobblers combine two of my favorites things in the world, fruit and biscuits. A simple, easy-to-make, comfort dessert, they can be thrown together in a super short amount of time. It’s an easy recipe to fiddle with as well – don’t have apricots, try plums, peaches of nectarines; don’t like blueberries use raspberries or strawberries instead. You can even use frozen fruit if you don’t have access to fresh fruit. Double the recipe if you are serving a large party, or split it in half you need less (though you might have to adjust the bake time more or less depending on which direction you go) Of course I like eating the leftovers for breakfast. I figure it’s sort of like a reverse biscuit and jam, filled with fruit so it can’t be all bad for you can it?

description: Most of the time, when I get a peach coffee cake I find the peach flavor to be lackluster. Weak soggy peaches that have sunk to the bottom of the cake disappoint me. I flipped that around by first cooking the peaches in the beginning of the recipe, to help concentrate the flavor and then a bit of thickener (cornstarch or tapioca flour) to thicken the peaches and keep them from sinking to the bottom. Basically I create a simple peach pie filling ahead of time, to marble into the cake. It may sounds fussy but it’s worth the trouble once you take a bite of this marvelously moist coffee cake.

description: If you’ve ever visited Oregon, you’ll know that blackberries are utterly ubiquitous. Sometimes called marionberries up there, the blackberry bush seems to grow anywhere and everywhere and people seem to forage them all over the place. I’m not so lucky to have bushes on the side of the road, but I did find pints of them at my local grocery store, calling out to me to buy and use them. Who am I to refuse the call of the berry? Buried in the back of my fridge was a bunch of fresh mint that I needed to use before they went bad. I don’t know why fresh mint isn’t used more in baked goods as their bright herbaceous flavor adds a great layer of flavor. A little bit of honey, some ground almonds and the nutty flavor of whole wheat and you have a great little muffin to start your day with!

2 cups All-purpose Flour
½ teaspoons Baking Soda
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Salt
1 whole Egg
8 Tablespoons Butter
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
½ cups Granulated Sugar
½ cups Brown Sugar
1 Tablespoon Milk
½ cups Crushed Graham Crackers
½ cups Chocolate Chips
½ cups Mini Marshmallows
description: S’more cookies that taste like the real thing.

name: Lemon Chicken Stir-fry
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 pound Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts, Thinly Sliced
1 piece (about 1-inch Size) Fresh Ginger Root, Finely Diced
2 cups Water
2 packages (3 Oz. Size) Chicken-Flavored Ramen Noodles, Broken Into Pieces
2 cups Broccoli Florets, Fresh Or Frozen, Thawed
1-½ cup Carrot Shreds
1 whole Red Pepper, Cut Into 1/2 Inch Strips
3 whole Green Onions, Sliced
1 whole Lemon, Zest And Juice, Divided Use
description: This fresh-tasting stir fry is sure to please both mom and the kiddos. Colorful veggies to make mom happy and fun squiggly ramen noodles to make every kid’s slurpy noodle dreams come true!

name: Large Pearl Tapioca Pudding
ingredients:
1-½ cup Large Pearl Tapioca
6 cups Vitamin D Milk
1 can (14 Oz. Can) Sweetened Condensed Milk
½ teaspoons Nutmeg
2  Eggs, Slightly Beaten
½ teaspoons Salt
1-½ teaspoon Vanilla
description: A creamy tapioca pudding with a lightly sweetened taste. Large pearl tapioca must be soaked overnight and drained well.  I purchased the large pearl from Nuts.com since it can be difficult to find in your grocery store.

name: Maple Cinnamon Mini Doughnut Muffins
ingredients:
2 cups FOR THE DOUGHNUT MUFFINS:
¾ cups All-purpose Flour
¾ teaspoons Light Brown Sugar
1 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
1  Baking Soda
¼ cups Large Egg
½ cups Good Quality Maple Syrup
1 teaspoon Milk
½ sticks Vanilla Extract
½ sticks Unsalted Butter, Melted And Slightly Cooled
½ cups FOR THE SUGAR COATING:
description: Moist mini doughnut muffins with the perfect combination of maple syrup and cinnamon rolled in sugar to finish them off. Perfect for a quick little snack!

name: Maple Leaf Frappe
ingredients:
1-½ cup Coffee, Cold
½ cups Non-fat Milk
1 teaspoon Stevia To Taste
1 teaspoon Maple Syrup
1-¼ teaspoon Maple Extract
⅛ teaspoons Butter Extract, Optional
⅛ teaspoons Xanthan Gum (optional)
2 cups Ice
description: A creamy, buttery, thick, but fluffy frozen coffee drink with the flavor of sweet maple syrup.

name: Parsnip and Thyme Gratin
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Butter Or Olive Oil
2 Tablespoons All-purpose Flour
1-½ cup Milk
1 cup Parmesan Cheese, Grated
2 teaspoons Fresh Thyme, Chopped
4 whole Salt And Pepper, to taste
description: A flavorful alternative to traditional potatoes.

name: Peanut Butter Ball Popcorn
ingredients:
1 cup Peanut Butter
7 cups Popped Popcorn, Un-popped Kernels Removed
½ cups Nutella
⅓ cups Powdered Sugar
description: Gooey flavored popcorn with peanut butter, Nutella and powdered sugar.

name: Peanut Butter ‘Crunch’ Banana Bites
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons Unsweetened Peanut Butter
¾ cups Plain, High Fiber, Whole Grain Cereal (suggested: Kashi GoLean Original Cereal)
2 Tablespoons Chocolate Chips
2  Large Bananas, Peeled
description: A healthy snack that’s ready in 5 minutes. It’s got creamy peanut butter, plenty of “crunch” and some chocolaty sweetness too!

name: Pear & Ricotta Parfaits with Rosemary-infused Honey
ingredients:
½ cups Plain Honey (for The Rosemary-infusion)
4 whole Rosemary Sprigs
2 whole Firm Pears
3 cups Water
¼ cups Plain Honey (for Poaching The Pears)
2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
6 ounces, weight Ricotta Cheese
4 ounces, fluid Plain Granola
2 ounces, fluid Roasted, Unsalted Pepitas (or Pumpkin Seeds)
description: A simple fall treat, Pear and Ricotta Parfaits with Rosemary-infused Honey combine wonderful flavors to celebrate the season. The rosemary-infused honey used in this recipe is from Martha Stewart.

name: Healthy Maple Vanilla Muffins
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Flax Seeds
¼ cups Applesauce
1-½ cup Wheat Flour
1-½ teaspoon Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Sea Or Pink Salt
¼ teaspoons Cinnamon
⅔ cups Maple Syrup
½ cups Almond Milk
¼ cups Melted Earth Balance Butter Or Coconut Oil
1 teaspoon Pure Vanilla Extract
1 whole Vanilla Pod, Split In Half Lengthwise, Seeds Scraped Out
description: Vegan muffins sweetened with pure maple syrup and real vanilla beans!

name: Healthy Pumpkin Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients:
15 ounces, weight Canned Pumpkin Puree (Or Sub 1 4/5 Cups Homemade Pureed Pumpkin For The Can)
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
1-½ teaspoon Pumpkin Pie Spice
¼ teaspoons Sea Salt
2 cups Old Fashioned Or Quick Oats
½ cups Dark Chocolate Chips
½ cups Chopped Walnuts
description: Quick and easy oatmeal cookies made without sugar or flour!  These are so easy to customize—you can substitute any add-ins you’d like for the chocolate chips and walnuts.

name: Potato Wedges (Wedgies!)
ingredients:
2 whole Large Russet Potatoes Scrubbed Clean And Dry (keep Skin On)
2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 Tablespoon Montreal Steak Spice (or Any Spice Blend You Prefer)
description: I haven’t had a French fry since February 2006. I have totally sworn off deep fried food. These “wedgies” are my answer to a low fat healthy French fry without the guilt of the takeout window.

name: Gummy Bears
ingredients:
1 cup Organic Grape, Or Pineapple Or Pomegranate Juice
1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice
¼ teaspoons Stevia
3 Tablespoons Gelatin
description: Fruit juice-sweetened gummy bears are ideal as an after-school snack and work just as well for Halloween.

name: Pumpkin Chai Tea Latte
ingredients:
1 cup Prepared Sweetened Chai Tea Concentrate (such As Oregon Chai Or Tazo)
1 cup Milk
¼ cups Pumpkin Puree
½ teaspoons Vanilla
¼ teaspoons Cinnamon
description: A chai latte made with pumpkin puree, vanilla and cinnamon. All the flavors of fall in a toasty mug.

name: Pumpkin Enchiladas
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Butter
½ whole Large Sweet Onion (Such As Vidalia), Diced
2 whole Small Bell Peppers, Diced
3 cups Cooked, Shredded Chicken
½ cups Grated Cotija Cheese (Or Parmesan), Divided
1 whole Salt And Pepper, to taste
2 cloves Jalapeno, Seeded And Rough Chopped
1 cup Garlic, Peeled And Smashed
1 teaspoon Pumpkin Puree

¼ teaspoons Cumin
¾ cups Dry Oregano
½ cups Plain, Low-fat Greek Yogurt
8 whole Unsalted Chicken Stock
1 cup Small Corn Tortillas
description: Enchiladas made with chicken, bell peppers, pumpkin, and white cheddar cheese. An easy delicious fall meal.

name: Pumpkin Muffins
ingredients:
¾ cups Packed Brown Sugar
3 Tablespoons Molasses
¼ cups Olive Oil
2  Large Eggs
1 cup Canned Pumpkin
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
¾ cups Half-and-half
1 cup All-purpose Flour
1 cup Whole Wheat Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Soda
½ teaspoons Salt
1 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon
1 teaspoon Pumpkin Pie Spice
¼ teaspoons Ground Nutmeg
¼ cups Raw Unsalted Pumpkin Seeds
description: Perfect go to snack or breakfast for fall.

name: Pumpkin Pie French Toast with Cinnamon Whipped Cream
ingredients:
3 whole FOR THE FRENCH TOAST:
1 cup Eggs
¾ cups Milk
2 Tablespoons Pumpkin Puree (not Pie Filling)
1 teaspoon Granulated Sugar
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
¼ teaspoons Ground Cinnamon
¼ teaspoons Ground Nutmeg
10 slices Ground Cloves

1 cup Butter, For Frying
2 Tablespoons FOR THE CINNAMON WHIPPED CREAM:
1 teaspoon Whipping (heavy) Cream
½ teaspoons Granulated Sugar
description: A delicious Fall breakfast that the whole family will love—and they won’t even know that they’re eating a vegetable!

name: Pumpkin Scones
ingredients:
½ cups Greek Yogurt, Plain
⅔ cups Pumpkin, Canned (not Pumpkin Pie Filling)
¼ cups Egg Substitute Or 1 Egg
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
2 cups White Whole Wheat Flour
½ cups Sugar (I Used Presweet Tagatose)
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
1 teaspoon Baking Soda
⅛ teaspoons Salt
¼ teaspoons Pumpkin Pie Spice
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
6 Tablespoons Margarine Or Butter
⅓ cups Dried Cranberries
2 Tablespoons FOR BRUSHING ON SCONES:
1 teaspoon Egg Substitute
½ Tablespoons Non-fat Milk
description: A sweet, healthy, 100-calorie pumpkin flavored scone filled with cranberries and sprinkled with sugar. I was told they taste like Starbucks Scones!

name: Pumpkin Spice Doughnut Holes
ingredients:
4 Tablespoons FOR THE DOUGHNUT DOUGH:
¼ cups Unsalted Butter, Softened To Room Temperature
¼ cups Brown Sugar
¾ teaspoons Granulated White Sugar
1 teaspoon Kosher Salt
½ teaspoons Pumpkin Pie Spice
½ teaspoons Ground Cinnamon
¼ teaspoons Ground Ginger
⅛ teaspoons Ground Nutmeg
2 teaspoons Ground Cloves

1 teaspoon Baking Soda
⅓ cups Vanilla Extract
⅓ cups Pumpkin Puree

1 whole Egg
2 cups Egg Yolk
2 cups All-purpose Flour (plus Extra For Dusting)
1 cup Vegetable Oil, For Frying, Plus More As Needed
1 Tablespoon FOR THE CINNAMON SUGAR MIXTURE:
description: Doughnuts are surprisingly easy to make and this is the perfect recipe to get you started!

name: Pumpkin Spice Granola
ingredients:
4-½ cups Rolled Oats
¼ cups Ground Flaxseed Meal
½ cups Chopped Cashews
½ cups Pepitas
¾ cups Dried Cranberries
1-½ teaspoon Pumpkin Pie Spice

¾ cups Dark Brown Sugar
½ cups Pumpkin Puree
⅓ cups Applesauce
⅓ cups Maple Syrup
1-½ teaspoon Vanilla Extract
description: This granola recipe is perfect for fall and packed full of pumpkin flavor!

name: Pumpkin Spice Marshmallow Popcorn Balls
ingredients:
1 bag (8 Oz. Bag) Pumpkin Spice Marshmallows
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
6 cups Popped Popcorn, Un-popped Kernels Removed
½ cups Pecans, Chopped
description: Festive ooey gooey pumpkin-spiced flavored popcorn!

name: Grilled Bacon-Wrapped Beer Cheese-Stuffed Meatloaf
ingredients:
8 ounces, weight FOR THE BEER CHEESE:
½ teaspoons Sharp Cheddar Or Colby Jack Cheese
2 cloves Worcestershire Sauce
1 teaspoon Garlic, Chopped
1 dash Dry Mustard
5 ounces, fluid Cayenne Pepper
2 pounds Dark Beer (like Negro Modelo)
1 pound Salt To Taste
2 whole FOR THE MEATLOAVES:
1-½ cup Ground Beef
4 cloves Ground Pork
1 whole Eggs
3 Tablespoons Quick Cooking Oats
1 teaspoon Garlic, Chopped
1-½ Tablespoon Onion (small) Grated
8 pieces Tomato Paste
¾ cups Pepper
2 Tablespoons Kosher Salt
2 Tablespoons Bacon, Sliced In Half
1 Tablespoon FOR THE GLAZE:
2 Tablespoons Ketchup
1 Tablespoon Sriracha
½ teaspoons Yellow Mustard
description: Let’s just review … meatloaves stuffed with a homemade beer cheese, topped with bacon and an awesome glaze and then grilled.  What could possibly be bad?

name: Greek Hand Pies
ingredients:
1 pound FOR THE HAND PIES:
2 cloves Ground Beef
1 teaspoon Garlic, Minced
¼ teaspoons Greek Seasoning (McCormick)
⅓ cups Salt
¼ cups Finely Diced Zucchini
2 boxes Black Olives, Chopped
¼ cups (14.1 Oz. Size) Pre-Made Pie Crust
1 whole Crumbled Feta Cheese
1 cup Egg Light Beaten With A Splash Of Water
1 Tablespoon FOR THE TZATZIKI SAUCE:
1 clove Plain Greek Yogurt
2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
description: Pre-made pie dough is filled with a savory Greek filling.

name: Roasted Tomato Soup
ingredients:
28 ounces, weight Canned Whole Peeled Tomatoes
1 Tablespoon Salt And Pepper
½ teaspoons Dark Brown Sugar
1 Tablespoon Ground Cloves
2-½ cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil
¼ cups Vegetable Stock
description: Oven-roasted tomatoes, warm spice, vegetable stock and cream come together in a deliciously satisfying tomato soup.

name: Rosemary Garlic Parmesan Swirls
ingredients:
1-½ cup Bread Flour
1 teaspoon Kosher Salt
½ teaspoons Freshly Ground Black Pepper
1 Tablespoon Sugar
2-¼ teaspoons Instant Yeast
½ cups Warm Water
5 Tablespoons Butter, Melted And Cooled To Room Temperature
3 cloves Garlic, Minced
¾ cups Grated Parmesan
2 teaspoons Minced Fresh Rosemary
description: Cheesy, swirly goodness!

name: Jumbo Pumpkin Maple Muffins
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE MUFFINS:
2 cups Whole Wheat Flour
½ cups All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Your Favorite Granola
1 Tablespoon Kosher Salt
1 cup Baking Powder

1 cup Whole Milk
2 whole Pure Maple Syrup

2 Tablespoons FOR THE FROSTING:
2 Tablespoons Room Temperature Cream Cheese

name: Salad with Pesto Chicken
ingredients:
5 ounces, weight Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast
1 Tablespoon Basil Pesto, From A Jar Or Homemade
2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
3 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 pinch Chili Powder

¼ whole Red Onion

1 pinch Ground Black Pepper
description: Capture those last few rays of sunshine in this Mediterranean style salad.

name: Scalloped Potatoes with Ham
ingredients:
10 whole Potatoes
4 cups Milk (Vitamin D Or 2%)
3 teaspoons Salt
2 teaspoons Black Pepper
8 Tablespoons Flour
16 ounces, weight Thinly Sliced Honey Roasted Ham
8 ounces, weight Medium Sharp Cheese
description: Delicious and easy enough too make this fall!

name: Silverdollar Socca
ingredients:
1 1/2 cup / 6 3/4 ounces chickpea flour
1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt
2 large eggs
1/2 cup / 120 ml water
1 cup / 240 ml buttermilk
1/2 cup / 120 ml extra virgin olive oil 
2 tablespoons black sesame seeds
1 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds (optional)
cold-pressed mustard seed oil, extra-virgin coconut oil, or clarified butter, for frying
description: Tiny socca-inspired pancakes made with buttermilk or keffir -  golden, tender, and cooked in cold-pressed spicy mustard oil. Flat out delicious.

name: Asian Sweet Chili Sauce
ingredients:
2 pounds of chili peppers of your choice
1 onion, peeled and quartered
3 cloves garlic, peeled
1/4 cup cooking oil
1/2 cup rice wine vinegar (or cider vinegar)
1/2 cup  brown sugar
1/2 cup fish sauce
description: Good Asian cooks never run out of rice, soy sauce, ginger and garlic. I'll also throw fish sauce and Thai sweet chili sauce in the mix too. I must be a bad Asian because I'm constantly out of these...

name: French Silk Pie, Step-by-Step
ingredients:
4 ounces, weight Unsweetened Baking Chocolate
1 cup Salted Butter, Softened
1-1/2 cup Sugar
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
4 whole Eggs
1 package Baked Pie Shell
description: I first posted this French Silk Pie recipe back in the dark ages of 2008, and it remains one of my all-time favorite desserts...

name: Garlic Shrimp Pasta
ingredients:
½ pounds Spaghetti Noodles
½ sticks Butter
2 Tablespoons Minced Garlic
2 cups Shrimp, Precooked And Frozen, Or Fresh
1 whole Roma Tomato
1 Tablespoon Fresh Parsley, Chopped
1 teaspoon Garlic Salt
1 pinch Red Pepper Flakes
2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
description: Shrimp with pasta, herbs and tomatoes tossed with a garlic sauce. Cooks in 15 minutes.

name: Slow Cooked Bourbon Peach BBQ Pulled Pork
ingredients:
3 pounds Boneless Pork Shoulder Or Boston Butt Roast
½ whole Large Onion, Diced
½ cups Bourbon (Can Substitute Water.)
4 whole Large Peaches, Seeded And Skin Removed
1 clove Garlic, Minced
1 cup Ketchup
1 Tablespoon Apple Cider Vinegar
½ teaspoons Sea Salt
½ teaspoons Ground Black Pepper
1 teaspoon Smoked Paprika

1 whole Chipotle Pepper In Adobo Sauce, Chopped (Add 2 For More Heat.)
1 Tablespoon Adobo Sauce From Canned Chipotle Peppers
2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar
description: Slow Cooked Bourbon Peach BBQ Pulled Pork in the crockpot.

2 Tablespoons FOR THE GRAVY:
2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter
1-½ cup All-purpose Flour
1 cube Low Sodium Beef Broth
1 teaspoon Beef Bouillon

description: Perfect tender tasty meatballs in amazing gravy spooned over hot cooked egg noodles. Classic comfort food. Who doesn’t love that?

name: Sweet Potato Tacos
ingredients:
2 whole Sweet Potatoes, Peeled And Diced
1 can Drained Black Beans (15 Oz)

8 whole Sprouted Corn Tortillas
description: A vegan sweet potato tacos recipe that you’ve got to try.

1-½ cup Flour
½ teaspoons Salt
1 cup Sugar
1 teaspoon Baking Soda
1 cup Pumpkin Puree
½ cups Oil
2  Eggs, Beaten
¼ cups Water
½ teaspoons Cinnamon
½ teaspoons Allspice
½ teaspoons Nutmeg
½ cups Chopped Walnuts
description: Moist, flavorful and easy!  If you are a pumpkin fan, this bread is for you!

name: Tomato, Basil & Garlic Pasta
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
½ whole Red Onion, Finely Chopped
1 Tablespoon Minced Garlic In Oil
1 teaspoon Red Chili Flakes
1 Tablespoon Ground Thyme
1 Tablespoon Oregano
12 ounces, weight Grape Tomatoes
1 teaspoon Sugar
1 pound Angel Hair Pasta
¼ cups Grated Parmesan
¼ cups Fresh Basil, Chiffonade
description: Tomato, basil and garlic pasta

name: Traditional Potato Salad
ingredients:
3 whole Eggs, Raw
½ cups Sugar
1-½ teaspoon Flour
½ teaspoons Salt
½ cups White Vinegar
1 teaspoon Yellow Mustard
2 Tablespoons Butter, Softened
½ cups Evaporated Milk
5 pounds Red Potatoes
12 whole Eggs, Hard Boiled, Peeled And Chopped
1 bunch Green Onions, Chopped
description: The final word in potato salad!

name: Vegetable Beef Soup
ingredients:
1 pound Ground Beef
1  Large Yellow Onion, Chopped
2 teaspoons Salt
1-½ teaspoon Black Pepper
½ teaspoons Dried Parsley
14-½ ounces, weight Canned Diced Tomatoes, Unsalted
1 cup Tomato Puree, Unsalted
15 ounces, weight Canned White Potatoes, Drained And Sliced
1 can Green Beans, 14 Ounce Can (not Drained)
½ cups Carrots, Peeled And Thinly Sliced
description: The great thing about this soup is that you can cook it in a little over an hour and enjoy it then. Or you can allow it to simmer covered for a few hours, and deepen the flavors even more. The leftovers are great. They definitely do not taste like a reheated meal. So put this recipe in your files and be ready to enjoy it on a cool fall or winter evening.

name: Venison Chili
ingredients:
2 whole Onions, Chopped
1 whole Green Pepper, Chopped
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
2 pounds Ground Venison
1 can (27 Oz. Size) Chili Beans, Undrained
1 jar (12 Oz. Size) Roasted Red Peppers, Undrained, Choppped
1 can (8 Oz. Size) Tomato Sauce
½ cups Sherry
2 teaspoons Cumin
2 teaspoons Garlic Salt
1 teaspoon Chili Powder
1 teaspoon Salt
description: Warm chili on a cool fall day is a tailgating favorite. Keep it warm in an insulated carrier and serve it in Styrofoam cups along with some shredded cheese and saltine crackers. Since it is now hunting season and I get the occasional gift of venison, here is a version I made last week. Of course you can substitute any meat of your choice!

name: Whole Wheat Pumpkin Walnut Muffins!
ingredients:
1-½ cup Whole Wheat Flour
1 Tablespoon Pumpkin Spice

¼ teaspoons Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Salt
⅓ cups Apple Sauce
½ cups Agave Nectar
¼ cups Melted Butter

1 cup Pumpkin Puree
description: Delicious whole wheat pumpkin walnut muffins, just in time for Fall! Enjoy fresh out of the oven with a hot cup of coffee for breakfast!

name: Apricot Pistachio Oatmeal Cookies

1 cup Old-fashioned Rolled Oats (not Quick Cooking)

name: Linguine in White Clam Sauce

2 ounces, weight Unsalted Butter
3 cloves Finely Minced Garlic
½ whole Small Diced Shallot
1 cup White Wine (chardonnay)

description: Make this easy classic dish for Linguine in White Clam Sauce that is sure to be a fan favorite!

10 ounces, weight Pasta, Your Choice, Cooked To Package Directions

2 pints Mushrooms, Any Kind, Sliced Or Coarsely Chopped
1 whole Small Onion, Thinly Sliced
3 cloves Garlic, Minced
1 Tablespoon Flour (scant)

½ cups Sour Cream, Plus More For Serving If Desired
½ teaspoons Worcestershire Sauce
description: Love the sour cream base but not into meat?  Here’s your answer.

name: Caribbean Rice with Shrimp
ingredients:
1 can Pineapple Tidbits (20 Oz Can)
1 can Coconut Milk (14 Oz Can)
1 cup Long Grain Brown Rice
¼ cups Unsweetened Flaked Coconut (such As Bob's Red Mill)

1 whole Onion, Chopped
2-½ whole Bell Peppers (I Like To Use One Green, And Half Each Of Red, Orange, And Yellow), Seeded And Chopped
5 cloves Garlic, Minced

1 teaspoon Parsley
12 ounces, weight Cooked Shrimp (I Use Frozen/Thawed, With The Tails Removed)
description: I used to be addicted to Zatarain’s Caribbean rice, but lately I haven’t been using their products since I prefer to eat brown rice. I thought to myself, “How hard can it be?”  As it turns out, on my first try, I proclaimed Rinabeana 1, Zatarain’s 0!

name: Double Crumb Cake
ingredients:
3 cups FOR THE CAKE:
1 cup All-purpose Flour
3 teaspoons Sugar
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
2  Salt
1 cup Large Eggs
¼ cups Buttermilk Or Milk
3 teaspoons Oil
4 cups Vanilla Extract

name: Cheesy Acorn Squash Stuffed with Southwestern Quinoa
ingredients:
1 whole Acorn Squash
2 teaspoons Olive Oil

½ whole Jalapeno, Seeded And Finely Chopped
½ teaspoons Cumin

14-½ ounces, weight Salt To Taste
1 cup Can Black Beans, Rinsed And Drained
1 cup Corn (fresh, Frozen, Or Canned/drained)

¼ cups Cilantro, Chopped
description: A hearty-yet-meatless fall dinner of acorn squash stuffed with spicy quinoa, black beans, corn, and cilantro and topped with melted cheese.

6 cups Water
description: Warm, hearty soup filled with lima beans and kielbasa.

name: Edamame Succotash
ingredients:
12 ounces, weight Frozen Edamame (shells On)

1 pinch Freshly Ground Black Pepper

5 whole FOR THE FILLING:
½ whole Large Peaches, Washed, Pitted And Chopped Into One Inch Chunks (skin On)
¼ cups Lemon, Juiced
½ cups Sugar (white, Granular)
½ teaspoons Whole Wheat Flour
2 Tablespoons Cinnamon

1 cup FOR THE CRUMBLE:
¼ cups Whole Wheat Flour

description: Another reason I love autumn!  This is a fun variation of the traditional apple crisp recipe I posted earlier.

name: Pan Fried Grouper Tacos with Chipotle Sour Cream
ingredients:
½ cups Light Sour Cream
¼ cups Milk
1-½ teaspoon Chipotle Chile In Adobo Sauce, Minced
1 whole Lime, Divided

description: Fish tacos lightly fried in olive oil and topped with avocado, cabbage and cilantro. Smoky chipotle sour cream adds just the right amount of flavor and heat!

name: Sweet and Spicy Slow Cooker Chicken Legs

4 whole Chicken Legs, Up To 6
½ cups Soy Sauce
2 Tablespoons Rice Vinegar

¼ cups Brown Sugar
7 cloves Garlic, Peeled
2 teaspoons Cornstarch

1 whole Green Onion, Sliced, For Garnish
description: A tender and flavorful sweet and spicy chicken leg recipe that is a cinch to throw together in your slow cooker.

name: Slow Cooker Filipino Pork Adobo

1 whole Onion, Thinly Sliced
6 cloves (Large Cloves) Garlic, Peeled And Thinly Sliced

1 Tablespoon Fresh Ginger, Smashed

name: frico grilled cheese sandwiches
ingredients:
12 days is a very long trip. I was there long enough that the cars no longer looked funny to me, or gave me the panic-of-imminent-death that they were on the wrong side of the road. It was long enough that I came home and asked my son if he wanted porridge for breakfast, but I meant oatmeal. I’ve lost sight of why we whip cream for desserts, when a fruit crumble is so much better thickly drizzled with it cold and fresh. I may have called something “brilliant” yesterday, when it really wasn’t. I’ve always thought that the feeling of being away is increased by the number of times when you’re so caught up in the details of being there (maybe for good stuff like
or stuff that’s more amusing in hindsight like being consumed with why you’re stuck on a jammed train or a fully-booked hotel you’re trying to check into at 1 a.m. can’t find your reservation or have no idea where to transfer rails because what do you have against clear signage, London, what?) and by that standard, the trip felt even longer. This is wonderful when you’re on a family summer vacation but a little sadder when you’re away from them, and I’m feeling the need to excessively dote on
now that I’m back, which likely means more home cooking, more soaking up of weekend inspiration, and more new fun ideas to share here. Everyone wins.
2 slices bread of your choice
2 teaspoons butter, salted or unsalted
1/2 cup (2 ounces) coarsely grated cheddar
description: With all due respect, I think you’ve been putting cheese on the wrong side of your grilled cheese sandwiches. Or, at the least, neglecting the better ones, the exteriors. Wait, hear me out. It’s basic food math that while cold cheese is good, warm cheese is better. But if you take that a step further — and if you’re new here, let me tell you: we will always take it a step further — you will agree that melted cheese is better than warm cheese, and the melted cheese that rolls off a piece of sandwich bread and sizzles on a skillet, browning and crisping, is the top of the cheese tower… A place I’d very much like to live. Do you think a cheese tower might exist somewhere? Might it be France? Now I’m picturing an Eiffel Tower made out of cheese and what were we talking about? Oh right: melted and browned cheese wins, really for the same reason that browned butter trumps regular butter: the fats melt away from the dairy solids and toast them until they’re caramelized and achingly delicious and you forget why you’d ever eat it any other way. Don’t fight it.

description: There are two secrets to these brownies that make them a step above your usual pumpkin cheesecake brownie. One, make sure to cook down the pumpkin puree from the can, concentrating the pumpkin flavor. You can certainly skip this step and just use 1 cup of the pumpkin puree from the can but the resulting brownie won’t look as orange and it won’t taste as pumpkin-y. Two, use Dutch processed cocoa. You can find it online but most grocery stores carry Hershey’s Special Dark cocoa which works fine for this recipe. You’ll get a deeper more bitter chocolate taste to the brownies as well as a lovely rich black color that’s a great contrast to the orange pumpkin cheesecake. If the “spiderweb” pattern seems too fussy for you to make, just drizzle the reserved brownie batter over the cheesecake batter in a random pattern and swirl with a butter knife or toothpick.

There are two secrets to these brownies that make them a step above your usual pumpkin cheesecake brownie. One, make sure to cook down the pumpkin puree from the can, concentrating the pumpkin flavor. You can certainly skip this step and just use 1 cup of the pumpkin puree from the can but the resulting brownie won’t look as orange and it won’t taste as pumpkin-y. Two, use Dutch processed cocoa. You can find it online but most grocery stores carry Hershey’s Special Dark cocoa which works fine for this recipe. You’ll get a deeper more bitter chocolate taste to the brownies as well as a lovely rich black color that’s a great contrast to the orange pumpkin cheesecake. If the “spiderweb” pattern seems too fussy for you to make, just drizzle the reserved brownie batter over the cheesecake batter in a random pattern and swirl with a butter knife or toothpick.

Not good eats for kids (or adults). Avoid the dreaded kid spit out by roasting these babies until they are just tender and brown.

)

1 oz. gin
½ oz. lemon juice
4 oz. champagne
1 oz. simple syrup
Ice
1 brandied cherry

1/4 c. silken tofu
1 T. lemon juice
1/2 t. anchovy paste
4 T. grated parmesan cheese
2 T. mayonnaise
Dash Worcestershire sauce
1/4 t. dijon mustard
Salt and pepper to taste
1 small clove garlic, minced

8 cups unsalted mixed nuts (I used peanuts, brazils, walnuts, cashews and almonds)
1 stick butter, melted
1/3 cup maple syrup
3 tablespoons brown sugar
2 teaspoons garlic powder
1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper
1/3 cup chopped fresh rosemary
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme
2 tablespoons sea salt

name: Triple Coconut Cream Pie

2 eggs
1/4 cup flour
1/2 cup sugar
Pinch of salt
1/2 cup skim milk
1-13.5 ounce can of light coconut milk
1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
1-13.5 ounce can of regular coconut milk, refrigerated
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 tablespoons confectioner's sugar
1 prebaked pie crust
3 tablespoons toasted coconut

name: Turnip and Sweet Potato Gratin
ingredients:
Cooking spray
4 tablespoons butter, divided
3 garlic cloves, minced
2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
2 cups low-fat milk
1/2 teaspoon dried sage
1/2 teaspoon dried thyme

Salt and pepper, to taste

2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced thinly (about 1-1/2 pounds)
1/2 cup shredded Parmesan cheese
1/2 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese

name: Two Bean Meatless Meatloaf

1/2 cup ketchup
2 tablespoons molasses
1 teaspoon chili powder
2 tablespoons mustard
1/4 cup water
1 cup oats

1/2 large green pepper, diced

1/2 cup sunflower kernels

1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed

2 tablespoons vegan Worcestershire sauce
Salt and pepper, to taste
description: The two different types of beans help the texture approximate regular meatloaf. The pinto beans become smooth and creamy, while the chickpeas tend to keep some of their shape. Try experimenting with other types of beans to find your perfect combo.

name: Vanilla Cardamom Spritz Cookies
ingredients:
1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, softened
1 cup granulated sugar
1 large egg
2-1/2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom
1/2 teaspoon sea salt
2-1/2 cups all purpose flour
Sprinkles and colored sugar for decorating

name: Vanilla Chai Tapioca Pudding
ingredients:
1/2 cup tapioca pearls
1 cup water
1/2 cinnamon stick
4 whole cloves
1/4 teaspoon ground ginger
4 cardamom pods, crushed
1 square cheese cloth
2 cups unsweetened, vanilla almond milk
1 vanilla bean (can sub 1 teaspoon vanilla extract)
Pinch salt
1/2 cup sugar

name: Vegan “Meat” Balls
ingredients:
1/2 cup cooked lentil
1 cup cooked brown rice
1/4 cup oats
1/3 cup wheat germ
1 tablespoon soy sauce
2 tablespoons olive oil
2 teaspoons lemon juice

1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
1/8 teaspoon nutmeg
1 teaspoon chili powder
1 teaspoon paprika
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon onion powder
1 teaspoon maple syrup (could sub molasses)
1 teaspoons dry mustard

name: Vegan Baked Beans with Pears
ingredients:
2 tablespoons olive oil
1 medium onion, diced
2 garlic cloves, minced
1 pear, diced
1 tablespoon chili powder
1 teaspoon dry mustard
1 teaspoon cumin
1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
2 tablespoons vegan Worcestershire sauce
4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
3 tablespoons molasses
1/4 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup water
1 can great northern beans, drained and rinsed
1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed

name: Vegan Butternut and Apple Bisque
ingredients:
2 tablespoons olive oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 large onion, diced
1 tablespoon fresh grated and peeled ginger
2 large carrots, peeled and chopped
1 large apple, peeled, cored and chopped
1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon
2 medium butternut squash, peeled, seeds removed, chopped
3 1/2 cups vegetable broth
Salt and pepper, to taste
description: The real flavor star in this soup is the butternut squash. The apple lends a nice, naturally-sweet side note that partners perfectly with the warmth of the squash. No apples on hand? Sub in a tablespoon of honey or maple syrup for a similar taste. If you want to up the protein of this dish, sprinkle some crunchy, earthy salted pumpkin seeds on top.

name: Vegan Fall Vegetable Stew with Black Beans and Barley
ingredients:
2 small butternut squash (about 2-1/2 pounds), peeled, seeds removed, and cut into 1" chunks
2 tablespoons olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
1 small green bell pepper, diced
2 stalks celery, diced
2 carrots, diced
1 large onion, diced
8 ounces button or baby bella mushrooms, sliced
2-15 ounce cans black beans, drained and rinsed
1 teaspoon fresh rosemary, minced
2 tablespoons fresh sage, minced
1 tablespoon fresh thyme, minced
2 bay leaves
Salt and pepper, to taste
6 cups vegetable broth
3/4 cup pearled barley

name: Vegan Pumpkin Spice Latte
ingredients:
2 cups non-dairy milk (I used unsweetened vanilla almond milk)
1/4 cup pumpkin puree
3-4 tablespoons maple syrup
2 tablespoons vanilla extract
1/4 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice (plus more for garnish)
2/3 cup strongly brewed coffee
description: Save yourself the hassle and expense of dropping into your local Starbucks this Fall and instead make the beloved PSL at home using ingredients you probably already have on hand.

name: Vegan Red Beans and Rice
ingredients:
1 pound dry red kidney beans
5 cloves garlic, minced
1 large onion, diced finely (about 1 1/2 cups)
5 celery stalks, diced finely (about 1 1/2 cups)
1 large green bell pepper, diced finely (about 1 1/2 cups)
3 bay leaves
2 tsp. thyme
2 tsp. oregano
1/4 – 1 tsp. red pepper
1/2 tsp. black pepper
2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped
1/2 tbsp. red pepper sauce (such as Tabasco)
1 tsp. Liquid Smoke
Salt, to taste
Rice, cooked, for serving

name: Vegan Roasted Red Pepper Pesto
ingredients:
2 medium red peppers, halved, seeded, and roasted
1-1/2 cup packed fresh basil leaves
5 garlic cloves
1/2 cup pine nuts
1/2 cup walnuts
1/3 cup nutritional yeast
Salt and pepper, to taste
1/3 cup olive oil
description: If you aren't a fan of tracking down nutritional yeast and don't care about the vegan-ness, go ahead and sub in Parmesan cheese in the same amount. Toss a few tablespoons of this pesto with your favorite pasta and you have a quick and delicious dinner.

name: Vegetarian Five Bean Soup Mix
ingredients:
1 pound pinto beans
1 pound split green peas (or green lentils)
1 pound great northern beans
1 pound black beans
1 pound kidney beans
1 tablespoon black pepper
1 tablespoon paprika
1 tablespoon dry mustard
2 tablespoons dehydrated onions (found in the spice aisle)
2 tablespoons sea salt
2 tablespoons garlic powder
2 tablespoons dried oregano
1 teaspoon dried rosemary
8 bay leaves
4 vegetable bouillon cubes
4 clear quart Mason jars plus lids and rings
Parchment paper
Tape or stickers
Labels
Fabric and ribbon to cover top

name: Vegetarian Thai Quinoa Chili
ingredients:
1 tablespoon chili powder
